title: IT Service Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The IT Service Manager is accountable for the end-to-end performance, governance and continual improvement of a portfolio of IT services, including management and development of the Service Desk function, its team and platform as the single front door for all incidents and service requests.

Operating as the senior service management interface for the Head of IT the role translates business priorities into measurable service outcomes, establishes effective governance and ensures services remain resilient, secure, compliant and commercially sustainable.

The role oversees ITIL-aligned governance across incident management, service request fulfilment, problem management, change enablement, service transition and service level management. It drives continual improvement in service management capability to deliver a consistently high-quality, measurable customer experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Own the Service Desk platform and the operational front door for all incidents and service requests, ensuring effective intake, triage, routing, prioritisation, communication and fulfilment through consistent processes and service standards.

· Manage, lead and develop the Service Desk team, including Service Desk Agents and the Service Analyst, setting clear objectives, clarifying accountability, coaching performance and building consistent service management capability.

· Accountable for end-to-end service performance, customer experience, resilience, risk and value, using KPIs, SLAs, experience measures and trend analysis to drive informed decisions and corrective action.

· Analyse service data and produce accurate dashboards and regular reports covering incident and request volumes, backlogs, SLA performance, resolution times and customer satisfaction. Identify trends, recurring issues and improvement opportunities, translating findings into actionable recommendations and tracking the impact of service improvements.

· Champion the effective and responsible use of automation and artificial intelligence across service management processes to reduce manual handling, accelerate incident and service request fulfilment, improve service quality and deliver a faster, more consistent customer experience.

· Provide leadership during major incidents and critical service escalations, ensuring decisive ownership, effective communications, appropriate business continuity and timely restoration of service.

· Ensure robust problem management and post-incident governance, holding owners to account for root cause analysis, corrective actions, risk reduction and measurable prevention of recurrence.

· Own service change governance and represent service interests in change approval, balancing pace of delivery with operational risk, control, readiness and service stability.

· Set service acceptance and transition standards for new and changed services, ensuring support models, ownership, security, monitoring, capacity, continuity, documentation, knowledge and funding are in place before go-live.

· Maintain a prioritised continual improvement portfolio that delivers measurable gains in service quality, automation, efficiency, resilience, customer satisfaction and business value.

· Manage supplier service performance and commercial outcomes, challenging underperformance, validating obligations, coordinating improvement plans and supporting contract, renewal and sourcing decisions.

· Maintain oversight of service budgets, forecasts, consumption and cost drivers, identifying opportunities to improve value, control demand and optimise the total cost of service.

· Own the service risk and control position, ensuring audit actions, data protection, cyber security, backup, recovery, disaster recovery and operational resilience requirements are understood, evidenced and addressed.

· Chair service reviews and governance forums, presenting concise performance, financial, risk, compliance and improvement updates to senior business and IT stakeholders.

· Develop trusted relationships with business leaders, acting as the senior point of accountability for service matters and converting business demand into clear service priorities and outcomes.

· Own and maintain the project roadmap for service initiatives and improvements, ensuring priorities, dependencies, resources and delivery milestones are aligned with business and technology objectives.

· Own the service management strategy and operating plan for assigned services, ensuring priorities, investment and improvement roadmaps align with business objectives and technology strategy.

SKILLS & CAPABILITIES

Experience & Knowledge

· Substantial experience managing a portfolio of business-critical IT services in a complex, multi-stakeholder and supplier-supported environment

· Demonstrable accountability for service strategy, governance, performance, customer experience, risk, financial management and continual improvement

· Experience owning and developing IT service management (ITSM) platforms, with a proven track record of evolving technology through the responsible use of automation, AI and continual service improvement to reduce manual handling, accelerate service delivery and improve customer experience, supported by measurable outcomes

· Experience managing and developing a Service Desk function, including Service Desk Agents and Service Analysts, setting direction, managing performance and building capability across direct and matrix teams

· Strong track record of influencing senior stakeholders, chairing governance forums and presenting complex service matters as clear business decisions, risks and outcomes

· Experience managing strategic suppliers and supplier governance, service contracts, performance obligations, improvement plans and commercial negotiations to optimise service value

· Experience overseeing service budgets, forecasts, cost optimisation, demand management and investment cases

· Proven leadership of major incidents, high-impact escalations, problem management and service recovery in pressured environments

· Strong practical knowledge of ITIL-aligned governance across incident management, service request fulfilment, problem management, change enablement, service level management, service design and transition, and continual improvement

· ITIL certification is essential

· Ability to define service measures and translate operational, financial and customer data into insight, priorities and evidence-based decisions

· Supporting technical and control knowledge covering monitoring, asset and software management, lifecycle planning, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, continuity planning, operational and service resilience, cyber security, data protection and governance controls

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

· Visible and credible leader who sets clear direction, creates accountability and develops high-performing teams

· Strategic thinker able to connect technology services, business priorities, customer experience and commercial outcomes

· Confident and influential communicator, effective from operational teams through to executive leadership

· Decisive under pressure, with sound judgement and the ability to balance service, risk, cost and business priorities

· Commercially aware and financially literate, with a strong focus on value, outcomes and responsible use of resources

· Skilled in negotiation, constructive challenge and conflict resolution across internal teams and external suppliers

· Analytical and evidence-led, able to turn complex information into clear priorities, decisions and executive messages

· Customer-focused and pragmatic, maintaining strategic perspective while ensuring operational commitments are delivered

· Resilient, adaptable and comfortable leading through ambiguity, organisational change and competing demands

· Committed to continual improvement, professional standards and building a mature, measurable service management culture

COMPLIANCE AND VALUES

Ensure adherence to:

· ITIL Framework

· Quality (ISO 9001)

· Information Security (ISO 27001)

· Cyber essentials & Cyber essentials +

· Environmental Management (ISO 14001 / ESG)

Consistently demonstrate Axians’ UK core values:

· Trust, Solidarity, Responsibility, Entrepreneurial Mindset & Autonomy

SALARY AND BENEFITS

· Salary is based on experience and location.

· Benefits include:

· Company Shares Scheme, Pension, Medical Insurance, Financial Planning Support, Death in Service, Medicash Healthcare Cash Plan, Permanent Total Disability Insurance, Enhanced Maternity/Paternity/Adoption Pay, Company Sick Pay, Hybrid Working, Investment in personal and professional training, Professional Memberships, Health checks, Wellbeing training and support, Employee Assistance Program, Flu jabs, Eyecare and of course paid holiday.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Axians is a fun and growing business both in the UK and globally. We are part of a network of businesses where you can learn from and work with peers worldwide to help you achieve your ambitions. Supporting our employees and customers is at the heart of who we are. This means we can support a hybrid work environment, but we always work best in teams in person, either in our offices or on customer sites.

ABOUT US

Axians UK is a technology services partner that delivers transformative solutions to accelerate our customers’ ambitions in today’s ever-changing world. Whether they need tried-and-tested platforms or cutting-edge innovation, we commit to customer excellence and invest in long-term thinking.

The strength of Axians’ global network as part of VINCI Energies means our customers can rely on our incredible people to deploy technology that achieves critical operational outcomes, wherever you are and whatever your need.

title: 1st Line IT Support Engineer
description:

title: AI Engineer (Spatial Intelligence)
description:
About Huawei Research and Development UK Limited

Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000 employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world.

Our vision and mission is to bring digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. To this end, we will drive ubiquitous connectivity and promote equal access to networks; bring cloud and artificial intelligence to all four corners of the earth to provide superior computing power where you need it, when you need it; build digital platforms to help all industries and organizations become more agile, efficient, and dynamic; redefine user experience with AI, making it more personalized for people in all aspects of their life, whether they’re at home, in the office, or on the go.

This spirit of innovation has led Huawei to work in close partnership with leading academic institutions in the UK to develop and refine the latest technologies. With a shared commitment to innovation and progress, both parties have worked together to achieve common goals and establish a strong partnership. The partnership between UK and Huawei help to develop the technologies of the future that will transform the way we all communicate, work and live.

For the past 30 years we have maintained an unwavering focus, rejecting shortcuts and easy opportunities that don't align with our core business. With a practical approach to everything we do, we concentrate our efforts and invest patiently to drive technological breakthroughs.

This strategic focus is a reflection of our core values:

  • Staying customer-centric,

  • Inspiring dedication,

  • Persevering,

  • Growing by reflection.

Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Overview

Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Job Summary

We are seeking a talented and forward-thinking AI Engineer (Spatial Intelligence) to bridge the gap between physical environment sensing and on-device Personal Intelligence. In this role, you will develop the critical foundation models that allow consumer devices to understand their physical surroundings and retrieve relevant local data. You will be at the forefront of building the next generation of maps, entirely powered by edge-AI.

Key Responsibilities:

• Foundation Models Optimization: Deploy and fine-tune multimodal models for consumer-grade edge hardware and highly specialized use cases.
• Spatial Systems: Build prototypes to translate geospatial data into structured formats optimized for LLM reasoning.
• Vector Search: Design high-performance data retrieval solutions optimized for distributed spatial and geographic data.
• Thematic Mapping: Create data pipelines to enrich traditional mapping systems with real-time semantic context.
• Demo Development: Produce fully functional solution to demonstrate viability of concepts or new model abilities.

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Person Specification:

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• AI & Machine Learning: Strong experience working with LLMs, foundation models, or multimodal AI architectures.
• Data Experience: Solid understanding of geospatial data, vector embeddings, or semantic search.
• Edge Computing: Familiarity with running models under local hardware constraints (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, CoreML).
• Programming Proficiency: Advanced skills in orchestration frameworks such as: Pydantic AI, AutoGen, or LangGraph.
• Education: Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

description:

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.


Night Crew Supervisor Position Purpose

The Night Crew Supervisor is responsible for overseeing overnight stocking operations and leading the night crew to ensure merchandise is stocked, displayed, and available for customers when the store opens. This position supports operational excellence by maintaining inventory accuracy, productivity standards, safety compliance, and store presentation while providing leadership, training, and development to overnight associates.

  • Supervise nightly stocking and replenishment activities throughout the store.
  • Coordinate workflow to ensure all assigned freight is stocked accurately and efficiently.
  • Monitor department priorities and adjust assignments as needed to meet operational goals.
  • Ensure merchandise is stocked according to company merchandising standards and planograms.
  • Verify aisles, displays, and promotional locations are properly set and maintained.
Inventory & Product Availability
  • Help maintain accurate inventory levels through proper stocking and rotation practices.
  • Monitor out-of-stock conditions and communicate product concerns to store management.
  • Support inventory counts, audits, and other inventory-control processes.
  • Assist in reducing shrink through proper merchandise handling and stock control procedures.
Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead, coach, and support night crew associates to achieve productivity and service goals.
  • Train associates on stocking procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.
  • Assign work responsibilities and monitor completion of assigned tasks.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, and a positive work environment.
  • Provide feedback and performance coaching as needed.

title: Journalists – Open Justice
description:
YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:

We are looking for talented and passionate Multimedia Journalists to join NZME's successful Open Justice - Te Pātiti team.

An open and transparent legal system is one of the hallmarks of a well-functioning democracy. As a court reporter, you become the public's eyes and ears, playing a vital role in shining a light on the judicial process.

We have a specialised team of ringfenced Open Justice reporters based throughout the country. We now have several vacancies and are looking to base people in Tauranga and Hawke’s Bay - but we’re flexible on people working from our other locations such as Whanganui, Gisborne or Palmerston North.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT:

As part of the Open Justice team, you'll produce impactful multimedia content for NZME's extensive digital and print platforms, including the New Zealand Herald, Newstalk ZB, and regional mastheads. Your work will also feature on Radio New Zealand, Top South Media, Whakaata Māori, and Allied Media through our content partnerships.

You'll cover a mix of stories for multiple news cycles - shorter daily stories (including breaking news and coverage of hearings), features and long-term investigations. The key responsibilities include:

  • Covering a full range of courts and tribunals: Civil and criminal; employment and environment; human rights and immigration, and many more.

  • Producing agenda-setting journalism that explains the "why" as much as the "what".

  • Holding lawmakers to account.

  • Championing the rights of everyone involved in the system.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM:

  • You'll have a Journalism qualification and at least 2+ years of newsroom experience, ideally with a background in court reporting.

  • You'll hold a track record in identifying stories of significant public interest and telling them in an engaging and innovative way.

  • You'll have a good working knowledge of ever-evolving legal issues and the ability to converse with experts in a complex field. Training will also be provided in this area, but a knowledge of media law and the rules around court reporting is preferred.

  • You'll be able to develop contacts, navigate the complexities of gathering information from the judicial system and be confident arguing for reporting rights in a courtroom environment.

  • While basic knowledge of audio and video editing techniques would be an advantage, training is available.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

NZME is committed to the ongoing development of journalists working in this specialised area. We're particularly passionate about devolving knowledge and skills to regional hubs.

NZME provides a safe, inclusive, and diverse working environment. We are committed to developing our understanding of the principles of Te Tiriti o Waitangi and embedding them in all aspects of our work.

You'll enjoy a range of benefits including complimentary NZ Herald Premium, VIVA Premium and BusinessDesk subscriptions, wellbeing support and counselling services, professional development opportunities, recognition programmes, exclusive staff discounts, and access to tickets through NZME's event network.

LOCATION AND CONTRACT:

Our primary vacancies are based in Tauranga and Hawke's Bay. That said, we're open to candidates based in Gisborne, Palmerston North, or Whanganui — so if that's you, we'd still love to hear from you.

This is a fixed term contract ending December 2027. However the contract may be renewed or extended if NZ on Air funding continues.

WORKING RIGHTS:

All applicants will be asked about their working rights in New Zealand. Examples include citizen, resident, visa holder, or requiring visa sponsorship.

title: Nurses
description:
Senior Nurse – Nursing Home

Job Summary

We are looking for a compassionate and experienced Senior Nurse to join our nursing home team in Castleford, GB. In this on-site role, you will deliver high-quality, person-centred care to residents while supporting colleagues and upholding the highest standards of clinical practice. If you are a caring nurse who wants to make a real difference in residents' daily lives, we would love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver safe, compassionate, person-centred nursing care to residents, respecting their dignity, privacy, and individual preferences.
  • Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate individual care plans, adapting them as residents' needs change.
  • Administer medication accurately and safely in line with current regulations, policies, and best practice, and maintain precise records.
  • Monitor residents' health and wellbeing, recognise signs of deterioration, and respond promptly with appropriate clinical action or escalation.
  • Lead and support care staff on shift by delegating tasks, offering guidance, and promoting a positive, collaborative team environment.
  • Collaborate with GPs, allied health professionals, and other external services to ensure coordinated, effective care.
  • Communicate sensitively and clearly with residents, families, and carers, providing updates and emotional support, including during end-of-life care.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential clinical documentation, and uphold safeguarding, infection prevention, and health and safety standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Current registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC) as a Registered Nurse.
  • Significant post-registration experience as a nurse, ideally within a nursing home, residential care, or older people's care setting, in keeping with a senior-level role.
  • Sound knowledge of clinical care for older adults, including long-term conditions, mobility, nutrition, wound care, and medication management.
  • Understanding of safeguarding principles, consent, and the Mental Capacity Act.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a genuinely caring and respectful approach.
  • Right to work in the UK.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supervising, mentoring, or leading care teams or acting as a shift lead.
  • Experience supporting residents living with dementia, and with palliative and end-of-life care.
  • Additional training or qualifications in areas such as venepuncture, catheter care, PEG feeding, or tissue viability.
  • Familiarity with CQC standards and inspection requirements.
  • Experience contributing to quality improvement, audits, or care planning reviews.

Technical Skills

Clinical Skills

  • Comprehensive resident assessment and care planning.
  • Safe medication administration and management.
  • Wound care, pressure ulcer prevention, and infection control.
  • Recognition and management of acute changes in condition.
  • Palliative and end-of-life care.

Professional and Administrative Skills

  • Accurate record-keeping using electronic or paper care documentation systems.
  • Clear handover and reporting.
  • Time management and prioritisation in a busy care environment.
  • Team leadership, delegation, and conflict resolution.
  • Compassion, patience, and emotional resilience.

About the Role

This is a senior position in a nursing home setting, based on-site in Castleford, GB. Remote work is not available. The salary is competitive and will reflect your experience and qualifications. As a Senior Nurse, you will be a trusted clinical presence for residents, families, and colleagues alike.

Application Information

If you are a caring Senior Nurse who would love to join our team, we invite you to apply. Please submit your up-to-date CV, including your NMC registration details and a summary of your relevant nursing experience. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the next steps. Appointment will be subject to the usual pre-employment checks, including references, right to work verification, and relevant background checks.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and are committed to equal opportunities in our recruitment process.

title: Clinical Applications Specialist – Dental IOS Trainer
description:
Clinical Applications Specialist – Dental IOS Trainer

Remote – United States
Independent Contractor (1099), subject to classification review
Live Virtual Training
Schedule: Assignment-Based
Start Date: To Be Determined

Why Join Quest International?

Quest International is seeking an experienced dental professional to support live virtual training for dental teams using SHINING 3D intraoral scanning technology.

This is a contractor-based clinical training opportunity for someone who understands digital dentistry, has hands-on intraoral scanner experience, and enjoys teaching others how to use dental technology effectively.

The ideal candidate combines practical dental workflow knowledge with strong communication, presentation, and training skills.

What You’ll Do

Deliver Virtual Dental Training

Lead live virtual training sessions for dental assistants, hygienists, dentists, and other dental professionals.

Demonstrate Intraoral Scanning

Teach users how to operate approved intraoral scanner equipment and software, including:

  • Scan preparation

  • Scan acquisition

  • Scan review

  • Correcting missing scan areas

  • Digital impression workflow

  • Laboratory case transfer

Support Dental Workflows

Explain how intraoral scanning fits into everyday dental workflows and help users understand the proper sequence for completing and reviewing a digital case.

Troubleshoot Common User Issues

Help learners understand common scanner workflow problems, including lost scan tracking, incomplete scan areas, and basic user-level workflow issues.

Escalate advanced clinical or technical questions when appropriate.

Check Learner Understanding

Answer questions, review workflow steps, and confirm that learners understand how to perform the required tasks after training.

Document Training Activity

Maintain accurate records of completed training sessions, learner participation, questions requiring follow-up, and other required training documentation.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone with real hands-on intraoral scanning experience who can clearly explain dental workflows and teach others in a professional virtual environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience using an intraoral scanner in an actual dental environment.

  • Understanding of digital dental workflows from scanning through laboratory case transfer.

  • Experience training, teaching, coaching, onboarding, or demonstrating equipment to others.

  • Strong presentation, communication, and teaching skills.

  • Ability to conduct live virtual training using video, audio, screen sharing, and reliable internet.

  • Ability to demonstrate equipment and software clearly on camera when required.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate professionally with Quest International and training participants.

A college degree or dentist title is not required. Qualified dental assistants, hygienists, clinical educators, and other dental professionals with relevant hands-on experience are encouraged to apply.

Preferred Experience

Direct experience with one or more of the following is especially valuable:

  • SHINING 3D

  • Aoralscan

  • IntraoralScan

  • iTero

  • 3Shape TRIOS

  • Medit

  • CEREC

Direct SHINING 3D / Aoralscan experience is preferred.

Candidates with strong experience using other major intraoral scanning platforms may also be considered and may be required to complete product orientation before independently delivering training.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Dental IOS Trainers are able to:

  • Explain dental scanning workflows clearly and professionally.

  • Demonstrate intraoral scanner equipment and software.

  • Keep learners engaged during virtual instruction.

  • Identify and explain common scanning workflow issues.

  • Check learner understanding throughout each session.

  • Stay within the approved clinical and technical training scope.

  • Escalate questions appropriately when additional support is required.

  • Maintain professional and accurate training documentation.

Work Environment

This is primarily a remote, live virtual training assignment.

Candidates must have a professional virtual-training setup with reliable internet, audio, video, and screen-sharing capability.

Equipment, software access, demonstration models, and other technical requirements will be confirmed before assignments begin.

Onsite training or travel may occur only when separately agreed upon.

Contractor Engagement

This opportunity is intended as an independent contractor (1099) assignment, subject to final contractor-classification review.

Selected contractors may be required to complete a contractor agreement, Statement of Work, W-9 documentation, assignment-specific onboarding, product orientation, and technical-readiness review before beginning work.

Training volume, class length, frequency, preparation requirements, start dates, and other assignment terms will be confirmed before work begins.

No specific number of hours, training sessions, or assignments is guaranteed.

Compensation

Contractor rates will be determined based on experience, qualifications, training responsibilities, preparation requirements, and agreed assignment terms.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their:

  • Preparation rate, if applicable

  • General availability

  • State and time zone

Equal Opportunity

Quest International is committed to considering qualified candidates based on job-related experience, demonstrated ability, and the requirements of the assignment.

title: International Advocacy Advisor
description:
RFSL is seeking an International Advocacy Advisor to support Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists in advancing their advocacy priorities and influencing policy at national, regional and international levels. The role combines international advocacy, partnership development and capacity strengthening, with practical programme and administrative support that enables locally led movements to thrive.

About RFSL and our international work

RFSL (the Swedish Federation for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer, and Intersex Rights), founded in 1950, is one of the world’s oldest non-profit organisations working to advance LGBTQI rights.

RFSL’s international work supports LGBTQI movements in Eastern Europe, Asia and Africa through regranting, partnerships, knowledge exchange, organisational support and advocacy. We work closely with local partners to support locally led movements, strengthen their agency and influence, and contribute to enabling environments for LGBTQI rights at national, regional and global levels.

Your role with us

You will work closely with Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists to strengthen their ability to lead and influence advocacy processes. Together with partners, you will identify priorities, develop strategies and messaging, map stakeholders, and find opportunities to engage decision-makers and relevant international platforms, including the EU, UN, OSCE and Council of Europe.

A central part of the role is helping partners access the knowledge, networks, resources and practical support they need to pursue their priorities. This includes organising capacity-strengthening activities, managing scholarships and providing hands-on programme and administrative support. You will also contribute to advocacy efforts in Sweden related to Ukraine and work with RFSL colleagues to align policy, advocacy and communications.

You will collaborate with the Head of Program, International Program Managers, other Advocacy Advisors and colleagues across RFSL’s international work. The position is based in Stockholm and involves international travel several times per year.

Key responsibilities

  • Work with Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists to identify advocacy priorities, develop strategies and messaging, map stakeholders, and engage decision-makers and institutions.

  • Identify and develop opportunities for Ukrainian LGBTQI civil society to influence policy, including through relevant advocacy platforms and mechanisms within the EU, UN, OSCE, Council of Europe and other forums.

  • Strengthen partners’ capacity for independent advocacy by facilitating access to international spaces, knowledge, networks and strategic support, while centring their leadership and priorities.

  • Monitor and analyse political, legal and security developments in Ukraine with partners to identify advocacy opportunities and adapt approaches.

  • Plan and deliver capacity-strengthening activities, including training, workshops, peer learning, mentoring and networking, based on partners’ needs.

  • Manage scholarships and other partner support, including assessments, agreements, travel coordination, bookings, receipts, payments, documentation and follow-up in line with internal and donor requirements.

  • Contribute to RFSL’s policy, advocacy and communications work on Ukraine and LGBTQI rights, including coordinating relevant advocacy efforts in Sweden with colleagues and partners.

  • Collaborate with International Program Managers on programme planning, partner support, monitoring, evaluation and learning (PMEL), funding applications, donor reporting and documentation of results.

  • Participating in relevant internal and external meetings, unit-wide and cross-organisational processes, and RFSL’s federation-wide activities and events.

Who are you?

You are a structured, collaborative and solution-oriented professional committed to LGBTQI rights, international advocacy and locally led movement strengthening. You understand Ukraine’s political and social context, the regional human rights and civil society landscape, and the challenges facing LGBTQI organisations working in politically sensitive or resource-constrained environments.

You build trusted partnerships and adapt your approach to different organisations, particularly grassroots groups that may need substantial practical support alongside strategic guidance. You respect local leadership and autonomy, understand power dynamics in international partnerships, and approach your work with awareness of security, safeguarding and the importance of accountable support.

You enjoy combining strategic advocacy and capacity strengthening with practical operational and administrative tasks. You are comfortable moving between developing advocacy strategies and organising activities, coordinating travel, booking accommodation, handling receipts and ensuring that payments and documentation are in order. You recognise that this hands-on support is an important part of enabling partners to advance their own priorities.

You bring strong analytical, communication and organisational skills, can represent RFSL professionally with civil society, public authorities and international institutions, and work effectively across teams and cultures. You are proactive, flexible and accountable, and share RFSL’s values of anti-racism, feminism, accessibility and intersectionality.

To succeed in this role, you need:

  • A strong commitment to LGBTQI rights and experience or demonstrated competence in advocacy, policy influence, civil society support or related human rights work, particularly in relation to Ukraine.

  • Strong knowledge of the human rights situation and civil society landscape in Ukraine or the wider region, including experience working in partnership with LGBTQI movements or organisations.

  • At least three years of relevant professional experience in advocacy, civil society support, development cooperation or a related field.

  • Experience engaging with international or regional advocacy processes and human rights mechanisms, such as those of the EU, UN, OSCE or Council of Europe.

  • An understanding of security and safeguarding considerations when working with LGBTQI activists and civil society in challenging contexts.

  • Strong analytical, organisational and administrative skills, including experience with organisational capacity assessment, budgets, programme documentation and risk management.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Some understanding of Ukrainian or a closely related language, together with a willingness to develop Ukrainian-language skills as needed.

  • The ability to work from Stockholm, Sweden, and undertake international travel several times per year.

Desirable qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in political science, international development, human rights, public administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Experience working in politically sensitive, repressive or shrinking civic spaces, including conflict- or war-affected contexts.

  • Knowledge of Swedish, or a willingness to learn it.

Employment terms

  • Employment type: This is a permanent position, starting with a six-month probationary period.

  • Location: RFSL office in Stockholm.

  • Start date: As agreed

  • Contract terms: Covered by the Collective Agreement for Nonprofit Organizations

Our offer

RFSL offers an inclusive, values-driven workplace where you can contribute to meaningful change alongside committed colleagues and partners. We provide competitive employment conditions, including occupational pension and parental benefits.

How to apply

Apply by November 15th, 2026. The recruitment process is conducted in English and includes anonymous, competency-based assessment, a work-related assignment and a background check.

For questions about the position or recruitment process, contact HR Partner Tobias Jensen at tobias.jensen@rfsl.se.

RFSL strives to be an inclusive, feminist and anti-racist workplace. We welcome applicants regardless of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, sex characteristics, religion, race, ethnicity, country of origin, disability, age or other grounds of discrimination. We strongly encourage candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply.

title: Store Director
description:
Albertsons' Northern California Market has an opening for a Store Director.

The Store Director is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the store. The Store Director has overall responsibility for the store operation and employees. The Store Director is responsible for making store-level decisions on hiring, training, disciplinary action, and scheduling. The Company expects the Store Director will spend more than half their time in directing others, managing the enterprise, and activities directly and closely related to those tasks and that anyone having difficulty doing will inform their District Manager and/or Human Resources so that additional training can be provided.

Responsibilities

  • Overall management responsibility for the operation of a retail grocery store. This includes but not limited to store performance, control of cash, inventory and security, customer service, and management of staff
  • Track, analyze and take action to improve store performance by forecasting of weekly/daily sales goals and meeting or exceeding established goals.
  • Communicate sales goals, department performance and sales opportunities with staff to ensure positive results
  • Forecast, schedule, and monitor labor to be consistent with store sales and productivity guidelines and wage budgets; create action plan to address cost control issues
  • Develop and direct the execution of strategies to improve product placement and appearance
  • Manage display accuracy and appearance to implement promotions. Ensure that products are properly displayed and ordered in a manner to maintain in-stock conditions.
  • Manage issues relating to store maintenance, cleanliness, safety and sanitation.
  • Oversee and manage handling of cash and accounting. Ensure store is secured.
  • Prioritize, plan, and coordinate work activities, and manage time and resources so that work objectives are timely met.
  • Ensure compliance with legal requirements and company policies and procedures, including money handling, check cashing, security, food safety, worker and customer safety, sanitation, consumer protection laws (e.g., recalls), accurate and timely payment of wages, etc.
  • Focus on customer satisfaction and needs, ensure that employees provide customers with superior customer service through use of best practices and training and coaching concerning the importance of superior customer service
  • Handle customer and employee complaints. Makes decisions to resolve all complaints in the best possible manner for the customer or employee and the business.
  • Select, train, develop, and manage job performance of store employees, with input from other management personnel; expected to effectively recommend hiring and disciplinary action up to and including termination.
  • Provide constructive suggestions and encouragement, set performance expectations, provide honest feedback, and identify assignments to provide others with developmental opportunities.
  • Maintain appropriate professional relationship with union officials, and ensure compliance with collective bargaining agreement provisions, if applicable.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with direct reports, peers, supervisors, suppliers, and customers effectively handling complex or difficult situations involving others.
  • Motivate others to perform the job and work towards common objectives. Comply with Company policies and procedures to serve as a role model to others instilling a positive attitude in others.
  • Responsible for ensuring the store is properly staffed to meet labor goals, sales goals, and customer needs. Takes a proactive approach to hiring and in engaged in what staff is needed to run an efficient operation.
  • Makes the final decision on hiring candidates, conducts interviews, and meets with prospective employees.
  • Ensures new hires are aware of all policies, procedures, and receive the proper/required training. Evaluates new hires, provides feedback, and makes final decision on a new hire’s eligibility to pass the probationary period.

Internal applicants must pass Store Director Selection (SDS) interview process prior to placement in the role.

title: Chief Storyteller & Community Officer
description:
About Introw

Introw is the #1 AI-native partner management platform. We are growing 5x year over year, signing multi-year enterprise contracts with some of the biggest logos in B2B SaaS, like Adyen, Factorial & Huntress. We raised $3M led by Visionaries VC, we serve hundreds of companies worldwide, and we hold a 4.9/5 rating across 100s of reviews.

We run inside HubSpot and Salesforce, so partner teams manage their whole program without leaving the CRM, and their partners work where they already are: Slack, Teams, email, and AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. Globally leading companies run partnerships, their best-performing channel, on Introw.

Partnerships is a people business. The best partner leaders learn from each other, share what works, and show up for each other.

Now we want a storyteller and community builder to make Introw the place where that happens. This is not a “post three times a week” role. You will find the stories worth telling, build a community partner pros actually want to be part of, and use every growth hack in the book to get both in front of the right people.

If you love hypergrowth, building a community from scratch and articulating a narrative (in a fun way), keep on reading!

Tasks

As our storyteller and community manager, you own how the partnership world gets to know Introw:

  • Build out our community from scratch: partnership managers want to connect with each other. You will make that happen.
  • Own our newsletter and grow it into the must-read for partnership professionals: the trends, stories and voices shaping partnerships, in one place.
  • Map the influencers and thought leaders in partnerships, build real relationships with them, and turn them into friends of Introw.
  • Run PR, partner and influencer marketing: co-created content, podcasts, guest sessions, media coverage, and campaigns that put Introw in front of new audiences.
  • Stay close to what’s trending in partnerships and join the conversations with industry voices, creators and peers.
  • Make our meetups, roundtables, webinars, and event moments bigger, better, and more memorable.
  • Run growth experiments to grow brand awareness and pipeline: viral loops, community-led campaigns, and the hacks nobody tried yet.
  • Track what works, kill what doesn’t, and double down on what grows.
  • Work shoulder to shoulder with marketing, product, sales, and customer success to turn community energy into pipeline.

Requirements

You’re an A-player. You want your fingerprints on a category-defining brand, and a mediocre bar bores you. The following should be how your friends describe you:

  • A natural storyteller. You spot the hooks that grab people’s attention and craft stories that inspire.
  • A community builder. You’ve grown a community, a group, or an audience before, and you know it starts with giving, not asking.
  • A strategist who executes. You can write the community plan and you’re the first one to roll up your sleeves to make it happen.
  • An optimizer. You look at what’s already running and see how to make it twice as good.
  • A connector. You love reaching out to people you don’t know yet, and influencers reply to you.
  • A growth hacker. Scrappy, creative, and fast. You’d rather run ten small experiments than write one big plan.
  • 3+ years in marketing, community, PR, or partnerships, ideally in B2B SaaS. We care about the bar you hold more than years on paper.
  • A people person. You love events, real conversations, and getting strangers to talk to each other.
  • Analytical enough. You know your numbers and let the data tell you what to do next.
  • Keen to learn agentic workflows and use AI to do in a day what used to take a week.
  • Excellent written English. Dutch or French is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • A strong network in the partnerships, channel, or B2B SaaS space.
  • Experience growing a newsletter or running PR, influencer or creator programs.
  • Familiarity with partnerships, channel sales, or CRMs like HubSpot or Salesforce.

Benefits

How we work: we are a small, senior team that plays to win and hires A-players who want real ownership.

  • You own your area. High trust, high autonomy, no hand-holding.
  • Craft is the point. We sweat the details and hold a high bar.
  • We move fast. Decisions in hours, not weeks.
  • We are ambitious. We are here to win the category globally, growing 4 to 5x a year.

What you get:

  • A Macbook and iPhone, fully set up for you.
  • Fully paid phone subscription.
  • Healthcare plan.
  • Mobility budget.
  • Meal vouchers.
  • Introw merch.
  • Regular team drinks and events, plus global travel to industry events.
  • A real seat at a fast growing, well-funded, globally winning company where your work ships and gets seen.
  • Optional: Equity

Ready to grow the community at the heart of partnerships? If you want to own community, PR and influencer marketing at a category leader, we want to meet you.

Apply with the button on this page.

What to expect: a quick intro call, a deep dive on your past work, a short exercise where you sharpen one of our current community activities, and time with the team.

title: Talent Acquistion Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Lead the Talent Acquisition Function

  • Lead and manage the overall Talent Acquisition function, including Team A and Team B.

  • Set clear recruitment priorities, responsibilities and performance expectations for each team.

  • Review team and individual performance regularly, identify gaps and coach team members to improve.

  • Build healthy competition between teams through clear, fair and transparent measures.

  • Ensure both teams follow consistent recruitment standards, processes and service expectations.

  • Identify recruitment capacity needs and recommend improvements to the team structure and workflow.

Deliver Recruitment for UpGrowth and Clients

  • Oversee end-to-end recruitment for internal hiring and client assignments.

  • Translate hiring requirements into clear job briefs, sourcing plans and recruitment timelines.

  • Guide the team on sourcing, screening, interviewing, shortlisting, interview coordination, offer management and onboarding follow-up.

  • Monitor open vacancies, ageing roles, candidate pipelines and placement progress.

  • Step in to support complex, urgent or senior-level searches when needed.

  • Ensure recruitment recommendations are based on role fit, capability and evidence.

Manage Client Service and Commercial Results

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients and their designated HR contacts.

  • Clarify hiring requirements, service scope, timelines, decision-making responsibilities and charges arrangements at the start of each assignment.

  • Keep clients informed of progress, challenges, market feedback and next steps.

  • Manage client expectations professionally and raise risks early when a role or timeline may be affected.

  • Monitor recruitment service delivery and contribute to client retention and business growth.

  • Work with the Founder and relevant teams to identify additional recruitment opportunities.

Manage Recruitment Sales, Forecasts and Budgets

  • Maintain an accurate sales pipeline covering new enquiries, confirmed assignments, active vacancies, expected placements and completed placements.

  • Prepare recruitment revenue forecasts using realistic assumptions, including vacancy status, expected placement dates, agreed charges and likelihood of success.

  • Track sales achieved against forecast and explain material changes, delays or risks.

  • Maintain complete and accurate recruitment sales records, including client, candidate, role, charges, placement, and invoice details.

  • Liaise with the Founder’s EA and Finance team to prepare and reconcile recruitment sales reports.

  • Ensure placement and charges information is submitted promptly and accurately to support invoicing and financial reporting.

  • Monitor agreed recruitment budgets, including sourcing costs, job advertisements, recruitment tools and other approved expenses.

  • Identify overspending or cost risks early and seek approval before committing unbudgeted expenditure.

  • Follow up with relevant teams on invoice status and payment updates when required, and flag outstanding items or discrepancies.

Improve Process, Reporting and Governance

  • Track key measures such as time to shortlist, time to fill, interview-to-offer conversion, placement success, agreeable-period outcomes, sales performance and client satisfaction.

  • Use recruitment and sales data to identify bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements.

  • Maintain accurate recruitment records and ensure candidate and client information is handled confidentially.

  • Ensure the team follows approved processes, client communication arrangements and company requirements.

Other Duties

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Founder from time to time.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business or a related field.

  • At least 5 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.

  • At least 2 years of experience leading or supervising a recruitment team.

  • Experience managing multiple vacancies and working with clients or hiring managers.

  • Good understanding of recruitment revenue, placement fees, sales forecasting, budget

  • monitoring and business reporting.

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to maintain accurate records and explain variances.

  • Experience using spreadsheets, recruitment systems and reporting tools.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, coaching and problem-solving skills.

  • Commercial awareness and the ability to balance delivery quality, timelines, costs and service

  • fees.

  • Able to manage changing priorities while keeping clients and the team updated.

What Success Looks Like

  • Both teams deliver against clear and fair performance expectations.

  • Vacancies are managed proactively, with timely shortlists and clear progress updates.

  • Recruitment sales forecasts and reports are timely, accurate and supported by complete records.

  • Recruitment expenditure is monitored against approved budgets.

  • The EA and Finance team receive the information they need to prepare and reconcile sales reports.

  • Clients receive consistent, professional recruitment support.

  • The function improves its placement results, client retention and contribution to UpGrowth’s growth.

The Mindset That Fits UpGrowth

Ownership : You take responsibility from instruction to completion.

Proactiveness : You anticipate what is needed and act before matters become urgent.

Clarity : You communicate updates, risks and next steps in a simple and timely way.

Resourcefulness : You investigate, propose solutions and keep moving when information is incomplete.

Accountability : You follow up respectfully but firmly and do not allow commitments to disappear.

Growth mindset : You welcome feedback, learn quickly and continuously improve how work gets done.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer - Belgrade
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer - Belgrade

We are looking for a passionate Senior Engineer who wants to join our growing Belgrade team, helping us to transform and scale our payments platform.

As a Senior team member you will have influence with technical direction, work collaboratively with stakeholders and drive high standards for code quality and performance. Our mission is simple: we’re simplifying global business - so businesses thrive wherever they choose to grow. We deliver services across:

• Global payments and receivables

• Foreign Exchange (FX)

• Treasury management

• Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America, backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide.

Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we’re building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

title: Workers' Compensation Claims Associate
description:
Overview

Good Things Start Here.

Good things are happening at Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies—an A+ (Superior) rated, nationwide Property & Casualty insurer backed by Berkshire Hathaway. With supportive leadership, collaborative teams, and opportunities to grow, GUARD is a place where people build meaningful, long‑term careers.

Good Things You Can Count On.

  • Hybrid schedule: 2 days remote / 3 in‑office
  • Predictable hours (no nights, weekends, or holidays)
  • Competitive pay + generous PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision starting day one
  • 401(k), tuition reimbursement & longevity bonuses

Responsibilities

Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies is hiring entry-level Workers' Compensation Claims Adjusters. This is a great opportunity to start a career in insurance and claims. No prior Workers' Compensation claims handling experience is required.

You'll participate in a structured training program designed to teach you the fundamentals of Workers' Compensation claims handling, including claims evaluation, compensability, medical management, benefit delivery, and return-to-work practices. As you build your knowledge and experience, you'll help injured workers navigate their recovery while developing the skills needed for a career in claims.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with employers, injured workers, medical providers, and other parties throughout the claim process.

This role may be based out of the following office locations: Wilkes‑Barre, PA or Scottsdale, AZ.

Unauthorized recording, transcription, AI note-taking, or AI interview assistance tools may not be used during interviews without prior approval.

title: Plumbing Field Supervisor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Absolute Airflow, a Lee's Air, Plumbing & Heating Company, is hiring a Plumbing Field Supervisor to run the plumbing sales supervisor model we use in Fresno. This is not an entry-level role.

In this model, our plumbing service technicians diagnose and complete repairs, and turn larger opportunities — replacements, repipes, sewer and drain line work, water heaters, and system upgrades — over to the Plumbing Field Supervisor. You meet with the homeowner, walk them through what the technician found, present repair and replacement options, and help them choose the right solution for their home.

You work alongside the technicians in the field, back them up on in-home presentations, and help them get better at spotting and presenting options to homeowners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Present repair and replacement options to homeowners

• Educate homeowners about their plumbing systems so they can make informed decisions

• Review the technician's diagnosis and recommend solutions that fit the home and the customer's needs

• Coach and develop the plumbing technicians you work with on presenting options

• Follow up on open estimates and turned-over leads in ServiceTitan

• Work toward sales goals set by the VP of Sales and General Manager

• Arrive in uniform in a branded company truck; this role does not perform plumbing repairs on the job

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• At least 2 years of professional plumbing experience

• Ability to diagnose plumbing problems and recommend solutions

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Strong customer communication and an outgoing personality

• Dependability, a strong work ethic, and pride in clean, professional work

• Willingness to coach others and keep developing your own skills

• In-home or residential sales experience a plus

• Valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record

BENEFITS

• 401(k) with a 4% company match

• Company truck, fuel card, company phone, and tablet

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Life insurance

• Paid time off

• Employee discount

• Ongoing customer service, sales, and professional development training

title: Expert DevOps Engineer
description:
Forma zatrudnienia: umowa o pracę

Lokalizacja: ul. Sokolska 34, Katowice lubul. Puławska 2, Warszawa (2 dni w tygodniu pracujemy z biura)

Wynagrodzenie: 23 000 - 27 000 zł brutto

O zespole:

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego i utrzymującego podwozie banku. W zespole zajmujemy się rozwiązaniami odpowiedzialnymi za komunikacje między aplikacjami bankowymi. Tu tu mamy bankową Kafkę, tworzymy bankowy service mesh i portal do jego zarządzania. Działamy tak w chmurze GCP jak i w rozwiązaniach onPrem. Zespół składa się z DevOpsów opiekujących rozwiązania od początku do końca. Działamy w Agile z częstymi wdrożeniami i automatyzacją procesów CI/CD. Naszym mottem jest stabilność i wydajność.

Twoje zadania:

Mile widziane

To oferujemy:

  • - Pakiet medyczny, ubezpieczenie na życie, platformę Mindgram, Pracowniczy Program Emerytalny i Program Profilaktyki Onkologicznej
  • - Karty sportowe (Medicover Sport i Multisport) i kafeterię benefitową na punkty

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Make Your Mark:

You’ll Get To:

Get to Know Us

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they're doing! At BlackLine, we're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business of enterprise applications.

Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.

Being a best-in-class SaaS company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting-edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.

This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash (I2C) solution, a market-leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.

Work, Play and Grow at BlackLine!

Make Your Mark

As a Senior Data Engineer in our growing Business Intelligence & Analytics Engineering team in Krakow, you will be a core hands‑on builder of the data platform behind a mission‑critical, AI‑powered SaaS product. You will design and deliver the pipelines, models, and reports that our customers and internal teams rely on to make decisions worth millions of dollars - and you will do it to a high engineering bar, with modern tooling, alongside a talented team you help to grow.

You will build how data flows from our transactional systems into Snowflake , model it for reliability and performance, and surface it as trusted, actionable insight through Power BI . Working closely with our Staff engineers, Manager, and Product partners, you will take ownership of well‑scoped areas of the platform, raise the quality bar through the work you deliver, and grow toward technical leadership. As a forward‑thinking engineer in our mission to deliver autonomous finance, you will use modern AI development tools like Claude and Cursor to accelerate delivery and sharpen quality across the data platform.

You’ll Get To

  • Build and Govern Data Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain robust ELT/ETL pipelines that reliably move and transform data from operational systems (microservices, event streams, third‑party sources) into well‑modelled, analytics‑ready datasets in Snowflake.
  • Deliver Trusted Analytics with Power BI: Develop enterprise‑grade Power BI reports and dashboards for both internal stakeholders and customer‑facing analytics, building semantic models, row‑level security, and a governed BI layer that people trust.
  • Contribute to the Data Platform Architecture: Help shape and evolve our end‑to‑end data architecture on Snowflake - from ingestion and transformation to serving - and deliver your areas of it so the platform stays scalable, cost‑efficient, and reliable.
  • Champion Modern Data Modelling: Apply best‑in‑class transformation practices, producing modular, well‑tested, and documented data models that the whole team can build on.
  • Champion AI‑Accelerated Development: Use and promote agentic development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to accelerate pipeline development, query optimization, and documentation - and help teammates adopt the same mindset.
  • Build in Data Quality and Observability: Bake data quality frameworks, automated testing, and monitoring into the pipelines you build, catching data issues before they reach customers or business decisions.
  • Grow and Share Your Craft: Raise the bar through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing on data modelling, Snowflake optimization, and BI best practices, and grow toward broader technical leadership over time.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Finance stakeholders to understand data needs, translate them into reliable data products, and communicate platform capabilities and constraints clearly.

Technical / Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong hands‑on experience with Snowflake, including data modelling, performance tuning, cost optimization, clustering or dynamic tables, and Snowflake‑native security and governance features.
  • Solid Power BI proficiency: building semantic models (DAX, Power Query), enterprise report design, row‑level security, incremental refresh, and working with the Power BI service.
  • Proven experience building and operating production ELT/ETL pipelines using tools such as dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
  • Expert‑level SQL and working knowledge of at least one general‑purpose language (Python preferred) for data processing and automation.
  • Demons

title: Junior Backend / Fullstack Developer (Java) – Azure IoT (kontraktor)
description:
Kim jesteśmy?

Jesteśmy ITSG Global, firmą software’ową, która od 2007 roku tworzy i rozwija rozwiązania technologiczne dla międzynarodowych klientów. Realizujemy projekty m.in. w obszarze systemów backendowych, platform IoT, rozwiązań chmurowych oraz AI.

Obecnie poszukujemy developera do współpracy przy rozwoju platformy przemysłowego IoT i budowanych na niej rozwiązań dla klientów. To rola dla osoby z kilkuletnim doświadczeniem, która na co dzień pracuje z AI i chce rozwijać się w obszarze chmury oraz IoT w dojrzałym, produkcyjnym środowisku.

O projekcie:

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego platformę przemysłowego IoT opartą na Azure oraz portfolio rozwiązań budowanych na niej dla kilkunastu klientów przemysłowych z regionu DACH, m.in. producentów maszyn, bram i urządzeń. Platforma zbiera dane telemetryczne z urządzeń w terenie, przetwarza je i udostępnia w aplikacjach do monitorowania oraz zarządzania flotą urządzeń.

Backend platformy i większości projektów klientów powstaje w Javie (Spring Boot), z częścią usług i testów w Kotlinie. Frontend tworzymy w TypeScript i React.

Pracujemy w podejściu AI-first. Agenci AI i asystenci kodowania pomagają nam pisać kod, testy i analizować problemy. Przede wszystkim jednak pozwalają szybko wchodzić w nowe obszary: nieznaną technologię, nowy fragment systemu czy problem, z którym ktoś mierzy się pierwszy raz. AI jest dla nas narzędziem, które przyspiesza naukę i pracę. Nie zastępuje zrozumienia. Odpowiedzialność za jakość kodu, który trafia na produkcję, zawsze leży po stronie developera.

Zakres zadań w projekcie

  • Rozwój usług backendowych w Javie i Spring Boot, zarówno w rdzeniu platformy, jak i w projektach klientów.
  • Implementacja przetwarzania danych z urządzeń w architekturze opartej na zdarzeniach (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).
  • Pisanie testów automatycznych (jednostkowych i integracyjnych) jako stały element realizowanych zadań, również w Kotlinie.
  • Udział w code review i doprowadzanie zmian do środowiska produkcyjnego.
  • Praca z kontenerami (Docker) i usługami Azure.
  • Aktualizacje zależności i rozwój starszych komponentów, w tym migracje do nowszych wersji Javy i Spring Boot.
  • Realizacja zadań w obszarach, które są dla Ciebie nowe, w tym we frontendzie w TypeScript/React. AI wspiera Cię w szybkim wejściu w temat, a Ty oceniasz i bierzesz odpowiedzialność za jakość rozwiązania.
  • Analiza i naprawa błędów w rozwiązaniach działających w środowisku produkcyjnym.

Oczekiwane kompetencje:

  • Minimum 2 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w tworzeniu usług backendowych w Javie i Spring Boot.
  • Codzienna praca z narzędziami AI wspierającymi programowanie (np. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot). Ważne jest dla nas, żebyś wykorzystywał(a) AI do szybkiego wchodzenia w nowe technologie i problemy, niezależnie od języka.
  • Umiejętność krytycznej oceny kodu wygenerowanego przez AI: czy jest poprawny, czytelny, bezpieczny, pasuje do architektury i jest odpowiednio przetestowany.
  • Doświadczenie z usługami chmury Azure.
  • Praktyczna znajomość Dockera i Linux.
  • Pisanie testów automatycznych jako naturalna część pracy (JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ; Testcontainers mile widziany).
  • Znajomość SQL i pracy z relacyjną bazą danych (np. PostgreSQL, Hibernate).
  • Znajomość TypeScript na poziomie pozwalającym zrozumieć i ocenić kod frontendowy. Nie oczekujemy specjalizacji, ale też nie traktujemy TS jako czegoś, co „wygeneruje się samo”.
  • Znajomość Git i podstaw CI/CD.
  • Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie.

Mile widziane:

  • Doświadczenie w IoT. To dla nas mocny plus, szczególnie przy pracy z Azure IoT Hub, MQTT lub systemami obsługującymi floty urządzeń.
  • Znajomość Kotlina lub chęć pracy z nim (dużą część testów piszemy w Kotlinie).
  • Doświadczenie z Kafką lub innym systemem kolejkowym (np. Event Hubs, Service Bus).
  • Znajomość Azure Data Explorer (Kusto), Container Apps lub Kubernetes.
  • Doświadczenie z React.
  • Znajomość narzędzi do monitoringu (np. Grafana, Prometheus, Micrometer).
  • Znajomość języka niemieckiego.

Warunki współpracy projektowej:

  • Stawka: 90–130 PLN/h + VAT (B2B) w zależności od doświadczenia.
  • Możliwość realizacji współpracy 100% zdalnie, hybrydowo lub z biura w Warszawie.
  • Długoterminowa współpraca przy produkcyjnej platformie przemysłowego IoT, z kontraktami klientów planowanymi na kolejne lata.
  • Współpraca w zespole, w którym AI jest codziennym narzędziem pracy, z dostępem do nowoczesnych narzędzi i przestrzenią do dzielenia się praktykami ich wykorzystania.
  • Współpraca z doświadczonymi specjalistami inżynierskimi, od których można się dużo nauczyć.
  • Możliwość rozwoju kompetencji w obszarze chmury Azure, architektury event-driven i IoT.
  • Dodatkowo: możliwość korzystania z lekcji języka angielskiego, karty MultiSport, prywatnej opieki medycznej, wydarzeń integracyjnych, budżetu szkoleniowego oraz inicjatyw rozwojowych.

Proces rekrutacji:

  • Rozmowa telefoniczna z Rekruterem.
  • Rozmowa z Hiring Managerem.
  • Rozmowa techniczna.

Kontakt: nkijek@itsg.com.pl

title: Nordic Business Manager - Medhouse
description:
Are you a commercially driven Life Science professional with a strong network and a passion for building strategic customer relationships? Join Medhouse as our Nordic Business Manager and play a key role in driving business development, strengthening customer partnerships and accelerating growth across the Nordic region.

About Medhouse

Medhouse is a Nordic Life Science partner supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical technology companies with commercial expertise, people and innovative business solutions.

Our services include commercial outsourcing, interim management, recruitment, executive search and digital commercial solutions. As we continue to grow, we are strengthening our ability to serve customers consistently across the Nordic region and develop new business opportunities.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a commercially driven Nordic Business Manager to take ownership of selected Nordic customer relationships and assignments, while supporting new business development and growth across our four markets.

The role combines strategic account development with hands-on customer engagement. Working closely with Country Managers and local teams, you will coordinate cross-border customer relationships, identify opportunities to expand existing partnerships and help win new business. The focus is commercial growth and customer value.

Key Responsibilities

Nordic Business Manager

  • Own and develop selected Nordic key accounts, serving as the primary Nordic relationship lead and coordinating with local account owners.

  • Build trusted relationships with regional and Nordic decision-makers at pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical technology companies.

  • Develop account plans that identify customer needs, growth opportunities, stakeholders and priorities across markets.

  • Coordinate commercial follow-up for Nordic customer assignments to ensure consistent communication, strong customer satisfaction and opportunities for contract extensions or expansion.

  • Identify and pursue cross-selling opportunities across Medhouse services and Nordic markets.

  • Lead or coordinate Nordic account reviews, customer meetings, proposals and framework agreement discussions in collaboration with Country Managers.

Nordic Business Development & Growth

  • Generate new business opportunities through an established Life Science network and proactive prospecting.

  • Support Country Managers in developing strategic prospects, customer meetings, tenders, proposals and commercial negotiations.

  • Identify Nordic and cross-border opportunities for commercial outsourcing, interim management, recruitment, executive search and digital services.

  • Develop relationships with regional procurement, commercial and functional leaders to position Medhouse as a preferred Nordic partner.

  • Translate customer needs into commercially attractive solutions together with local teams and relevant service experts.

  • Maintain a clear view of account opportunities and contribute to sales pipeline development and revenue growth.

Nordic Customer Collaboration

  • Work closely with Country Managers to align Nordic account strategies with local market priorities and responsibilities.

  • Coordinate customer-facing activities across countries to provide a joined-up Nordic customer experience.

  • Share relevant customer insights, market intelligence and successful commercial approaches across the Nordic sales organisation.

  • Support the development of compelling Nordic value propositions and customer presentations.

Your Profile

Experience & Qualifications

  • Solid commercial experience within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical technology or the broader Life Science sector.

  • An established network of Life Science contacts, ideally spanning more than one Nordic market.

  • Demonstrated experience in key account management, business development, strategic sales or commercial partnerships.

  • Ability to navigate complex customer organisations and build relationships with senior decision-makers.

  • Experience coordinating multi-market customers, assignments or commercial projects is an advantage.

  • Understanding of consulting, commercial outsourcing or other Life Science service models is an advantage.

  • P&L responsibility or previous country management experience is not required.

Personal Characteristics

  • Commercially ambitious, proactive and motivated by measurable customer and business growth.

  • Excellent relationship-builder with a consultative, customer-focused approach.

  • Structured and reliable in managing several accounts and opportunities simultaneously.

  • Collaborative and diplomatic, able to work effectively with Country Managers and local teams.

  • Hands-on, entrepreneurial and comfortable turning opportunities into concrete actions.

  • Curious about customer challenges and skilled at connecting needs with solutions.

Language & Location

  • Excellent English communication skills.

  • Fluency in Swedish or another Scandinavian language; understanding of Danish and Norwegian is desirable.

  • Finnish language skills are an advantage.

  • Based in a Nordic capital city, with flexibility for the right candidate and willingness to travel regularly.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6–12 months, the successful candidate will have:

  • Established ownership of an agreed portfolio of Nordic key accounts, with clear account plans and customer stakeholder maps.

  • Built strong working relationships with Country Managers and relevant customer decision-makers across the Nordic region.

  • Created a qualified pipeline of new Nordic and cross-border business opportunities.

  • Supported successful proposals, customer expansions or new assignments that contribute to revenue growth.

  • Improved commercial coordination and customer experience for selected Nordic accounts.

Company: Medhouse
Location: Nordic capital city (with flexibility for the right candidate)
Geographical scope: Norway, Denmark, Finland and Sweden
Reporting to: Nordic Managing Director
Travel: Regular travel across the Nordic region

Why Join Medhouse?

Join a growing, entrepreneurial Nordic Life Science partner where you can make a direct commercial impact. You will work closely with experienced local teams, develop strategic customer relationships and help accelerate Medhouse’s next phase of Nordic growth.

Please feel free to contact krister.sandstrom@medhouse.se +46 70 535 98 62 or louise.jonsson@medhouse.se +46 72 085 05 53

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Associate, Absence Management
description:
Phillips 66 & YOU - Together we can fuel the future

As an Associate, Absence Management, you will help administer Phillips 66 disability benefits and time-off policies through accurate, timely, and consistent processing. You will support employees and business partners by maintaining reliable records, responding to routine questions, and helping ensure related payroll and timekeeping information is complete. This is an opportunity to build practical Human Resources experience while contributing to a team that delivers dependable support to the organization.

What You’ll Do

• Process assigned absence and disability administration activities, including Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Family and Medical Leave, and other leave programs, by following established procedures.

• Provide courteous, timely support to internal and external customers by responding to routine questions, complaints, and issues and directing matters as needed.

• Enter, verify, and maintain accurate payroll, timekeeping, absence, and related information in accordance with established requirements.

• Complete routine administrative tasks, filings, reports, and data checks, including disability and managed-absence reporting.

• Create, review, and update standard correspondence, communication materials, templates, and other documents for accuracy and completeness.

• Maintain organized, confidential files and records related to leave administration and retrieve information from company systems and filing repositories.

• Use standard office software, reporting tools, digital collaboration platforms, and related systems to support data entry, information retrieval, documentation, and routine analysis.

• Plan and prioritize detailed work to meet deadlines, communicate status, address errors, and support continuous improvements to leave-management processes and procedures.

What You’ll Bring - Required

• Legally authorized to work in the job posting country
