title: ITB Prosjektleder Veidekke Rogaland
description:
Veidekke Bygg Rogaland styrker satsingen på tekniske fag og søker en erfaren ITB-prosjektleder som vil ta en sentral rolle i våre prosjekter. Hos oss får du også være med på å videreutvikle arbeidet med tekniske fag.

Du blir et viktig bindeledd mellom de tekniske fagene og skal sikre at systemene fungerer sammen. Vi har allerede styrket laget innen elektro, ventilasjon og VVS. Nå søker vi deg som kan komplettere laget med solid ITB-kompetanse.

Hva får du ansvar for?

Som ITB-leder vil du jobbe tett med prosjektleder, prosjekteringsleder, tekniske entreprenører, rådgivere og byggherre. Du får ansvar for å skape helhet og sikre gode grensesnitt mellom blant annet elektro, VVS, ventilasjon og automasjon.

Dine viktigste oppgaver er:

  • Lede og koordinere ITB-arbeidet fra tidligfase til overlevering

  • Etablere og følge opp ITB-strategi, ITB-planer og grensesnittmatriser

  • Sikre funksjonskrav og godt samspill mellom de tekniske fagene

  • Følge opp tekniske entreprenører og rådgivere gjennom prosjektering og produksjon

  • Planlegge og lede integrerte tester, idriftsettelse og prøvedrift

  • Drive systematisk ferdigstillelse og sikre god FDV-leveranse

  • Bidra til å videreutvikle Veidekkes kompetanse og metodikk innen ITB

Vi ser spesielt etter deg som har:

  • Solid ITB-kompetanse og praktisk erfaring med ITB-ledelse eller ITB-koordinering i byggeprosjekter

  • Trygghet i å koordinere ulike fag, leverandører og interessenter

  • Erfaring med teknisk integrasjon i større eller komplekse byggeprosjekter

  • Erfaring med testing, idriftsettelse, prøvedrift og systematisk ferdigstillelse

  • God tverrfaglig forståelse innen elektro, VVS, ventilasjon og automasjon

  • Relevant teknisk utdanning, eksempelvis ingeniør- eller fagskoleutdanning

  • Kjennskap til NS 3935 og NS 6450

  • Erfaring med BIM og relevante digitale verktøy

Hvem er du?

Du trives i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi, struktur og samarbeid, og ser helheten samtidig som du har kontroll på detaljene.

Vi tror du er:

  • Er strukturert, tydelig og selvstendig

  • Skaper gode relasjoner og får ulike fag til å spille sammen

  • Identifiserer utfordringer tidlig og følger dem opp

  • Er løsnings- og resultatorientert

  • Trives med ansvar og har gjennomføringsevne

Hvorfor Veidekke?

Du får blant annet:

  • Spennende og komplekse byggeprosjekter i Rogaland

  • Stor påvirkning på prosjektets tekniske løsninger og sluttresultat

  • Et sterkt fagmiljø med kompetanse innen flere tekniske disipliner

  • Ansvar, tillit og gode utviklingsmuligheter

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og bonusordning

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Mulighet til å bli medeier gjennom Veidekkes aksjekjøpsordning

  • Tilgang til bedriftshytter, kunstforening og ulike sosiale aktiviteter

Arbeidssted vil være i våre lokaler i Jåttåvågen, og ute på våre pågående prosjekter i distriktet.

Vil du være med og sikre at teknikken ikke bare blir bygget, men faktisk fungerer sammen? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Stillingen rapporterer til prosjektsjef for tekniske anlegg. For en uformell prat om stillingen ta kontakt med:

Aage Tengs - Forretningsutvikler - Tlf. 99222111.

Veidekke Bygg distrikt Rogaland dekker Stavanger og Haugesund fordelt med totalt ca. 170 ansatte funksjonærer og håndverkere. Våre satsingsområder er primært bolig i blokk, kontor, formålsbygg som skoler og helsehus, samt private næringsbygg. Kontorene våre er henholdsvis i Jåttåvågen i Stavanger og Kvaløygata i Haugesund.

Veidekke er en av Skandinavias største entreprenører. Selskapet utfører alle typer bygg- og anleggsoppdrag, vedlikeholder veier og produserer asfalt, pukk og grus. Involvering og lokalkunnskap kjennetegner virksomheten. Omsetningen er om lag 43 milliarder kroner, og nær halvparten av de 7 800 medarbeiderne eier aksjer i selskapet. Veidekke er notert på Oslo Børs og har siden starten i 1936 alltid gått med overskudd.

Stillingen inngår i Veidekke Bygg, som driver landsdekkende byggevirksomhet for private og offentlige kunder. Virksomheten bygger boliger, yrkesbygg, skoler og andre offentlige bygg. Årlig omsetning er NOK 15,3 milliarder (2025), og virksomheten har ca. 2 800 ansatte, hvorav 1 550 fagarbeidere og 1 250 funksjonærer.

Our Interview Process

We pride ourselves on having a fair but flexible recruitment process, we want to create a platform where you can show us your best. For us, keeping it simple means you can focus on understanding if our people, values and the work we do are right for you. Our typical process can be broken down into 3 stages;

  • Recruiter call: This normally lasts 15-30 minutes. We will talk to you about Answer Digital, the type of work we do, and an overview of the role. We’ll ask you some questions about your current situation and why you’re interested in working here. Here, we’d advise asking any “people” questions, anything about our culture, career progression or approach to flexible working.

  • Skills based interview: This interview will be with 2 people, normally from the team you’re applying to work with. We can do this stage remote or in person, whichever you’d prefer. This interview will involve questions around your experience, the skills you’ve gained and the work you’ve done. We’ll also ask questions about the role and challenges you might face and how you’d face them. Here, we’d recommend asking questions about the role, the day to day responsibilities and what life in the team is like.

  • Cultural/Value interview: This interview will be with 2 of our Leadership team, either our Directors or Capability Leads. It will focus on our culture and values, talking about our values and what they mean to us as well as understanding what values are important to you and how you like to work. This interview is about making sure Answer is right for you, as much as the other way around. Here, we advise you to ask as many questions around our business model, our ambitious growth plans and anything to do with Answer as a business.

description:

Dudek’s journey began in 1980 with a vision to serve Southern California’s water and wastewater agencies.

Today, we are a 100% employee-owned firm supporting clients nationwide and delivering projects that improve and protect the built and natural environments of communities throughout the United States. Who You Are

As an employee you embrace accountability, working safely, and collaboration while thinking resourcefully and independently.

Like all Dudekians, you are curious and solution-oriented, with the ability to adapt quickly to changes and approach challenges with a spirit of innovation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Dudek is seeking entry-level environmental professionals with limited consulting experience or university students who are looking to enter the environmental consulting field to provide as-needed field assistant services. This position will be based at project sites within California and is well-suited for individuals interested in gaining hands-on field experience. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience in the natural environment/outdoors either professionally, academically or recreationally, and an interest in learning to survey for and/or observe biological and aquatic resources in a natural environment.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Vill du arbeta med lösningsarkitektur i komplexa kundmiljöer där modern infrastruktur, automation, cloud och säkerhet möts? Vi söker en senior lösningsarkitekt som vill hjälpa våra kunder att designa hållbara, skalbara och tekniskt genomförbara lösningar, från behov och kravbild till arkitektur, implementation och vidareutveckling.

Din roll
Du blir en del av vårt team på Accelerate och arbetar i uppdrag hos marknadsledande kunder med digitalisering, modernisering och tekniska förändringsresor. Du arbetar nära verksamhet, utveckling, drift och säkerhet för att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken, inte bara i teorin.

I rollen bidrar du med arkitekturell höjd, teknisk förståelse och förmåga att hålla ihop helheten i komplexa miljöer. Du trivs i gränslandet mellan strategi och implementation och kan omsätta verksamhetsbehov, tekniska förutsättningar och krav till tydliga lösningsförslag, målarkitektur och genomförbara vägval.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Ta fram lösningsarkitektur för moderna plattformar, integrationslandskap och cloud- eller hybridmiljöer

  • Driva tekniska vägval och arkitekturella beslut tillsammans med verksamhet, utveckling, drift och säkerhet

  • Designa hållbara, skalbara och förvaltningsbara lösningar inom integration, automation och plattformsteknik

  • Leda workshops, kravdialoger och tekniska forum i komplexa kundmiljöer

  • Dokumentera målarkitektur, integrationsflöden, beroenden och tekniska vägval

  • Bidra i moderniseringar, migreringar och större transformationsinitiativ

  • Säkerställa att lösningar fungerar långsiktigt utifrån krav på säkerhet, driftbarhet och förändringstakt

  • Fungera som teknisk brygga mellan strategi, arkitektur, utveckling, drift och leverans

Din profil
Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur, teknisk arkitektur eller en senior teknisk roll där du haft ansvar för design, vägval och helhetsperspektiv. Du är van att arbeta i komplexa enterprise-miljöer och har förmåga att förstå både tekniska detaljer och övergripande verksamhetsmål.

Du behöver inte kunna allt, men du behöver ha en stark teknisk grund, god kommunikativ förmåga och erfarenhet av att driva lösningsarbete tillsammans med kund och team. Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

För denna position kan svenskt medborgarskap krävas beroende på uppdrag. Vi utför även bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidat.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

  • Lösningsarkitektur i komplexa IT- eller enterprise-miljöer

  • Cloud, hybridmiljöer och moderna plattformar

  • Integrationer, API:er och systemlandskap

  • Infrastruktur, plattformsteknik eller utvecklingsnära miljöer

  • Säkerhetsmedveten arkitektur, exempelvis IAM, nätverk eller compliance

  • Workshopledning, kravdialog och stakeholder management

  • Agila arbetssätt och samarbete mellan verksamhet, utveckling och drift

Extra intressant om du har erfarenhet av:

  • Azure, AWS, Kubernetes eller OpenShift

  • DevOps, CI/CD, GitOps eller Infrastructure as Code

  • ServiceNow, Dynamics 365, SAP eller andra större verksamhetsplattformar

  • ITIL, ITSM eller arkitekturramverk

  • Informationssäkerhet, governance eller regulatoriska krav

  • Konsultrollen, rådgivning eller presale

Vi erbjuder dig
Som anställd på Accelerate erbjuder vi, förutom spännande uppdrag och tekniker:

  • Utbildning och certifieringar via våra partners (exempelvis Red Hat, HashiCorp, Microsoft, GitLab)

  • En trygg och säker anställning med bra förmåner

  • Kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och sjukvårdsförsäkring

  • Flexibilitet, frihet och balans mellan jobb och fritid

  • Att bli en del av ett passionerat team med tekniskt vassa kollegor

  • Möjlighet att arbeta nära kunder i uppdrag där arkitektur, teknik och affärsnytta möts

Vi tror på gemenskap och kompetensutbyte – här utvecklas vi tillsammans och stöttar varandra för att alltid ligga i framkant.

Placeringsort
Accelerate finns på flertal orter i Sverige och Norge. För denna tjänst utgår du från ett av våra kontor i Linköping eller Norrköping, med möjlighet till hybridarbete.

Önskad start är snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Har du frågor? Kontakta Jesper Carlsson på jesper.carlsson@iver.se

Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig. Välkommen till Accelerate!

title: Ad Creator
description:
ABOUT US

Aarke is a Swedish design company dedicated to creating premium home essentials that elevate everyday routines. Founded in 2013, our mission is to redefine the home appliance industry. Our first product, the Aarke Carbonator, has earned a devoted following in over 30 countries. In categories often overlooked by the design community, we challenge the status quo by combining made-to-last quality, premium materials, and a distinctive design philosophy.

Aarke is on an exciting growth journey, challenging the kitchen appliance industry. As we continue to expand, our employees remain our most valuable asset. We are now seeking an Ad Creator to join our team.

You can read more about Aarke @ .

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Ad Creator to join Aarke’s Performance Marketing team. Your main mission is to produce, iterate and test ad creatives for paid social, turning winning concepts into new variations and learning fast from what performs. You’ll also support the wider online team with assets for webshop, CRM and marketplaces such as Amazon.

You’ll work closely with Performance Marketing, Brand and Product teams to make sure our ads are both visually premium and commercially effective. This is a great role for someone early in their career who loves making ads, enjoys fast iteration and is curious about how AI is changing creative production.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ad iteration & production: Create new versions of existing ads by testing hooks, formats, messages, visuals and CTAs, and adapt them across platforms and markets.

  • AI-powered creative production: Use generative AI tools for image, video and copy to speed up production and go from idea to live test in hours, while keeping a sharp eye on brand quality.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Act as the link between Brand and Commercial teams, ensuring creative concepts align with strategic goals.

  • Creative testing: Work with the performance team to set up tests, read results and use the learnings to make the next round better.

  • Insight-led ideas: Turn audience insights, data and product USPs into clear ad concepts with strong calls to action.

  • Trendspotting: Keep track of what’s working on Meta, TikTok and other platforms and bring fresh ideas to the team and your own work.

WHO ARE YOU?

  • You are comfortable with A/B testing, analytics, and performance metrics, especially on META, Google, TikTok and Pinterest.

  • You understand the balance between aesthetics and performance, ensuring that creatives are not just visually appealing but also performance/ conversion driven.

  • You love creating content for social and digital ads and you have a portfolio or examples that shows it.

  • You have a good eye for aesthetics and storytelling, and you’re skilled in Photoshop, After Effects, CapCut, Figma or similar tools.

  • You’re already using AI tools in your creative work, or you’re eager to.

  • You’re fast, structured and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • You’re a team player with a go-getter attitude, finding creative solutions with limited resources.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER

At Aarke you get to work with consumer products that people can relate to and are amongst the most loved in their respective category. We are constantly looking to improve our way of working and you are welcome and expected to support and influence our growth journey. At Aarke you will find a hard-working, fun, interesting, and diverse group of professionals with a range of different backgrounds.

We're a scale-up-an entrepreneurial organization that's always learning and evolving. No matter your role, you'll wear multiple hats and have both the freedom and the expectation to contribute wherever you're needed.

WHAT NOW?

Please submit your application and portfolio through career.aarke.com/jobs, we will be reviewing applicants continuously. If you have questions about the position, please contact Anna Korling (Chief People Officer)at anna@aarke.com

title: Ålderskontrollant/ Mystery Shopper 19-24 år med B-körkort Stockholm
description:
Ålderskontrollant / Mystery Shopper 19-24 år- med B-körkort – Stockholm

Som ålderskontrollant och Mystery Shopper arbetar du dig runt i landet på en så kallad "slinga" i ett team av två medarbetare. Ni kommer att köra våra företagsbilar och bo på hotell under slingorna. Vid arbetsresor delas boendet upp så att kvinnor delar rum med kvinnor och män delar rum med män.

Kostnader så som boende och bränsle står självklart företaget för. Där av är det viktigt att du har B-körkort och god körvana så att du känner dig trygg på vägarna. Slingorna kan variera mellan 2-5 dagar i sträck. Det vill säga att beroende på månad och uppdrag så kan det variera hur mycket man arbetar och sover utanför Stockholm. Ensamarbete förekommer också, men oftast är man team av två.

Under arbetet kommer ni att besöka butiker, caféer, restauranger och liknande typer av enheter, för att göra så kallade provköp på t.ex spel, tobak, läkemedel och alkohol. Detta för att mäta om försäljningsenheten begär legitimation på ålders begränsade varor.

Tjänsten startar med intro i början av december, du behöver kunna vara tillgänglig då för att kunna börja tjänsten.

Form av ålderskontroller dvs. kontroller för att säkerställa att alkohol inte säljs till minderåriga. (Alkohollagen Kap 5 § 5). Dessa uppdrag handlar om just säkerställande av ålderkontroll genom provköp, för att vara provköpare i det åldersspann där ålderskontroll krävs behöver du alltid vara 20 år fyllda och/eller i närliggande högre ålder som är åldersrepresentativ för det lagliga inköpet av alkoholhaltig vara.

Detta för att säkra att alla provköp genomförs av en ålders representativ kontrollant och alla butiker kontrolleras på samma grunder. Själva ålderskontrollerna genomförs i förebyggande syfte.

Vidare ingår det som Mystery Shopper att genomföra anonyma kvalitets mätningar. Vilket innebär att du kommer besöka en enhet och agera som en vanlig kund där du följer ett specifikt scenario för att kunna bedöma specifika kriterier i upplevelsen av ditt besök. Vi hjälper våra kunder att utveckla kvalité och försäljning i mötet med kunden samt säkerställa att uppsatta rutiner efterlevs löpande.

Kunskapskrav:

Du som söker ska ha manuellt B-körkort och kunna svenska språket i både tal och skrift.

Det är av en stor merit att vara duktig på att uttrycka sig i skrift, samt att ha ett öga för detaljer då det ingår mycket rapportskrivning i arbetet. Har du tidigare arbetat med serviceyrken och / eller har kassa erfarenhet så ser vi detta som meriterande.

Arbetstiderna är främst under dagtid men kvälls och helgjobb kan förkomma ibland.

title: People & Culture Specialist
description:
People & Culture Specialist

Join Beneq as our People & Culture Specialist and help shape how People & Culture works in a growing technology company. You will be the person managers and employees turn to every day, with clear areas of your own from day one and room to grow.

Beneq designs and manufactures ALD (atomic layer deposition) equipment for semiconductor, research and industrial customers worldwide, with headquarters in Espoo and entities in the US and Japan. We are now strengthening our People & Culture function.

What you will do

Most of the work is in Finland, with support to colleagues in France, the US and Japan.

You own:

  • Hire to retire delivery: contracts, changes and employment documents, onboarding, leaves, offboarding and retirement, with accurate records at every step

  • Working time recording: day-to-day administration of our system Nepton

  • HR data and reporting: employee data in order

  • Employee surveys: run in-house from setup to results and follow-up

You work with managers and the acting Head of people & Culture on:

  • Recruitment: role profiles and job postings, screening and interviewing, candidate communication, offers and pre-employment steps

  • Line manager support: first point of contact for managers’ day-to-day HR questions on working hours, absences, leave and contract changes

  • Employee relations: preparing documentation, keeping records and making sure each process step is followed

  • Employee events and internal communication

What you bring

Above all, you are a doer: you see what needs doing, pick it up and see it through, even when several things land at once. You have a sharp eye for detail, so contracts and data are right the first time. We are a small team that does a lot in-house, so you are comfortable setting things up and running them yourself.

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in HR or People & Culture across the employee lifecycle from hire to retire, including recruitment

  • Working knowledge of Finnish employment law and collective agreements, ideally the Technology Industry agreements, and the judgement to know when to check or escalate

  • Strong Excel skills for HR data management and reporting

  • A service mindset towards managers and employees, and discretion with sensitive matters

  • Working proficiency in English

What we offer

  • The chance to shape a People & Culture function as it is built for the next stage

  • A small, close team and daily work with managers across engineering, production, sales and service

  • An international deep-tech company with customers around the world

How to apply

Submit your application, including your CV and salary request, by 11.11. We encourage early applications, as interviews may begin during the application period. Please note: we only handle applications submitted via our system. Applications sent through other channels will not be processed.


Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the world’s first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneq’s team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

title: Sr. Engineer, Manufacturing
description:
About Company:

About us:


Gener8 is an innovative tech company with offices in San Jose and Carlsbad, CA, Wilmington, MA, Indianapolis, IN and Cartago, Costa Rica. We know what it takes to be a key partner in the life science and medical device industries. Since 2002, Gener8 has guided our customers by turning their innovative concepts into reality by providing engineering and software design services and manufacturing complex instruments and consumables. Our customers are striving for breakthroughs in medical research and diagnostic applications as well as surgical devices that help scientists and medical professionals understand and diagnose diseases and improve patient treatment outcomes.

About the Role:

The Senior Engineer, Manufacturing, plays a critical role in driving the efficiency, quality, and innovation of manufacturing processes within our Carlsbad, CA facility. This position is responsible for leading the design, development, and implementation of advanced manufacturing solutions that support product scalability and cost-effectiveness. The role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams including design engineering, quality assurance, and production to ensure seamless integration of new technologies and continuous process improvements. The Senior Engineer will also analyze manufacturing data to identify bottlenecks and develop strategies to enhance throughput and reduce waste. Ultimately, this position ensures that manufacturing operations meet rigorous standards for safety, quality, and productivity while supporting the company’s strategic growth objectives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in a manufacturing engineering role within a high-tech or industrial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, tooling, and equipment.
  • Proficiency with CAD software and manufacturing simulation tools.
  • Experience with process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Engineering or related discipline.
  • Certification in Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt) or Lean Manufacturing.
  • Experience with automation and robotics integration in manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with quality management systems such as ISO 9001 or AS9100.
  • Previous experience working in a regulated industry such as medical devices or aerospace.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and optimization of manufacturing processes to improve efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with product design and quality teams to ensure manufacturability and compliance with industry standards.
  • Analyze production data and metrics to identify areas for process improvement and implement corrective actions.
  • Develop and document manufacturing procedures, work instructions, and process controls.
  • Support the introduction of new products by designing scalable manufacturing solutions and conducting pilot runs.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and provide technical guidance to production teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and maintain a safe working environment.

Skills:

The required skills enable the Senior Engineer to design and refine manufacturing processes that enhance product quality and operational efficiency. Proficiency in CAD and simulation tools is essential for developing and validating manufacturing workflows and tooling designs. Knowledge of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies supports the identification and elimination of waste, driving continuous improvement initiatives. Preferred skills such as automation integration and quality system familiarity allow the engineer to implement advanced manufacturing technologies and ensure compliance with industry standards. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are applied daily to troubleshoot production challenges and optimize process performance.

title: Commercial Pricing and Costing Manager
description:
Job Title: Commercial Pricing and Costing Manager

Industry: Infrastructure, Logistics, Transportation

Location: Wilmington, Delaware

Social Media: LinkedIn / Facebook


About Enstructure:

Enstructure LLC is a logistics infrastructure company with corporate offices in Montreal, Canada, Wellesley, Massachusetts and New York City. Enstructure owns and operates an integrated network of marine terminals and logistics assets on the East Coast, Gulf Coast, Inland River System of the United States and across Canada. Founded in 2016, Enstructure's mission is to acquire and grow established terminal and logistics companies that will benefit from the company's resources and best practices. Enstructure provides extensive services for some of the world's largest companies within the energy, agriculture, automotive, retail, food, manufacturing, construction and public safety sectors.

Key Functions

  • Lead financial assessment of commercial opportunities across the terminal network, including development of economic costing and pricing models.
  • Evaluate potential capital projects and investment opportunities using discounted cash flow (DCF), net present value (NPV), internal rate of return (IRR), ROI, and payback analyses.
  • Independently build, maintain, and validate complex, scalable Excel financial models from the ground up, including scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and financial projections.
  • Analyze customer, service, and terminal profitability, cost drivers, pricing assumptions, and margins to support commercial decisions.
  • Create reporting tools and dashboards that track business metrics and financial performance weekly, monthly, and quarterly.
  • Support annual and quarterly budgeting, operating and strategic planning, reforecasting, CRM reporting, and internal performance reporting.
  • Analyze market and operational data to identify trends, evaluate opportunities, and improve commercial strategy.
  • Partner with commercial, operations, and finance teams to evaluate strategic and operational alternatives and present clear recommendations to leadership.
  • Document model assumptions, reconcile financial inputs, and maintain accuracy, consistency, and appropriate version control.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • At least 4 years of relevant financial analysis, financial modeling, commercial finance, or investment analysis experience.
  • Demonstrated experience independently developing complex financial models and evaluating capital investments or business opportunities.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency required, including complex formulas, lookups, PivotTables, sensitivity analysis, and model auditing; Power Query or Power Pivot experience is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, cash flow, and valuation concepts.
  • Ability to translate complex financial analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for nonfinancial stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills, accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proficiency in PowerPoint and financial reporting tools.
  • Experience in infrastructure, logistics, transportation, marine terminals, or other capital-intensive businesses preferred.
  • Experience with acquisition analysis, due diligence, or post-investment performance tracking is a plus, not required.
  • Comfortable working with remotely located colleagues and communicating by telephone and video conferencing.
  • Ability to travel as required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other impermissible criterion or circumstance.

title: Site Supervisor Industrial Automation
description:
Maak mee het verschil op de werf.

Als Site Supervisor Industrial Automation stuur je de uitvoering van industriële automatiseringsprojecten op de werf aan. Je coördineert medewerkers en onderaannemers, bewaakt de planning en kwaliteit en zorgt ervoor dat de werkzaamheden veilig en volgens de afspraken verlopen. Je bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor de klant en werkt nauw samen met de Project Manager, engineering en operations.

Jouw plek bij VMA

  • Organiseren en coördineren van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden op de werf voor industriële automatiseringsprojecten.

  • Aansturen, begeleiden en ondersteunen van techniekers, monteurs en onderaannemers.

  • Opvolgen van de uitvoeringsplanning, taakverdeling en voortgang; tijdig bijsturen waar nodig.

  • Toezien op de correcte uitvoering van elektrische en automatiseringswerken volgens plannen, schema’s en technische specificaties.

  • Bewaken van de kwaliteit, veiligheid en orde en netheid op de werf.

  • Deelnemen aan werfvergaderingen en zorgen voor duidelijke communicatie met de klant en interne teams.

  • Technische en organisatorische problemen analyseren en samen met de betrokken partijen oplossingen uitwerken.

  • Afstemmen met de Project Manager, engineering en andere projectteams over wijzigingen, materialen en werfbehoeften.

  • Controleren of materialen, gereedschappen en documentatie beschikbaar zijn voor de uitvoering.

  • Opvolgen van werfadministratie, voortgangsrapporten en relevante technische documentatie.

  • Ondersteunen bij testen, opstart en indienststelling van industriële automatiseringsinstallaties.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Je hebt relevante ervaring in industriële automatisering, elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare technische omgeving.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het coördineren van werkzaamheden en het aansturen van uitvoerende teams op de werf.

  • Je kan elektrische schema’s en technische plannen lezen en interpreteren.

  • Kennis van industriële automatisering, PLC-systemen en instrumentatie is een sterke troef.

  • Je communiceert vlot met klanten, collega’s en onderaannemers en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor duidelijke afspraken.

  • Je werkt georganiseerd, houdt het overzicht en gaat proactief om met wijzigingen en onverwachte situaties.

  • Veilig werken is voor jou vanzelfsprekend en je spreekt anderen aan wanneer dat nodig is.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands goed; kennis van het Frans of Engels is een pluspunt.

  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B en bent bereid om naar projectlocaties te reizen.

Hiermee laat VMA jouw motor draaien:

  • Je komt terecht in een internationaal, multitechnologisch bedrijf met uitdagende projecten en ruimte om samen te groeien.

  • Een motiverend loon dat afgestemd is op jouw competenties en ervaring, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen.

  • Een collegiaal team waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en werkplezier centraal staan.

  • Ruimte voor opleiding en professionele ontwikkeling, onder meer via de CFE-academy.

  • Regelmatige evaluatie- en feedbackgesprekken om je ontwikkeling en noden te bespreken.

  • Deelname aan diverse VMA- en CFE-evenementen.

title: Indigo Premier Research Mentor
description:
Indigo Research provides a unique opportunity to mentor highly motivated high school students from around the world, helping them learn about academic research and complete a college-level project. Our program offers high-quality research mentorship to aspiring students from diverse backgrounds, with the goals of giving them valuable experience in academic research and making a significant impact on their future academic and professional careers.

We're looking to connect with current faculty members at top 15 US or top 10 UK universities who would enjoy sharing their academic expertise and helping young people discover what they're capable of.

As an Indigo Research Mentor, you'll work remotely with high school students from around the world, supporting them as they turn their interests into a research project of their own. This could involve exploring a new question, making sense of existing literature, developing an argument, or working towards a research paper or other academic output.

More than simply teaching a subject, you'll help students learn how to think critically, ask better questions, and approach challenges with greater independence. You don't need to have all the answers; what matters is your ability to guide students through the process and make academic research an engaging and rewarding experience.

Qualifications:

  • Currently hold a faculty position at a top 15 university in the US or a top 10 university in the UK.

  • Have strong subject knowledge and can help students explore a research topic with academic depth and rigour.

  • Enjoy mentoring and are patient, empathetic, and encouraging when working with high school students.

  • Are comfortable working with students from different cultural and educational backgrounds.

  • Are open to feedback and willing to adapt their approach to each student's needs.

  • Can work independently, exercise sound judgment, and are comfortable in a collaborative, evolving startup environment.

By joining Indigo Research as a mentor, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of aspiring students, helping them to break down geographic barriers and access high-quality research mentorship.

title: Intern, Project Manager, Marketing on Demand
description:
Do you want to work for a company where your co-workers are co-owners? We are 100% employee-owned! The Bernard Group’s sister company, Smartpress, is a fast-growing online printing service, disrupting the traditional printing industry one innovation at a time. Our customers love us (seriously, google Smartpress reviews) and we love them right back, providing an easy online experience, high-quality printed products and world-class customer service. Our internship program provides you with the opportunity to learn, contribute and gain hands-on experience alongside our teams. This paid internship will begin with an interactive onboarding program where you’ll learn more about our technology, processes and culture. Interns are integrated into our teams, giving you the opportunity to learn how we provide clients with the quality, service and speed the industry requires while experiencing a culture of teamwork and ownership. We invite you to consider joining us as we consistently work to go above and beyond, and WOW those we serve!

As a Project Manager Intern, Marketing on Demand (MOD), you will support our Project Managers in the day-to-day care of client MOD sites—the branded sites where clients order their marketing materials and collateral. You’ll gain hands-on experience with the steps that bring a MOD program to life, from client requests and site setup to estimating, production and fulfillment. Working alongside Project Managers, Implementation Managers and Project Coordinators, you’ll learn about client communication, project planning, and the print and technology industry.

Shift available: Monday through Friday, 8:30 am–5:00 pm. This internship is based primarily on-site at TBG’s offices in Chanhassen, MN. Relocation assistance, housing and transportation are not provided. Candidates must reside in or be able to commute locally to the Chanhassen area for the duration of the internship.

Compensation: $21.00 hourly

A variety of these traits will help land you this job if you:

  • are currently enrolled in a bachelor’s program in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
  • have coursework or experience in project management, customer service, print or e-commerce. No prior experience is required!
  • are comfortable learning new software and systems, including Google Workspace and Excel.

On top of that you must:

  • exhibit excellent verbal and written communication, including the ability to write clear, professional client emails.
  • demonstrate strong organization and attention to detail.
  • show initiative, ask thoughtful questions and approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset.
  • manage multiple tasks and deadlines while following through on open items.
  • take direction well and work collaboratively with people across different teams.

In this position, you will:

TBG Overview:

We believe teams of top talent with clear objectives will consistently outperform centralized control. We put a great amount of energy into building skilled and diverse teams to handle our most challenging pursuits. It’s the difference between average and being a world-class service provider.

Teamet utvikler og forvalter flere egenutviklede systemer for operative miljøer i konsernet. Vi har ansvar for løsningene hele veien, fra idé og utvikling til drift og videre forbedring. Det betyr kort vei fra kode til bruker og reell påvirkning.

  • Ta ansvar for det vi leverer: teamet eier produktene sine, og vi ser etter deg som leverer kvalitet, tar eierskap og bidrar aktivt til gode og robuste løsninger

  • Jobbe tett med brukerne: du får god og direkte kontakt med brukere og fagmiljøer, slik at løsningene vi lager treffer behovene deres og faktisk gjør en forskjell

Rollen vil vokse og endre seg etter hvert som behovene våre utvikler seg, og du vil være med på å forme den i dialog med nærmeste leder. Her får du både ansvar og rom til å utvikle deg faglig.

Samtidig trives du med å utvikle løsninger sammen med andre. Du bygger gode relasjoner, deler kompetanse og setter teamets samlede leveranser foran egne prestasjoner.

As a domiciliary audiologist, you can help our most vulnerable patients with their hearing in the comfort of their homes. You will play a crucial role in providing audiological testing services to patients in the comfort of their homes

You will be trusted to make autonomous decisions and valued for your professional expertise. You'll have full support from our central teams including logistical and clinical support.

title: Geospatial Data Science Engineer - 6 months contract
description:
Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS).

You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries.
  • Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy.
  • Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes.
  • System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms.
  • Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with an emphasis or thesis work on computational statistics, data mining, machine learning, or spatial optimization.
  • Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems.
  • Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis.
  • Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas).
  • Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB).
  • Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates.
  • Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks).
  • Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS).
  • Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps.
  • Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision).

This is an initial six-month contract, with the possibility of extending the assignment.

title: Frozen Food Manager Spokane Valley, WA.
description:
Description

Frozen Food Manager

Position Purpose: Exemplifies and ensures strong customer service in all aspects of the job. Directs and controls the operation of the Frozen Department to achieve sales and profit objectives.

Job Description: As a primary contact for customers, the Frozen Food Manager provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. Trains, supervises, schedules, and assigns duties to Frozen Food Clerks. Changes signs and prices as directed by merchandising. Responsible for maintaining appropriate stock and inventory in the frozen food area. Responsible for minimizing out of stock product. Writes frozen food order in the order guide book. Checks order for completeness upon arrival. Rotates product and removes expired stock daily. Keeps frozen food cases stocked with product, cleans department area, restocks items in freezer for other departments. Boards received from trucks are loaded onto pallets. Pallets are taken to the sales floor with a pallet jack and product is loaded into cases. Cardboard boxes are broken down and placed in the bailer. Ice machine is checked daily and filled as needed. End displays are restocked as per instructions. Cleans any spills from leakage in cases or on department floor. In event of a freezer malfunction or power outage the employee will remove all items, clean out the case, and replace or restock product. May also function as cashier/checker during peak times.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

· Provide customer service as currently defined by the employer within the scope of the position and within company policy.

· Train, schedule, and supervise Frozen Food workers to ensure optimum staffing patterns for the department.

· Speak with customers to resolve problems involving sales, satisfaction with service, or product and other problems related to the operation of the Frozen Food area.

· Perform daily inventory and order necessary supplies to maintain adequate inventory.

· Replace stock in coolers, freezers, and end displays.

· Make sure that all expired items are removed from the shelves daily.

· Unload boards and stack on pallets or six wheel carts. Push pallet jacks or six wheeled carts through store to display areas.

· Maintain cleanliness of display areas and freezers.

· Other duties as assigned.

JOB RELATED QUALIFICATIONS:

· Ability to follow company customer service procedures. Demonstrated prior customer service skills or related experience.

· Ability to interact with customers and co-workers.

· Ability to work independently.

· Ability to understand and follow instructions.

· Desired: Previous experience as a clerk.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Frozen Food Clerks and Helper Clerks working in department.

PERMITS/LICENSES:

Varies depending on store location and state/county requirements.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

%Inside: 95% %Outside: 5%

Temperature Extremes: Freezer temperature may be –20° F.

Chemicals: Seldom (mild detergents or glass cleaner).

MACHINES, TOOLS, AND EQUIPMENT:

hand truck, six wheel cart, pallet jacks, grocery carts, box cutter, pens and pencils, mops, brooms, telephone/intercom, power pallet jack, big joe, bailer, scrubber machine

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Constant (over 70% of the time)

Frequent (30-70%)

Occasional (10-30%)

Seldom (1-10%)

Lifting:

Constantly lifts 1-20 lbs. Occasionally lifts 21-35 lbs.

Carrying:

Constantly carries 1-10 lbs. Frequently carries 11-20 lbs. Seldom carries 21-35 lbs.

Pushing/Pulling:

Constantly pushes/pulls 1-10 lbs. Frequently pushes/pulls 11-20 lbs. Occasionally pushes/pulls 21-50 lbs.

Reaching:

Constant knee to shoulder reaching. Occasional overhead and at or above shoulder level reaching.

Standing:

Constant standing while on job. Sitting allowed on breaks.

Walking:

Constant walking while on job.

Climb/Balance:

Seldom. May use step stool to reach higher shelves.

Trunk Functions:

Frequent neck rotation. Occasional bending of head, bending/stooping, twisting, crouching, squatting, kneeling.

Upper Extremity:

Constant handling/grasping. Frequent repetitive motion. Seldom forceful gripping.

Vision:

Use of peripheral vision and depth perception to move pallet jacks, carts, and six wheelers around crowded store area containing customers. Near vision used to read price sheets, product labels, etc.

Hearing:

To converse with customers, provide service, perceive questions and conduct business. To answer pages and receive instructions/information from other employees.

Speech:

To converse with customers, answer questions and conduct business. To exchange information with other employees, use the telephone or page other employees over intercom.

Safety – Sensitive Position:

Job responsibilities include tasks or duties that could affect the safety or health of the employee performing the task or others.

Union and Non-Union: “The pay range is $17.38 to $20.71 per hour, but no less than the local minimum wage. Starting rates will vary based on things like location, experience, qualifications and the terms of any applicable collective bargaining agreement. Dependent on length of service, hours worked and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, benefits include medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, sick pay (accrued based on hours worked), PTO/Vacation pay (accrued based on hours worked), paid holidays (9 days annually), bereavement pay, and retirement benefits (pension and/or 401k eligibility).”

DISCLAIMER:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by employees assigned to this job. If you have questions regarding your ability to physically perform the listed job duties and requirements – e.g. lifting, standing, bending, etc. - please speak to your Store Director. All team members must comply with Company, Division, and Store policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified may vary within each store and from store to store.

This is a pure supply-side business development role: you sell Sparteo’s CTV monetization to the owners of the screens and the apps, not to advertisers. As an independent consultant working closely with our CTV and Supply leadership in Europe, you will be the tip of the spear for Sparteo’s CTV supply in the US.

Your mission is to leverage your existing network to open doors at CTV OEMs and leading CTV / FAST app publishers, sign long-term partnerships and grow the revenue they generate on our platform.

  • Business Development: Identify and approach smart TV manufacturers, streaming device makers and top CTV / FAST app publishers in the US. Pitch Sparteo’s CTV monetization stack and its value against their current setup.

  • CTV Expertise: Solid understanding of the CTV monetization ecosystem: SSPs and DSPs, SSAI, VAST, ad pods, app-ads.txt and supply chain transparency.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: A self-starter comfortable working autonomously as a 1099 Contractor, with a remote team based in Europe.

  • A strategic thinker with an 'AI-native' reflex, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints. You don't just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision

Your mind set to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

  • 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment.

  • 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

title: Compensation & Benefits Manager - London
description:
Compensation & Benefits Manager

Location: London
Reports to: Head of HR, Global

Works closely with: People Team & Finance Team

About Us

Sokin is a next-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency. Our mission is simple: we’re unifying the best of business banking.

We deliver services across:

  • Global payments and receivables

  • Foreign Exchange (FX)

  • Treasury management

  • Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America. Backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide.

Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we’re building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

The Role

This is a highly cross-functional role: you’ll work closely with Finance, including the CFO and Head of FP&A, to ensure our reward decisions are commercially sound and financially sustainable.

Key Responsibilities

Compensation

  • Develop and maintain salary structures, job levels, and pay bands using market data and benchmarking

  • Lead annual salary review, bonus, and equity/long-term incentive cycles, including modelling, budgeting, and communications

  • Advise managers and People Partners on offers, promotions, and pay adjustments

  • Run job evaluation and levelling to ensure internal equity and consistency

  • Conduct regular pay equity analysis, and gender and ethnicity pay gap reporting where required

Finance Partnership

  • Work closely with the Head of FP&A to develop and maintain accurate salary and employee benefits cost forecasts and budgets, including salary reviews, bonuses, employer taxes, pension contributions and other employee-related costs, in collaboration with the Talent team.

  • Partner with the CFO on reward strategy, providing financial modelling and scenario analysis to support decisions on pay budgets, incentive plans, and equity

  • Partner with Finance to develop salary review and bonus budgets, and manage the annual compensation review process to ensure proposed awards align with agreed budgets

  • Collaborate with Finance on the tax treatment of equity, bonus accruals, and benefits costs

  • Provide regular reporting to Finance and the CFO on people costs, pay competitiveness, and cost-versus-value of benefits

  • Support Finance with business cases, ROI analysis, and board or investor materials relating to reward

Benefits

  • Manage the full benefits portfolio (e.g. pension/retirement, health and life insurance, wellbeing, leave, and flexible benefits)

  • Manage relationships with benefits brokers, insurers, and providers, including renewals and tenders

  • Evaluate new benefits offerings and monitor take-up and employee satisfaction

  • Ensure benefits communications are clear, accessible, and engaging

Governance and Analytics

  • Ensure compliance with employment, tax, and pensions legislation across all operating locations

  • Build dashboards and reporting on compensation costs, pay competitiveness, and benefits utilisation

  • Support the remuneration committee or leadership with data, proposals, and market insights

  • Own relevant policies, documentation, and audit readiness

Operations and Projects

title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst & Data Engineer- Remote
description:
We're looking for a remote Business Intelligence Analyst & Data Engineer for our client in Ireland, who can operate across the full data lifecycle — from building and maintaining reliable data pipelines to designing dashboards and reports that drive business decisions. This role sits at the intersection of data infrastructure and analytics: you'll own how data flows into our systems and how it's ultimately consumed by stakeholders across the organization.

This is a great fit for someone who enjoys both the technical rigor of data engineering and the storytelling/analytical side of BI work, and who wants ownership over an end-to-end data product rather than sitting in just one lane. AI-driven analytics is a growing part of our roadmap, so we're especially interested in candidates who are curious about applying AI/LLM tools to make data more accessible and self-service across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate data from multiple source systems (CRM, ERP, project management tools, spreadsheets, APIs) into centralized data warehouses or data marts
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across pipelines through validation, testing, and monitoring
  • Optimize data models (star/snowflake schemas) for reporting performance
  • Automate manual data processes and reduce reliance on ad hoc spreadsheet work
  • Manage data source connections, credentials, and refresh schedules
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, latency issues, and discrepancies

Business Intelligence & Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports (e.g., in Tableau, Power BI, or similar) that translate raw data into clear, actionable insights
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into technical specifications
  • Define and maintain a single source of truth for key business metrics (a data dictionary / metrics glossary)
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support strategic decision-making
  • Monitor dashboard usage and proactively improve reports based on stakeholder feedback
  • Document data lineage, business logic, and calculation methodology for transparency and auditability

AI-Enabled Analytics

  • Design and maintain data structures (clean schemas, semantic layers, metric definitions) that are well-suited for consumption by AI agents and natural-language query tools, not just human-facing dashboards
  • Build or support AI-powered reporting assistants/chatbots that let stakeholders ask business questions in plain language and get accurate, governed answers
  • Evaluate and integrate LLM-based tools into the analytics stack (e.g., automated insight generation, anomaly detection, natural-language-to-SQL interfaces)
  • Establish guardrails for AI-generated analysis — certified data sources, citation of underlying data, and validation processes to ensure trustworthy outputs
  • Stay current on AI/BI tooling trends and proactively recommend where automation or AI can reduce manual reporting work

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with department leaders (Sales, Finance, Operations, Professional Services, etc.) to understand data needs and pain points
  • Act as a technical liaison between business teams and IT/engineering on data-related initiatives
  • Support the rollout of new tools, data sources, or automation initiatives (e.g., AI-powered reporting agents, workflow automation platforms)

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 6+ years of experience in a data engineering, BI analyst, or analytics engineering role
  • Strong SQL skills, including experience writing complex queries, optimizing performance, and working with large datasets
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines (custom scripts, or tools like Fivetran, dbt, Airflow, Workato, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with a BI/visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (dimensional modeling, normalization, star schemas)
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar)
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured data analysis
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or another scripting language for data manipulation and automation
  • Familiarity with CRM/ERP systems (Salesforce, NetSuite) and how operational data flows from them
  • Experience with API integrations and workflow automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) into data workflows — such as natural-language querying, automated report generation, or AI-driven data agents
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agent-based architectures as applied to analytics
  • Experience establishing data governance practices (certified data sources, metric definitions, documentation standards) suitable for both human and AI consumers
  • Prior experience in a Professional Services, Finance, or Operations analytics function

title: Executive & Commercial Assistant to the CEO
description:
About UpSkill Universe

UpSkill Universe is a multi-award-winning AI upskilling and training organisation, founded in 2015. We design and deliver practical learning programmes for large enterprises, governments and community partners, and we have now trained close to 800,000 people across 43 countries, working with organisations including Google, Sky, UBS, HSBC, Visa, Lloyds Bank and Santander. Our work spans the UK, Sub-Saharan Africa and international markets, across AI, data, digital skills, leadership and inclusion.

About the role

We are looking for an Executive & Commercial Assistant to work alongside our CEO and sit at the centre of how UpSkill Universe wins new business. Around 70% of the role is running the CEO's working week well: the diary, the inbox, travel, board and client preparation, and the follow-through that keeps commitments moving. The remaining 30% is commercial enablement: researching accounts and contacts, following up on the CEO's relationships and conversations, preparing outreach, and keeping HubSpot an accurate picture of where every opportunity stands, working closely with our Head of Growth and sales team. As with any EA role, the balance will flex with what the business needs at the time.

You will use AI tools confidently every day and build simple, repeatable systems such as templates, workflows, automations and dashboards, so that the CEO's time goes where it creates the most value. This role suits someone who is highly organised, commercially curious and ambitious, and there is a clear route into business development for the right person.

This is a permanent, full-time hybrid role, reporting to the CEO and based at our London office for part of the week, with occasional UK and international travel.

Your responsibilities will centre on:

  • Owning the CEO's diary, inbox and meeting preparation so that time is protected for selling and key relationships.

  • Researching accounts and contacts and preparing outreach and follow-up on the CEO's relationships.

  • Making sure every conversation, event contact and introduction is followed up and handed to the right person in Sales.

  • Keeping HubSpot accurate, current and useful for the whole Commercial team.

  • Using AI and automation to make the CEO's office and our sales process faster and more consistent.

  • Coordinating board, leadership and client preparation so that nothing is missed.

What you will do

Executive partnership and CEO operations (around 70% of the role)

  • Diary and Inbox Management: Own the CEO's calendar and inbox triage, protecting time for selling, client relationships and board work, and making sure nothing important waits more than a working day for a response.

  • Meeting Preparation: Brief the CEO ahead of client, partner and board meetings with a short summary of the organisation, attendees, HubSpot history and the objective for the conversation, then capture actions afterwards and chase them through to completion.

  • Board and Leadership Rhythm: Prepare papers, packs and follow-ups for board and leadership meetings, keeping a clear log of decisions, owners and deadlines.

  • Travel and Events: Organise UK and international travel along with the CEO's speaking, conference and panel commitments, and turn each event into a plan of who to meet and how to follow up.

  • Recruitment and Admin Coordination: Schedule interviews, manage candidate communication, and handle invoices, supplier and office logistics, awards and event submissions.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: Act as a warm, professional first point of contact for clients, partners, funders and government stakeholders.

Commercial enablement (around 30% of the role)

  • Account Research: Research target organisations and contacts against our ideal customer profile, including HR, L&D, Talent and Digital leaders in large enterprises and CSR, Foundation and Social Impact leads for societal programmes, using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and HubSpot.

  • Outreach and Follow-up: Prepare and send personalised outreach and follow-up on the CEO's relationships, event contacts and introductions, booking meetings for the CEO and passing qualified interest to Sales.

  • Network Re-engagement: Work through the CEO's network, past clients, lapsed accounts and event attendees to reopen conversations, which is often where our quickest wins sit.

  • CRM Management: Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date for contacts, companies, activities, meeting outcomes, next steps and deal stages.

  • Proposal Coordination: Pull together proposal packs, credentials, case studies and tender documents with the Commercial team.

  • Reporting: Share a short weekly update on CEO follow-ups and commercial enablement activity, and contribute to monthly pipeline reviews.

AI and systems (running through the whole role)

  • AI-first Working: Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Copilot for research, drafting, meeting notes, summaries and personalised outreach at scale, with sound judgement on accuracy, tone and data protection.

  • Building Systems: Design and maintain simple workflows, templates, sequences and automations (for example HubSpot workflows, Zapier or Make) that save time for the CEO and the sales team, and document them so that others can use them.

What success looks like

  • By the end of month three: the CEO's diary, inbox and meeting preparation routine is running smoothly, HubSpot records for CEO-owned accounts are complete and current, and outreach sequences are live.

  • By the end of month six: at least eight hours a week of CEO time released from administration and redirected to new business and key accounts.

  • Inbox responses within one working day on items the CEO needs to act on, and no missed follow-ups on CEO-owned opportunities.

Progression

After 12 to 18 months, and against clear performance measures, there is a route into a Business Development Manager role within the Commercial team, or into a broader Chief of Staff remit working across the business.

About you

  • Two to five years in an executive assistant, business support, sales development, business development or account management role, ideally in a growing business, consultancy or learning organisation.

  • A track record of managing a busy senior diary, and ideally of arranging meetings with senior stakeholders.

  • Confident and articulate on the phone, in writing and on LinkedIn, and comfortable approaching senior people.

  • Uses AI tools every day and can show examples of work built or sped up with them.

  • Hands-on CRM experience (HubSpot preferred; Salesforce or Dynamics also considered).

  • Highly organised and discreet, with strong attention to detail and the ability to juggle competing priorities.

  • Enjoys finding and building a better way of doing things.

It would be great if you also bring experience in EdTech, L&D, training or consultancy, knowledge of LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot workflows, Zapier or Make, an interest in AI, future skills or social impact programmes, or experience coordinating bids and tenders.

Working at UpSkill

At UpSkill you will join a team that cares about the work and about each other, with the freedom and the tools to bring your best self to work and see the difference you make. Our benefits include:

  • Access to annual learning grants so you can take control of your learning and development journey.

  • Early Friday finishes.

  • Unlimited paid holiday.

  • Flexible, hybrid working.

  • Referral, commission and bonus schemes.

  • Well-being initiatives and a busy social calendar.

  • A strong tech set-up, whether you are working from home or in our London office.

This position offers a salary of £35,000 to £45,000, depending on experience.

How we hire

We would love to get a feel for your approach and personality, so if you think you would be a great fit, please submit your application. We believe in being open about our process:

  • The first stage is a 15-minute informal chat so we can get to know you and understand your motivations for joining us.

  • You will then be invited to a second stage interview with your potential manager, so you have the chance to ask questions and learn more about the team you would be joining.

UpSkill Universe is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and all relevant and qualified applicants will be considered regardless of religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, ethnicity or background.

title: Senior IT Manager
description:
We always do the right thing, the right way.

Job Title: Senior IT Manager

Job ID: 737 — Senior IT Manager

Location: San Marcos, CA - Hybrid Status

Department: IT

Reports To: Senior Director - IT & Cybersecurity

Job Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $130,000 - $150,000 (DOE) + Incentive Compensation

Summary:

At Aptiv Interconnect, we inspire the world’s most innovative teams by doing the right thing, the right way. We are seeking a Senior IT Manager to lead and oversee the IT operations across multiple manufacturing sites.

The Senior IT Manager will focus on creating and implementing standardized IT processes, driving technology improvements, and aligning IT strategies to meet the operational goals of each location. This role requires a strong leader who can effectively manage a distributed team, enhance collaboration, and ensure uniformity and compliance in IT operations across all sites. Each site has a dedicated IT Manager, who will report directly to this role.

Leadership & Core Responsibilities

  • Drive uniformity in IT operations across multiple manufacturing sites by developing and implementing standardized policies, procedures, and protocols.
  • Lead complex IT projects across all sites, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, on-time completion, and adherence to quality standards.
  • Set and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess IT performance across sites, focusing on uptime, system efficiency, and security compliance.
  • Oversee budgets, ensuring cost-effective technology utilization, compliance with licensing, and strategic resource allocation.
  • Partner with senior leadership and operational managers to understand business needs and translate them into IT strategies.
  • Facilitate regular communication and best practice sharing among site IT Managers, fostering a cohesive team approach across all locations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external vendors, ensuring cost-effective contracts and timely support for hardware, software, and IT services.
  • Mentor and develop IT Managers at each site, empowering them with decision-making authority within defined parameters and fostering a collaborative IT culture.
  • Encourage IT teams to propose improvements in technology use and support operational efficiency. Lead efforts to adopt new technologies that add value to the business.
  • Create development programs for IT Managers, ensuring they have the tools and knowledge to excel and lead effectively within their sites.

Position Requirements

Education & Technical Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; a Master’s degree is a plus.
  • Minimum of 8-10 years of IT management experience, preferably in a multi-site manufacturing or industrial environment, including direct management of site-level IT Managers.
  • Demonstrated expert-level knowledge of NIST 800-171 standards and CMMC frameworks to ensure government and contractual compliance. Responsible for auditing and oversight—ensuring that all sites are meeting CMMC readiness.
  • Proven success in creating and implementing standardized IT processes, policies, and protocols across multiple locations to align with corporate operational goals.
  • Comprehensive hands-on proficiency in network infrastructure, cybersecurity (including Tanium, Crowdstrike, and Rapid7), cloud computing, and enterprise systems.
  • Extensive hands-on IT experience with hypervisor technologies (e.g., VMware ESXi/vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V) to manage and optimize virtualized server environments.
