title: Data Lead
description:
Data Lead

About Promtior

Promtior is at the forefront of the Agentic AI revolution, delivering cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses across industries — bridging technology and people to turn AI into a real competitive advantage. Since 2023, we've helped organizations boost operational efficiency through tailored Agentic AI solutions, from discovery and development to full implementation, across three core lines: AI Product Delivery (predictive analytics, intelligent automation, AI-driven chatbots, image processing), AI Department as a Service (LATAM-based teams that integrate directly with our clients' teams), and AI Adoption Consulting (helping companies find and act on AI opportunities across their business).

We're a team held together by genuine relationships, constant exchange, and shared learning. We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being.

About the Role

We're looking for a Data Lead to head our Data team within Engineering. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the technical direction for data engineering and data science work across client projects, grow the team, and stay close enough to the code to review designs and unblock production issues.

Key Responsibilities

You will lead Promtior's Data team — data engineers and data scientists — defining its technical vision, standards, and ways of working across client engagements. You will own the architecture of the data platforms we design and deliver, from ingestion and Lakehouse / Warehouse design (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent) to the curated datasets that feed analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases. You will set the team's engineering standards for data modeling, testing, CI/CD, documentation, data quality, observability, and governance, and make sure they hold in production. You will make and defend pragmatic architectural decisions, balancing performance, reliability, cost, and time to value, and explain those trade-offs to both technical and business audiences.

You will partner with clients, project managers, and AI/ML teams to translate business problems into data solutions, scope new initiatives, and participate in pre-sales and discovery when data expertise is needed. You will oversee delivery quality across projects, lead the resolution of critical production incidents, and drive root cause analysis to prevent recurrence. You will hire, mentor, and develop the team through code and design reviews, technical guidance, and career development, and you will help shape how we use AI tools to accelerate data discovery, development, and documentation.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data science, including at least 3 years leading a data team or setting technical direction for other engineers.

  • Proven track record designing and operating data platforms in production, owning them end to end, from design to post-deployment operation.

  • Advanced experience with at least one modern data platform (Databricks or Snowflake) and Lakehouse / Medallion architectures (Bronze/Silver/Gold).

  • Advanced Python and SQL for large-scale data processing.

  • Strong command of relational and analytical data modeling and Data Warehousing.

  • Experience designing ETL/ELT and incremental pipelines with orchestration and transformation tools (Airflow, dbt, or similar).

  • Experience defining standards for data quality, lineage, observability, CI/CD, and testing applied to data.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Working knowledge of the ML lifecycle and experience supporting data for AI/ML or LLM-based use cases in production.

  • Experience hiring, mentoring, and reviewing the work of data engineers or data scientists.

  • Ability to communicate architecture, trade-offs, and risks to clients and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Advanced English Level.

Especially Valued

  • Experience in a consulting or services company, leading data work across several clients or projects at once.

  • Having built a data platform or a data team from an early stage, rather than only maintaining an established one.

  • Experience with streaming and near real-time processing (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).

  • Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, feature stores, model registries).

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) applied to data platforms.

  • Experience optimizing cost and performance of large-scale data platforms (FinOps).

  • Experience modernizing legacy environments (e.g., SQL Server) toward cloud data platforms.

  • Experience in regulated or high-volume environments (fintech, payments, insurance).

  • Experience working directly with U.S. clients.

  • Official certifications (Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, or equivalent).

Benefits

  • Hybrid work model.

  • Flex Days: monthly team activities.

  • Professional development courses.

  • Internal clubs (soccer, padel, running, cinema).

  • A strong team player who naturally creates a supportive and inclusive environment.

  • Passionate about beauty, skincare, wellness and the FACEGYM concept.

WHY JOIN FACEGYM

title: Data & Governance Analyst I
description:
The Data & Governance Analyst I verifies customer integration changes in production and confirms they are working as expected before the change is signed off. This is the role that watches live orders flow after a change is deployed and identifies the problem before it becomes a support escalation or a customer complaint.

The delivery teams — New Business Onboarding, Integration Onboarding, Integration Support, and Data Integrity — own building and deploying the change. This team is the independent check that follows. Work reaches this role through JSM once a change is live; the analyst monitors it for the duration of the hypercare window, classifies any failure found, documents it clearly enough for the owning team to resolve without follow-up, and verifies the fix in production.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Governance Principles

This role applies the following principles to the integrations and data that support order creation and warehouse execution.

  • Evidence over assertion: A change clears because production behavior was observed and documented, not because the delivery team reports it is working. Every conclusion is supported by what was seen in the live system.
  • Clear accountability: Issues are returned to the team that owns the change. This role finds, documents, and re-verifies; it does not take over the correction and does not pass the work to internal support.
  • Data governance: Order-creation data — items, ship-tos, customer and account setup, cross-references — is treated as a controlled asset. A wrong record is treated with the same seriousness as bad code, because it breaks an order just as reliably.
  • Compliance and controls: Changes are verified against customer contractual commitments, retail routing guide requirements, and internal SLAs. What was checked and what was found is evidenced in the ticket so the decision can be reconstructed later.
  • Risk-based oversight: Effort is scaled to exposure. A high-volume go-live or a change touching shared master data warrants closer monitoring than an isolated, low-impact update.
  • Change and lifecycle management: No hypercare window closes with open issues unless the deferral is documented and accepted by a named owner.
  • Standardization: Verification is performed against RJW standards and approved baselines, and any customization or one-off configuration encountered is documented rather than absorbed quietly.
  • Transparency: Findings are reported plainly, including the ones that are unwelcome or that delay a closure. Raising a concern is expected and supported, including when it turns out to be nothing.

Production Monitoring During Hypercare

  • Monitor live production order flow for the full duration of assigned hypercare windows — rejects, exceptions, status progression, and order data accuracy against what the change was intended to do.
  • Verify that transactions are transmitting, translating, and posting correctly across the affected trading partners.
  • Confirm order data is landing correctly in production, including items, ship-tos, labels, MABD, and PO type.
  • Judge a change by whether the warehouse can actually fulfill against it, not only by whether the file processed.
  • Maintain the hypercare ticket with what was checked, what was found, and what remains open.

The Stage Gate

  • Apply the established verification criteria to every assigned change and confirm all criteria are satisfied in production before recommending a window for closure.
  • Return a change that has not met the standard to the owning team, with specific findings rather than a general concern.
  • Verify fixes in production and confirm the issue is fully resolved before closing.
  • Escalate to the manager any case where the criteria do not clearly apply or an exception is being requested.

Issue Identification and Documentation

  • Classify every failure as a hard fail (order rejected) or flow and fix (order passes with exception) and document the basis for the classification. An order that ships with an exception is still a finding.
  • Open defect tickets through JSM intake with reproduction steps, sample transactions, and the order, item, or customer identifiers involved.
  • Escalate issues that carry customer impact or that cannot be resolved within the hypercare window.
  • Provide failure detail that supports the RJW compliance decision on customer-caused order failures.

Process Support

  • Flag recurring failures and patterns to the manager rather than handling them one at a time.
  • Keep ticket documentation complete and current so that gate decisions are auditable after the fact.
  • Suggest improvements to monitoring checklists as new change types, trading partners, and platforms are encountered.
  • Partner with Integration Support and the onboarding teams during active hypercare, keeping communication clear and timely.

Required Qualifications

  • Third-party logistics or retail logistics experience, with a working understanding of how orders move from receipt through fulfillment and shipment.
  • Hands-on warehouse management system (WMS) experience — able to navigate order, item, and inventory data within the system to verify a change in production.
  • Ability to read a raw X12 file and identify what is incorrect in it.
  • Working knowledge of order processing and item data — items, ship-tos, labels, MABD, PO types.
  • Proficiency with a ticketing system (JSM, Zoho, ServiceNow or similar), including writing an issue that a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation.
  • Willingness to work to a defined standard and to document findings so they hold up to later review.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, sustained across repetitive monitoring work.
  • Willingness to escalate. An analyst who suspects something is wrong and says nothing is the failure this role exists to prevent.
  • Clear written communication and thorough documentation habits.
  • Must also demonstrate a sense of urgency, ownership of assigned hypercare windows, and the ability to manage several active windows at once.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years in EDI support, integration support, order management, data administration, or quality assurance within a logistics or supply chain environment.
  • SQL or equivalent ability to query live order and item data directly preferred.
  • Synapse WMS or McLeod experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with retail compliance requirements and routing guides preferred.
  • Exposure to a controlled change, audit, or quality review process preferred.

title: Lösningsarkitekt datalager och AI-integration till Svenska kraftnät
description:
Sista ansökningsdatum: 27 november

I takt med att vår IT-division på Svenska kraftnät växer ökar även enhetens uppdrag och Data- och rapportplattformen är och kommer att bli en allt viktigare del i Svenska kraftnäts satsning inom data- och AI-området. Vi söker en Lösningsarkitekt inom data och AI som vill vara med på vår datadrivna resa genom att omvandla data till värdefulla insikter och skapa lösningar som verkligen gör skillnad för hela verksamheten.

Om tjänsten

Här blir du en del av enheten Dataanalys och dataplattform, som ansvarar för att tillhandahålla plattformar för lagring, insamling, analys och delning av data, detta för att möjliggöra en säker och effektiv användning av data och information på hela myndigheten.

Enheten arbetar tvärfunktionellt enligt agila principer och består av ett engagerat team på 20 medarbetare i olika roller, bland annat arkitekter, utvecklare och IT-specialister som arbetar med applikationsdrift och support för plattformarna.

Just nu befinner vi oss i en fas där plattformen och arbetssätten moderniseras för att skapa förutsättningar för en mer effektiv och datadriven verksamhet samt möjliggöra ökad self-service och nyttja AI-förmågor i det interna arbetet med vår data lake.

I rollen som lösningsarkitekt arbetar du DevOps-baserat och ansvarar för leveransen från ax till limpa – från skiss och konceptualisering till design och implementering. Du tvekar inte att gå ned på djup teknisk detaljnivå när det krävs, alltid med fokus på smarta och förvaltningsbara lösningar. Du bidrar till att säkerställa att lösningarna möter verksamhetens behov, både nu och framåt, och att plattformarna och verktygen fungerar väl och kontinuerligt utvecklas. Du kommer även att ha ett tätt samarbete med andra enheter inom avdelningen Data & Digitalisering.

Tjänsten kommer även att innefatta:

  • Ta fram lösningsmönster med hänsyn till befintliga lösningar

  • Bidra i utvecklingen av hållbara, tillförlitliga och skalbara lösningar

  • Driva utredningar kring lösningarnas utformning, från inhämtning av data från levererande system till bearbetning, förädling och tillgängliggörande för olika konsumenter, exempelvis AI-lösningar

  • Skapa förutsättningar för bättre nyttjande av AI-förmågor

  • Ta fram tekniska designdokument och lösningsbeskrivningar

  • Driva och följa upp implementationen av tekniska lösningar

I rollen blir du en nyckelperson i att driva Svenska kraftnäts datadrivna utveckling och stärka verksamhetens förmåga att använda data som grund för beslut och insikter. Här får du goda möjligheter att påverka arbetssätt och lösningar inom givna ramar för verksamheten.

Om dig

Skallkrav

Vi söker dig som är strukturerad och analytisk, med förmåga att dra välgrundade slutsatser och navigera i komplexa datamiljöer för att omsätta dem i ändamålsenliga lösningar. Samtidigt har du ett framåtlutat arbetssätt med fokus på resultat och på att bidra till att data blir tillgänglig och skapar verklig nytta i verksamheten. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra och har lätt för att kommunicera på olika nivåer och anpassa dina resonemang efter mottagaren. Du förmedlar tekniska lösningar på ett pedagogiskt och tydligt sätt och kan både skapa samsyn och stå stadigt i dina bedömningar. I din roll möter du stora delar av verksamheten och har förmåga att lyssna in olika perspektiv och anpassa dig efter situation och behov.

Du ska också leva upp till den statliga vardegrunden. I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vidare har du en relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom Teknik, Systemvetenskap eller Datateknik, eller motsvarande utbildning och arbetslivserfarenhet som Svenska kraftnät bedömer vara likvärdig. Du har även:

  • Minst 6 års arbetslivserfarenhet av utveckling, design och arkitektur inom datalager/data warehouse/Data lake

  • Minst 4 års arbetslivserfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur inom datalager/data warehouse/Data lake

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

  • Erfarenhet av att jobba med att hantera Big-data-lösningar som bygger på kluster, t.ex. Hadoop/Cloudera

  • Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla integrationer som tillgängliggör data för AI-applikationer, exempelvis genom MCP

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med Linux, Spark och Python

  • Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med kompetenser inom infrastruktur

  • God kännedom om IT-säkerhet

  • Erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoder och verktyg

Bra att veta

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:

title: AI-kehittäjä (AI Developer)
description:
Tekoäly on Vekellä jo käytössä. Nyt haemme tekijää, joka vie sen myymälöihin, varastolle, asiakaspalveluun ja toimistolle. Ei vain suunnitelmiin, vaan ihmisten arkeen.

Etsimme hands-on AI-kehittäjää, joka jalkautuu tiimien pariin, näkee missä aikaa palaa turhaan ja rakentaa ratkaisun käyttöön asti. Et ole pelkkä konsultti, etkä pelkkä koodari. Ymmärrät työn, rakennat ratkaisun ja varmistat, että se jää elämään.

Veke yrityksenä

Lapin Ranualta ponnistanut huonekalukauppa Veke palvelee kaikkia suomalaisia, jotka viihtyvät kotona. Me ajattelemme, että huonekalut eivät saa olla ylihintaisia, tylsiä tai jonkun muun elämään suunniteltuja. Jokainen ansaitsee kodin, joka tuntuu kodilta.

Sinnikkyys, suomalaisuus ja rohkeus – niistä on Veken tarina tehty. Ranualaisesta huonekaluliikkeestä on kasvanut yksi Suomen suurimmista sisustuksen ja huonekalujen verkkokaupoista. verkkokauppamme lisäksi palvelemme asiakkaitamme seitsemässä myymälässä sekä yritysmyynnissä valtakunnallisesti.

Mitä työsi sisältää

Työsi on löytää, rakentaa ja juurruttaa. Raportoit CTO Teemu Räsäselle ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä IT:n sekä liiketoimintayksiköiden kanssa.

  • Löydät hyödyn. Istut tiimien kanssa, kartoitat pullonkaulat ja valitset kokeilut, joista syntyy näkyvä tulos viikoissa, ei kvartaaleissa.

  • Rakennat itse. Teet agentteja, skillejä, plugineja ja automaatioita. Sinun ei tarvitse olla ohjelmistokehittäjä, mutta ohjaat Claude Codea ja muita AI-työkaluja kuin tekninen tekijä.

  • Kytket datan hallitusti. Tiedät, miten MCP:t, API:t ja CLI:t istuvat eri yksiköiden työhön, mitä kannattaa ajaa lokaalisti ja mikä kuuluu pilveen. Huolehdit myös että tietoturva ja käyttöoikeudet pysyvät kunnossa.

  • Viet projektit maaliin. Kun tarvitaan IT:n tai kumppaneiden apua, koordinoit työn niin ettei pallo putoa.

  • Juurrutat ratkaisut arkeen. Koulutat pääkäyttäjät, jätät selkeät ohjeet ja seuraat käyttöä, säästettyä työaikaa ja laatua.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Tärkeintä on, että olet jo rakentanut jotain itse. Tutkinto tai titteli ei ratkaise.

  • Vahvaa omakohtaista kokemusta AI-työkaluilla rakentamisesta (esim. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, agentit, automaatiotyökalut)

  • Ymmärrystä integraatioista, rajapinnoista ja datan liikkumisesta järjestelmien välillä

  • Kykyä kääntää arjen ongelma konkreettiseksi ratkaisuksi kysymällä ensin oikeat kysymykset

  • Vahvaa projektinhallinnan otetta. Viet asiat maaliin useamman sidosryhmän kanssa

  • Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Saat muutkin innostumaan ja onnistumaan

  • Oma-aloitteisuutta, kokeilunhalua ja nälkää oppia jatkuvasti uutta

  • Sujuvaa suomen kieltä

Eduksi katsotaan kokemus vähittäiskaupasta, verkkokaupasta tai logistiikasta.

Mitä tarjoamme

  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa aidosti. Pääset kehittämään tekoälyratkaisuja, jotka muuttavat koko yrityksen arkea ja joiden tulokset näet nopeasti käytännössä.

  • Vapautta ja vastuuta. Pääset itse vaikuttamaan siihen, mitä kehitetään ja miten. Meillä päätökset tehdään nopeasti ja ideat viedään ripeästi käytäntöön.

  • Johdon vahvan tuen ja nykyaikaiset työkalut. Tekoälyn hyödyntäminen on meille strateginen kehityskohde, johon haluamme panostaa.

  • Paikan kasvavassa suomalaisessa yrityksessä. Saat ympärillesi osaavan ja kannustavan tiimin, jossa arvostetaan ihmisiä ja yhdessä onnistumista.

  • Hyvät henkilökuntaedut ja mukavan työyhteisön. Panostamme henkilöstömme hyvinvointiin ja mittaamme sitä säännöllisesti. Työelämän laatua kuvaava QWL-indeksimme oli 82,5 keväällä 2026, mikä on erinomainen tulos.

Käytännön tiedot ja hakeminen

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
ABOUT AARKE

Aarke is a Swedish design company redefining everyday kitchen appliances. Founded in 2013, we started with a carbonator and have since taken over the kitchen countertop, turning cheap plastic products into steel design built to last. We are now a 500 MSEK company, present in more than 30 countries globally.

Growth like that puts logistics at the centre. More markets, more sales channels and new product categories all depend on a supply chain that is reliable, cost-efficient and ready to scale. We're building a scalable premium company, where you take ownership of your area, pitch in wherever needed and thrive in a positive, fast-moving culture.

THE POSITION

As Logistics Specialist, you run our warehousing operations in Europe and the UK and act as the daily link to our 3PL warehouses in Sweden and the UK. You know what's arriving, what's on the shelf and what needs to go out, and you make sure it happens on time. When something goes wrong, you decide, act and follow through. You also support transport across Europe and the UK, and you understand how every logistics decision affects cost, inventory and margin. You report to the Head of Logistics within the Operations department, headed by our COO, and work closely with Supply & Production, Sales, Sales Support, Customer Experience and Finance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Run warehousing operations in Sweden and the UK

  • Manage daily communication with our 3PL warehouses and be their go-to contact at Aarke: answer questions, make day-to-day decisions and keep goods moving without delay

  • Plan and coordinate incoming deliveries, check receipts and resolve discrepancies

  • Follow up on warehouse performance: receiving lead times, inventory accuracy, picking accuracy and on-time shipping

  • Support cycle counts, stock adjustments and reconciliation between the warehouse system and our ERP

  • Coordinate value-added work at the warehouse, such as kitting, relabelling and rework, as well as transfers between warehouses

  • Monitor stock levels and identify shortages and excess inventory, supporting product availability while keeping inventory investment under control

  • Compare freight quotes and coordinate approved shipments

  • Prepare and check shipping documents, and track deliveries through to warehouse receipt

  • Check that warehouse invoices and freight costs match agreed rates

  • Work closely with the Head of Logistics and your Logistics teammates to ensure smooth product flows from inbound to delivery

Data, launches and improvement

  • Keep product, logistics and inventory data accurate

  • Coordinate launch timelines with Sales, Marketing, Product Development and Finance

  • Spot manual, repetitive work and help automate it, using AI tools where they make a difference

WHO WE ARE

You're a hands-on operator who moves quickly and doesn't let things drift. You know how a warehouse works and you're comfortable making quick decisions with the information you have. You are organised and detailed, at home in a spreadsheet, and persistent about following things through. You communicate clearly with partners and colleagues, and you raise issues early rather than late. You see the whole flow, not just the next shipment, and you understand what each decision costs.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Proven experience with warehouse operations and daily cooperation with 3PL partners

  • A solid understanding of end-to-end product flows, from producer through transport and warehouse to customer, and of the operations around them

  • Commercial and financial awareness: you understand how logistics decisions affect cost, inventory value, cash flow and margin

  • Experience with warehouse systems (WMS) and an ERP; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage

  • Confident in Excel: lookups, pivot tables and reconciling data across sources

  • Familiarity with retailer delivery requirements or Amazon inbound is an advantage

  • Comfortable using AI tools in your daily work, and checking what they produce

  • Cross-functional teamwork skills

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken; Swedish is a plus

WHY AARKE?

Aarke was founded in Stockholm to make everyday rituals a little better, with products designed to perform and made to last. Today our products are sold around the world, yet the team behind them is still small enough that your work is visible from day one.

In this role you'll have real ownership. You'll shape how our warehousing runs in Europe and the UK, and your decisions will show up directly in what our customers experience. You'll work with people who care about getting the details right, in a company where good ideas move quickly from suggestion to practice. If you enjoy seeing the whole picture and making it run a little better every week, you'll fit right in.

WHAT NOW?

Please submit your application through career.aarke.com/jobs. We review applications continuously.

For questions about the process, please contact Anna Korling (Chief People Officer) at anna@aarke.com.

title: Technical Trainer - Sioux Falls, SD
location: Sioux Falls, South Dakota, United States
description:
Job Summary:

As a Technical Trainer, your primary purpose is to deliver effective training programs across multiple locations, enhancing service quality and customer satisfaction. This role involves mentoring team members, promoting best practices, fostering collaboration with field leadership teams, and ensuring quality assurance through program evaluation and detailed reporting.

This position can be located within 30 miles of the Sioux Falls System.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and deliver successful training courses across multiple locations, supporting a wide range of service components, products, and customer service objectives to ensure the effective delivery of training programs.
  • Promote and train best practices to raise overall quality and enhance customer satisfaction by mentoring team members and emphasizing uniformity.
  • Foster strong partnerships with the field leadership teams by providing value through the support to your assigned technical operations centers to enhance collaboration and teamwork.
  • Evaluate existing programs using diverse resources to assess their value and relevance to meet current needs.
  • Design and implement follow-up/reinforcement activities and methodologies to strengthen and sustain knowledge gained.
  • Mentor and report quality assurance of installation, repair, and maintenance.
  • Collaborate with fellow Technical Trainers to coordinate and ensure comprehensive training coverage, guaranteeing all team members receive the necessary instruction and support to excel in their roles.
  • Produce comprehensive reports on a regular basis detailing field feedback, and training insights, aiding in the growth and effectiveness of the Technical Training team.
  • Deliver training sessions to various group sizes, including one-on-one meetings, small team gatherings, and large team meetings with over 100 participants.
  • Partner with the Instructional Designers to continuously evolve and enhance internal training programs, ensuring they effectively address and meet the evolving needs of our team members.
  • Efficiently manage and prioritize schedules to ensure timely completion of tasks, while adapting to ongoing changes and unforeseen challenges to maintain productivity and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of Midco’s safety program by enforcing safety rules and procedures, wearing appropriate safety apparel (e.g., safety helmets and vests, OSHA-approved boots), and operating all equipment safely.
  • Operate and drive a company vehicle in compliance with all Midco policies and procedures, ensuring safety, efficiency, and adherence to traffic laws. Maintain vehicle cleanliness and ensure regular maintenance and repairs are conducted as scheduled to uphold a professional image
  • Model Midco’s mission, vision, values, ethos, and Leadership Success Drivers, and inspire others to do the same.
  • Ensure customer privacy by adhering to Midco’s privacy guidelines while actively following Midco policies and procedures.
  • Maintain reliable and predictable attendance as required by the position.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Note: Management reserves the right to assign or reassign functions and responsibilities to this job description at any time.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent (GED).
  • 3 years of experience in telecommunications operations, technical field services, quality assurance, training, or a related technical role.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills.
  • Must have excellent active listening, conflict management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license with a clean driving record. A DUI conviction within the past 5 years will result in disqualification from employment in this position.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate’s degree with a focus in Communications, Business, or Sales.
  • Prior experience in a training role.

Work Environment:

  • In-person visits to a customer’s home or place of business are common. Specific abilities required include accessing a customer's home or place of business by stairs or elevator, operating doors or other entrances, and navigating hallways and buildings.
  • The noise level in the work environment is moderate to loud.
  • Frequent exposure to outside weather conditions.
  • Occasional exposure to moving mechanical parts, high, precarious places, risk of electrical shock, and risk of radiation and vibration.
  • May be required to work in excess of 40 hours per week and outside normal business hours, such as holidays, evenings, and weekends, as business demands.
  • Must be prepared to travel and work extended, flexible hours.

Physical Demands:

  • Be able to safely use a ladder rated for a maximum load of 375 lbs., including the combined weight of the individual, fall protection equipment, and any tools being carried.
  • Required to reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, or crouch.
  • Must occasionally lift and carry loads up to 80 lbs. and separately handle a 75 lbs. ladder.
  • Must be able to climb poles, ladders, bucket trucks, and other structures with proper fall protection equipment, adhering to the manufacturer's capacity for all equipment.
  • Must be able to work from elevated heights (bucket trucks, aerial lifts) and in tight spaces such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Bucket trucks have a maximum load capacity ranging from 300 to 400 lbs. based on the manufacturer's specifications for each vehicle. Team members certified for bucket truck use are responsible for being aware of and adhering to these maximum load requirements.
  • Drivers required to operate a Commercial Motor Vehicle (CMV) as a part of their role (e.g., bucket truck, truck/trailer combo) will need to be DOT qualified.

Mental Demands:

  • Ability to clearly and effectively convey complex technical information to diverse audiences.
  • Willingness to adapt methods and materials to suit different learning styles and environments.
  • Aptitude for identifying issues and developing practical solutions during training sessions.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the needs and concerns of others to provide support and encouragement.

title: Bedrock: Director of Manufacturing
description:
Director of Manufacturing

Do you thrive on leading manufacturing teams to deliver quality products on schedule?

Are you passionate about Lean Manufacturing and developing high-performing leaders?

Does working for a family-centric company with deep roots appeal to you?

Do the values of stewardship, versatility, and family resonate strongly with you?

Do you find the improvement of people’s lives through stewardship of God-given resources inspiring?

Then Bedrock Truck Beds is right for you!

Department: Manufacturing / Operations | Primary Location: Shiner, Texas | Reports To: President

Director of Manufacturing Job Summary

The Director of Manufacturing is responsible for leading and optimizing manufacturing operations across the Shiner and Beeville facilities, overseeing flatbed production, the flatbed finishing line, and Manufacturing Engineering. This position is accountable for achieving production goals, improving operational efficiency, maintaining product quality, ensuring employee safety, controlling manufacturing costs, and delivering products on schedule.

The Director will lead manufacturing and engineering teams to establish consistent processes, improve product manufacturability, implement Lean Manufacturing principles, and drive continuous improvement across both facilities. This individual must be a hands-on, results-oriented leader with a strong background in metal fabrication, welding, assembly, finishing operations, manufacturing engineering, and multi-facility leadership.


Director of Manufacturing Responsibilities:


Manufacturing Operations and Production

  • Direct manufacturing operations at both Shiner and Beeville facilities.
  • Oversee flatbed fabrication, welding, assembly, finishing, and final inspection.
  • Manage the flatbed finishing line to ensure proper workflow, production capacity, quality, and on-time completion.
  • Establish production schedules and ensure manufacturing resources align with customer demand.
  • Balance workloads, staffing, equipment, and production capacity between facilities.
  • Standardize processes and best practices across both locations.
  • Eliminate bottlenecks, downtime, rework, and inefficient use of labor and materials.

Manufacturing Engineering Leadership

  • Direct and develop the Manufacturing Engineering team, establishing priorities, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
  • Ensure Manufacturing Engineering supports production objectives, quality, cost reduction, and capacity improvements.
  • Lead the development and implementation of standardized work instructions, process documentation, production layouts, and manufacturing methods.
  • Drive improvements in fabrication, welding, assembly, tooling, fixtures, automation, and finishing processes.
  • Partner with Design Engineering to improve design for manufacturability, simplify production, and reduce manufacturing costs.
  • Lead engineering projects that improve labor productivity, product consistency, throughput, and equipment utilization.
  • Evaluate and implement new manufacturing technologies, equipment, tooling, and automation.
  • Establish engineering standards and ensure successful implementation of process changes across both facilities.
  • Use data, time studies, and root-cause analysis to identify opportunities for measurable improvement.

Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing development of Lean Manufacturing practices across both facilities.
  • Establish a culture of continuous improvement, waste elimination, and employee involvement.
  • Apply Lean tools such as 6S, standard work, value stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, and Kaizen events.
  • Improve production flow, reduce work-in-process inventory, shorten lead times, and eliminate non-value-added activities.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks throughout fabrication, welding, assembly, and finishing.
  • Implement labor standards, cycle-time measurements, and productivity metrics where appropriate.
  • Train and coach manufacturing leaders and employees in Lean principles and problem-solving methods.
  • Track and verify improvements in productivity, quality, cost, and delivery performance.

Leadership and Workforce Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop managers, production supervisors, and Manufacturing Engineering personnel.
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability for performance across manufacturing and engineering.
  • Build a culture focused on safety, quality, teamwork, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure adequate staffing, technical training, cross-training, and succession planning.
  • Develop capable leaders who can manage daily operations while driving consistent results.

Quality, Safety, and Compliance

  • Establish and maintain quality standards for flatbed manufacturing and finishing operations.
  • Reduce defects, scrap, rework, warranty claims, and customer complaints.
  • Ensure corrective actions address root causes and prevent recurring issues.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable OSHA requirements and environmental regulations.
  • Promote safe work practices in welding, cutting, grinding, material handling, finishing, and equipment operation.
  • Hold manufacturing and engineering leaders accountable for safety and quality performance.

Cost and Budget Management

  • Develop and manage manufacturing and Manufacturing Engineering budgets.
  • Monitor labor productivity, material usage, scrap, rework, overtime, and manufacturing cost per unit.
  • Lead cost-reduction initiatives without compromising safety or product quality.
  • Evaluate capital investments in equipment, tooling, automation, and facility improvements.
  • Partner with Purchasing and other departments to improve operating performance and reduce material cost.

Materials, Maintenance, and Supply Chain Coordination

  • Coordinate with Purchasing and Planning to ensure material availability.
  • Align production schedules with inventory, labor, equipment, and shipping capacity.
  • Ensure preventive maintenance supports equipment reliability and minimizes downtime.
  • Coordinate finished-product flow through shipping.

Performance Management and Reporting

  • Establish and maintain consistent KPIs for both facilities and Manufacturing Engineering.
  • Conduct regular reviews of safety, quality, production, delivery, cost, and engineering performance.
  • Report results, risks, and improvement initiatives to executive leadership.
  • Use data-driven decision-making to prioritize projects and measure results.
  • Ensure accountability for improvement initiatives and expected business outcomes.
  • All other duties as assigned by management.

Director of Manufacturing Skills and Competencies

  • Strong analytical, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, production reporting, and Microsoft Office or comparable tools.

Director of Manufacturing Qualifications

  • 7–10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, preferably in metal fabrication, welding, assembly, or industrial manufacturing.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing Lean Manufacturing principles and delivering measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost, and lead time.
  • Experience leading Manufacturing Engineering, production operations, and multiple manufacturing departments or facilities.
  • Strong understanding of fabrication, welding, assembly, finishing, production scheduling, and manufacturing processes.
  • Proven ability to improve manufacturing flow, eliminate waste, and increase labor productivity.
  • Experience with Lean tools such as 6S, Kaizen, value stream mapping, standard work, visual management, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience leading and developing managers, production supervisors, manufacturing engineers, and hourly employees.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing process development, tooling, fixtures, automation, and design for manufacturability.
  • Experience managing budgets, capital projects, production capacity, and manufacturing cost controls.
  • Ability to travel occasionally between Shiner and Beeville (approximately 90% Shiner / 10% Beeville).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Experience in truck equipment, commercial vehicle upfitting, agricultural equipment, or heavy metal fabrication.
  • Lean certification or formal Lean training, such as Lean Six Sigma, is a plus.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve walking and standing in manufacturing areas and using required personal protective equipment.


Work Environment

Manufacturing and office environments, with regular presence on production floors. Primary location is Shiner, with occasional visits to Beeville.


Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Profit Sharing
  • Counseling

title: PATIENT REGISTRATION SPEC
description:
Overview

Patient Registration Specialist, Admitting and Registration

Full Time, 80 Hours Per Pay Period, Day Shift

Parkwest Overview:

Parkwest Medical Center, Covenant Health’s flagship facility in West Knoxville, combines world-class cardiac expertise with the warmth of home in serving a vibrant East Tennessee community. Since 1973, Parkwest has grown into the region’s largest hospital in the area, offering advanced services like an all-digital catheterization lab, comprehensive breast health, emergency, and critical care. It’s consistently ranked among Tennessee's top 10 hospitals by U.S. News & World Report and earns national recognition as a Top 100 Heart Hospital, as well as an “A” safety grade from Leapfrog. As part of Covenant Health, the region’s largest employer, Parkwest Medical Center, marries cutting-edge technology with compassionate, community-centered care, earning accolades for cardiology, stroke, surgical excellence, and patient safety.

To learn more about Parkwest Medical Center and our units, visit Covenant Health Parkwest Medical Center Opportunities.

Position Summary:

Coordinates the centralized scheduling of all outpatient diagnostic and surgical procedures. Accurate collection and data entry of the required financial and demographic information for all patients registered to our facility. Ensures verification of benefits and pre-certification requirements are met prior to scheduled appointment/admission. Follows up as necessary on all urgent or unscheduled registrations for consistency in the process. Establishes controls so unscheduled patients understand and receive accurate information on their patient liability.

Responsibilities

  • Collects co-payments/deposits based on verification information obtained, generates receipts to the payer, and delivers all cash transactions to the cashier for proper posting to the patient account.
  • Maintains strict confidentially of patient information.
  • Recommends to the Coordinator updates to existing policies and procedures that support our values and are intended to increase efficiency and promote data integrity.
  • Notifies the Financial Counselor immediately upon scheduling or registering any potential self pay, worker’s compensation patient, or any non-covered procedures.
  • Makes patient type changes based on information given from Medical Records Staff and/or Care Coordinators, ensuring documentation is present in the medical record to support the change.
  • Ensures all reservations are properly documented to support departmental statistics. Enters faxed reservations into the HBOC scheduling system.
  • Schedules operative and diagnostic procedures utilizing the HBOC scheduling system. Documents each scheduled procedure/event with detailed information. Notifies departments of any special resources required for procedure/event.
  • Verifies insurance benefits and obtains pre-certification from various third-party payers. Has extensive knowledge of insurance plan requirements. Provides necessary documentation to DHS and Med Assist staff for patients potentially in need of financial assistance or TennCare enrollment.
  • Efficiently gathers all demographic, medical, and financial information for scheduling, registration, and verification of patient accounts utilizing the HBOC computer system to record data. Enters verification and pre-certification notes into SMS financial system as cross-reference.
  • Participates with clinical and care management areas to address opportunities to improve overall collections and cash flow.
  • Analyzes claims denial data for opportunities to achieve improved collections, enhance relations with insurance companies and physician practices, and improve workflow process.
  • Reports pertinent procedural changes/updates to appropriate leadership.
  • Professionally deals with patients, physicians, visitors, and other hospital staff members.
  • Demonstrates ability to keep abreast of regulatory and insurance requirements ensuring that changes are incorporated in daily job functions.
  • Assures the registration process is handled in a professional manner, maintaining registration accuracy rate of 95 to 100 percent.
  • Explains a variety of necessary information to the patient/family member, such as: consent for treatment, advance directives, medical/financial release, deposit requirements, billing and payment polices, and advanced beneficiary notices.
  • Recognizes situations that necessitate supervision, seeking appropriate resources.
  • Directs, escorts, and/or provides wheelchair assistance to the patient upon completion of the registration process to the appropriate nursing unit or diagnostic testing area.
  • Performs pre-registration process by utilization of phone and mail techniques, advising the patient during the conversation of any co-pay or deductible amounts due upon admission.
  • Maintains an accurate bed board, utilizing the computerized bed tracking system, so wait times for admitted patients are kept to a minimum.
  • Coordinates with Nursing Services the flow of inpatient and observation patient admissions.
  • Displays competence in use of all Information Computer Systems that supply information regarding patient registration and scheduling (DeRoyal, HBOC, Account Link and Medifax).
  • Updates schedules daily of unexpected procedures, cancellations, or changes and communicates with all individuals affected by revisions.
  • Shows initiative to cross-train in all duties related to; scheduling, registration, verification, and pre-certification.
  • Prepares the patient account folder by scanning all vital registration/scheduling/verification documents into the optical imaging system. Examples of documents: insurance cards, financial agreements, ER charge sheets, verification sheets, pre-certification letters and physician orders. Will also index the document(s) using the optical scanning system, placing the document(s) in the correct electronic file folder.
  • Demonstrates the ability to handle varying tasks and setting priorities.
  • Activates manual systems for computer network downtime, printing schedules in advance when necessary. Notifies leadership of unscheduled downtime occurrences.
  • Coordinates scheduling of classrooms for meetings, conferences, etc., ensuring confirmation is provided for the correct date and time.
  • Follows policies, procedures, and safety standards. Completes required education assignments annually. Works toward achieving goals and objectives, and participates in quality improvement initiatives as requested.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Education:

Non specified; will accept any combination of formal education and/or prior work experience sufficient to demonstrate possession of the knowledge, skill, and ability needed to perform the essential tasks of the job, typically such as would be equivalent to a high school diploma or GED. Preference may be given to individuals possessing a Bachelor’s degree in a directly-related field from an accredited college or university.

Minimum Experience:

One (1) year experience in a hospital or financial setting OR minimum three (3) years of total customer facing/customer service experience required.

Licensure Requirement:

None.

title: Person In Charge (PIC)
description:

During the absence of the Store Manager and the First & Second Assistant Managers, the PIC is in charge of the store, with analogous authority to make necessary decisions to operate the store at maximum profit, efficiency, and superior customer service. When in charge of the store (generally at night) the PIC will supervise the store employees. The PIC also acts as a Cashier-Checker (see job description). May be required to work in many of the departments within the store.

  • Supervises the sales floor to monitor service and replenishment of products.

  • Replaces stock in displays surrounding the checkout area.

All store employees during the absence of the Store Director or Assistant Store Director.

Varies depending on store location and state/county requirements.

six-wheeled cart, grocery cart, box cutter, pens and pencils, spray bottle, rags, mops, broom, telephone/intercom, cash register, credit card scanner, computer, pallet jack, bailer

title: Rakennuspeltiseppä
description:
Rakennuspeltiseppä tässä se on! Tilaisuutesi tulla vahvistamaan Oulun toimipisteemme asennustoimintaa.

Teemme kattoremontteja omakotitaloihin ja taloyhtiöihin suunnitelmallisesti, turvallisesti ja laadukkaasti ympäri vuoden. Jokainen tiimin jäsen kantaa vastuunsa siitä, että työ etenee sovitusti ja asiakkaalle luvattu lopputulos toteutuu.

Tulet mukaan kattoremontin loppuvaiheessa ja viimeistelet katon yhdessä työparisi kanssa. Työhösi kuuluvat peltityöt sekä kattoturvatuotteiden ja sadevesijärjestelmien asennukset. Kohteet vaihtelevat, joten työssä tarvitaan kädentaitoja, tarkkuutta ja silmää hyvälle työnjäljelle sekä kykyä ratkaista tilanteita kohteen mukaan.

Päivä alkaa yhteisellä lähdöllä hallilta, josta suuntaamme kohteeseen. Videolla näet, miten kattoremontti etenee kattoasentajien työvaiheista peltisepän viimeistelytöihin. Tsekkaa, miltä arkemme katolla näyttää 👇

Miksi tulisit työkaveriksemme?

🏠 Saat tehdä työtä, josta voi olla ylpeä: Toteutamme asiakkaidemme odottamia kattoremontteja laadukkaasti. Meillä myynti luottaa asennuksen työjälkeen ja asennus siihen, että asiakas on kohdattu oikein alusta asti.

💰 Selkeät tavoitteet ja palkitseva palkkamalli: Tiedät, mitä sinulta odotetaan määrällisesti ja laadullisesti. Kun tavoitteisiin päästään, se näkyy myös palkassasi.

🤝 Hyvä työnjohto ja toimiva arki: Satsaamme hyvään johtamiseen, työn kehittämiseen ja siihen, että työmaalla on hyvä tekemisen meininki.

👷‍♂️ Työturvallisuus on osa jokapäiväistä tekemistämme: Käytämme asianmukaisia työvälineitä ja pidämme huolta sekä omasta että työkaverin turvallisuudesta.

🌟 Great Place to Work® -sertifioitu työpaikka jo viidettä kertaa peräkkäin.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Meille on tärkeää, että sinulla on jo kokemusta katto- tai sadevesijärjestelmien asennuksista.

  • Kokemuksesi näkyy varmuutena tekemisessä, mutta myös järjestelmällisenä työskentelyotteena.

  • Ymmärrät, että suunnitelmallisuudella ja yhdessä tekemällä vaikutat työkuormaan.

  • Ahkeruus ja periksiantamattomuus ovat myös kuvaavia luonteenpiirteitäsi. Hyvä fyysinen kunto on iso etu.

  • Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

  • B-ajokorttia tarvitset työssä, C-korttikaan ei ole pahitteeksi.

Miltä vaikutti? Haluatko pukea meidän paitamme päällesi?

Jos kiinnostuksesi heräsi, olisi hienoa jutella kanssasi lisää. Tutustutaan puolin ja toisin!

Voit olla suoraan yhteydessä työnjohtajaamme Simeoniin p. 050 513 3123, simeon.heide@kattokeskus.fi taikka tuotantojohtajaamme Sampoon p. 050 4779 277 tai sampo.korkatti@kattokeskus.fi. Simeon ja Sampo kertovat mielellään rakennuspeltisepän työstä ja meillä työskentelystä.

Voit myös hakea suoraan tähän tehtävään oheisen painikkeen kautta. Hakeminen ei kestä kauaa. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti ja palkkauspäätöksessäkin voimme olla ripeitä. Älä siis suotta odottele viime hetkeen asti. Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Haku päättyy 15.11.2026.

Tsekkaa somesta, miltä arkemme näyttää! 👉
Instagram @kattokeskusduuni
TikTok @kattokeskus

Kuka etsii?

Kattokeskus on vuonna 1997 perustettu perheyritys, joka on vuosien myötä kasvanut yli 280 henkeä työllistäväksi ja kahdeksassa toimipisteessä toimivaksi joukkueeksi.

Tavoitteenamme on parantaa ihmisten asumisolosuhteita korkealaatuisella palvelulla ja huolehtimalla kattojen kunnosta tarjoamalla asiakkaillemme huolettomimpia ja luotettavimpia kattoremontteja, kattojen huoltoja ja aurinkopaneeliasennuksia. Visionamme on olla toimialan edelläkävijä sekä halutuin työnantaja ja kumppani asiakkaille.

Meillä avoimuus, tavoitteellisuus ja ilo ovat keskiössä. Kannustamme suoraan ja rehelliseen kommunikointiin. Tavoitteet ohjaavat työtämme, ja keskitymme järkevään ajankäyttöön ja korkeaan laatuun. Työympäristömme on positiivinen ja innostava, jossa jokainen voi loistaa. Johto näyttää esimerkkiä, kunnioittaa ja kuuntelee tiimiä, samalla kun arvostamme ja autamme toisiamme tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa.

Olemme Great Place to Work® -sertifioitu työpaikka jo viidettä kertaa peräkkäin. Great Place to Work®:n Trust Index ©-henkilöstötutkimus toteutettiin viimeksi lokakuussa 2025 ja siihen vastasi 69 % tiimistämme. Vastaajista 85 % oli sitä mieltä, että Kattokeskus on kokonaisuudessaan todella hyvä työpaikka. Kattokeskus sijoittui myös yhdeksänneksi Suomen Parhaat Työpaikat™ 2026 -listalla yli 250 henkilön organisaatioiden sarjassa.

title: Data & Governance Analyst II
description:
The Data & Governance Analyst II verifies customer integration changes in production and confirms they are working as expected before the change is signed off. Work reaches this role through JSM once a change is live. The delivery teams — New Business Onboarding, Integration Onboarding, Integration Support, and Data Integrity — own building and deploying the change; this team is the independent check that follows.

The Analyst II carries the changes with the highest risk and the least precedent — new customer go-lives, multi-partner and multi-site changes, and issues that span more than one system. Where an Analyst I works a defined standard against a known change type, the Analyst II determines what needs to be verified when no criteria exist yet, investigates root cause rather than reporting symptoms, and serves as the technical point of reference for the rest of the team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Governance Principles

This role applies the following principles to the integrations and data that support order creation and warehouse execution.

  • Evidence over assertion: A change clears because production behavior was observed and documented, not because the delivery team reports it is working. Every conclusion is supported by what was seen in the live system.
  • Clear accountability: Issues are returned to the team that owns the change. This role finds, documents, and re-verifies; it does not take over the correction and does not pass the work to internal support.
  • Data governance: Order-creation data — items, ship-tos, customer and account setup, cross-references — is treated as a controlled asset. A wrong record is treated with the same seriousness as bad code, because it breaks an order just as reliably.
  • Compliance and controls: Changes are verified against customer contractual commitments, retail routing guide requirements, and internal SLAs. What was checked and what was found is evidenced in the ticket so the decision can be reconstructed later.
  • Risk-based oversight: Effort is scaled to exposure. A high-volume go-live or a change touching shared master data warrants closer monitoring than an isolated, low-impact update.
  • Change and lifecycle management: No hypercare window closes with open issues unless the deferral is documented and accepted by a named owner.
  • Standardization: Verification is performed against RJW standards and approved baselines, and any customization or one-off configuration encountered is documented rather than absorbed quietly.
  • Transparency: Findings are reported plainly, including the ones that are unwelcome or that delay a closure. Raising a concern is expected and supported, including when it turns out to be nothing.

Production Monitoring During Hypercare

  • Own hypercare monitoring for the team’s highest-risk changes — new customer go-lives, multi-partner and multi-site changes, and changes affecting high-volume accounts or shared master data.
  • Monitor live production order flow for the full duration of the hypercare window — rejects, exceptions, status progression, and order data accuracy against what the change was intended to do.
  • Determine what must be verified on a change type with no established criteria, and document it so it is repeatable.
  • Verify that transactions are transmitting, translating, and posting correctly across all affected trading partners and facilities.
  • Judge a change by whether the warehouse can actually fulfill against it, not only by whether the file processed.
  • Carry several active hypercare windows concurrently and prioritize across them by customer impact.

Investigation and Root Cause

  • Investigate failures to root cause across EDI, order data, item setup, and warehouse system behavior, rather than reporting the symptom and handing it off.
  • Query order and item data directly to isolate whether a failure originates in the map, the order data, the item or account setup, or downstream processing.
  • Reproduce intermittent and partial failures, including those affecting only a subset of orders, partners, or locations.
  • Distinguish a defect in the change from a pre-existing condition or a customer-caused failure, and document the basis for that call.
  • Identify where a change has introduced undocumented variation from RJW standards and raise it rather than absorbing it.

The Stage Gate

  • Confirm all criteria are satisfied in production before recommending a hypercare window for closure.
  • Return a change that has not met the standard to the owning team with specific, reproducible findings, and hold that position under schedule pressure.
  • Classify every failure as a hard fail (order rejected) or flow and fix (order passes with exception) and document the basis for the classification.
  • Open defect tickets through JSM intake with reproduction steps, sample transactions, and the order, item, or customer identifiers involved.
  • Verify fixes in production and confirm the issue is fully resolved before closing.
  • Ensure the ticket carries an auditable record of what was checked, what was found, and who accepted any exception.

Team and Process Contribution

  • Serve as the technical point of reference for Analyst I peers on difficult failures and unfamiliar change types.
  • Mentor and onboard new analysts; review their findings and coach on monitoring depth and issue documentation.
  • Draft and maintain verification criteria and checklists as new change types, trading partners, and platforms are introduced.
  • Provide operational input into the standard and JSM workflow refinement based on what is actually failing in production.
  • Identify recurring failure patterns and bring them to the manager with supporting evidence.

Escalation and Representation

  • Escalate issues carrying customer impact, and those that cannot be resolved within the hypercare window, with a clear recommendation.
  • Supply failure detail that supports the RJW compliance decision on customer-caused order failures.
  • Represent the team directly with delivery teams and, where required, with the customer during an active hypercare window.

Required Qualifications

  • Third-party logistics or retail logistics experience, with a working understanding of how orders move from receipt through fulfillment and shipment.
  • Hands-on warehouse management system (WMS) experience — able to navigate order, item, and inventory data within the system to verify a change in production.
  • Ability to read a raw X12 file, identify what is incorrect in it, and trace the error back to its source.
  • SQL proficiency sufficient to query live order and item data independently.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot a production failure to root cause across more than one system.
  • Working knowledge of order processing and item data — items, ship-tos, labels, MABD, PO types.
  • Proficiency with a ticketing system (JSM, Zoho, ServiceNow or similar), including writing an issue that a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation.
  • Ability to maintain a finding under pressure and to document decisions and exceptions so they stand up to later review.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, sustained across repetitive monitoring work.
  • Ability to work independently on high-risk changes with limited direction.
  • Clear written communication, thorough documentation habits, and the ability to explain a technical failure to a non-technical audience.
  • Must also demonstrate a sense of urgency and ownership of assigned hypercare windows.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years in EDI support, integration support, order management, data administration, or quality assurance within a logistics or supply chain environment.
  • Synapse WMS or McLeod experience preferred.
  • Experience monitoring production systems or working a hypercare / go-live support window preferred.
  • Familiarity with retail compliance requirements and routing guides preferred.
  • Experience in a controlled change, audit, controls, or independent review process preferred.
  • Prior experience mentoring or training analysts preferred.

Det stiller store krav til gode anskaffelsesprosesser, solide kommersielle vurderinger og profesjonell oppfølging av kontrakter og leverandører. Du får en sentral rolle i å støtte prosjekt- og driftsorganisasjonen i Skagerak Energi og våre datterselskaper, samtidig som du bidrar til videreutvikling av anskaffelsesprosessene våre.

Stillingen har kontorplass ved vårt hovedkontor i Porsgrunn.

Hva vil du jobbe med hos oss?

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være å:

  • planlegge og gjennomføre anskaffelser til prosjekter og drift

  • gjennomføre kommersielle vurderinger og forhandlinger

  • følge opp kontrakter og leverandører

  • gi operativ anskaffelsesfaglig støtte til driftsorganisasjonen og prosjekter

  • bidra til gode og effektive anskaffelsesprosesser

  • drive forbedrings- og utviklingsarbeid innen anskaffelsesfaget

Rollen gir deg mulighet til å kombinere operativt anskaffelsesarbeid med faglig utvikling i en virksomhet med et betydelig investeringsnivå i årene fremover.

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som har et sterkt engasjement for faget og som trives med å ta ansvar. Du har god kommersiell forståelse og evner å se helheten i anskaffelsesprosesser. Du er initiativrik og liker å finne løsninger, samtidig som du jobber strukturert og ryddig.

Du kommuniserer klart og effektivt, både skriftlig og muntlig, og samarbeider godt med kolleger på tvers av fagområder. Du er nysgjerrig og åpen for nye måter å jobbe på, og du bidrar aktivt til utvikling og forbedring i teamet.

Vi ser også for oss at du har:

  • bachelor- eller mastergrad innen ingeniørfag, økonomi eller juss

  • betydelig erfaring med anskaffelser i prosjekter

  • erfaring med forhandlinger og kontraktsoppfølging i prosjekt

  • kjennskap til kontraktsstandarder som NS og KOLEMO

  • god kommersiell forståelse

  • relevant erfaring fra energi, infrastruktur, industri eller offshore er ønskelig

  • erfaring med anskaffelser innen elektro/mekaniske leveranser og bygg og anlegg er en fordel

  • god digital forståelse, og bruker systemer og digitale verktøy effektivt

Hva tilbyr vi?

  • Utvikling – Stor frihet i hvordan oppgavene løses i et høykompetent og tverrfaglig miljø med fokus på kompetanseutvikling

  • Gode betingelser – Solide pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, treningstilskudd og tilgang til bedriftshelsetjenesten

  • Sosialt og aktivt arbeidsmiljø – Bli med i vårt bedriftsidrettslag med aktiviteter som løping, klatring, padel og fotball – her er det noe for alle!

  • Tid til å lade batteriene – Tilgang til firmahytter ved sjø og fjell, samt billetter til kultur- og idrettsarrangementer

  • Moderne fasiliteter – Kontorplass i våre lokaler i Porsgrunn, kun få minutters gange fra buss- og togstasjonen. Kantine, sosiale soner og egen kaffebar - perfekt for en god start på dagen eller en liten pust i bakken


Lurer du på noe?

Hvis dette høres ut som noe for deg, så ta gjerne kontakt med oss eller send oss en søknad!

Annen informasjon

Vi søker kandidater som kan identifisere seg med våre kjerneverdier Kompetent, Ansvarlig, Nyskapende, og du må kunne beherske norsk skriftlig og muntlig.

Skagerak Energi forvalter kritisk infrastruktur og følger retningslinjer og lovpålagte sikkerhetskrav fra norske myndigheter i våre rekrutteringsprosesser. Derfor vil vi gjennomføre en bakgrunnssjekk og personkontroll i henhold til kraftberedskapsforskriften og våre interne rutiner og retningslinjer, herunder vurdering av tilknytning til høyrisikoland (defineres årlig av EOS-tjenestenes trusselvurderinger). I visse rekrutteringsprosesser gjennomfører vi også kredittsjekk. Du må være forberedt på å oppgi opplysninger om deg selv i denne prosessen.

title: Senior iOS Developer (m/f/d)
description:
Description

Appsfactory is Germany’s leading full-service agency for digital transformation, cloud solutions, mobile and web applications, automotive software, and customized tech solutions across various industries. Do you want to actively contribute to establishing our presence and supporting our growth in Mexico? Then this position is the right one for you!

To build our first team at our brand-new location in Guadalajara, Mexico, we are looking for dedicated Senior iOS Developers (m/f/d). You will play a central role in shaping the local workspace, building scalable backend systems, supporting our growing engineering team, and establishing a seamless connection with our central functions.

You will be part of an international company with colleagues from over 45 different nationalities, creating a diverse, dynamic, and enriching work environment. Through our collaborative company culture, you can expect an exciting journey where you pass on the Appsfactory mindset, shape our new office culture, and continuously grow your career. We value continuous professional development, regular feedback discussions, and opportunities to further expand your skills as our new hub expands.

Your Tasks

  • You design, build, and maintain high-quality native iOS features and Connected Car experiences that integrate mobile apps with vehicle systems and cloud backends

  • You lead the architectural implementation and strategy for mobile features, aligning technical direction with Product, UX, QA, backend, and international stakeholders

  • You ensure top-tier application performance, quality, responsiveness, security, and UI precision across supported iOS devices and wearables

  • You drive systematic root-cause analysis, bug resolution, code reviews, and continuous improvement of mobile engineering and CI/CD practices

  • You actively participate in Agile Scrum refinements, accurately estimate story points, and break down pull requests into maintainable increments

  • You mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and pair programming, while contributing to team delivery goals and roadmap commitments

Your profile

  • You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or offer equivalent professional experience

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in native iOS development with exceptional proficiency in Swift

  • You demonstrate a strong understanding of modern mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM, VIPER, MVP) and concurrency using async/await, Combine, or Dispatch

  • You have proven experience in building custom, pixel-perfect user interfaces, unit testing, and automated CI/CD pipelines (such as Jenkins)

  • You possess hands-on experience in publishing mobile apps to the App Store and a deep understanding of Apple Developer guidelines

  • You bring a strong Agile mindset (Scrum/Kanban) combined with excellent problem-solving skills and fluent written and verbal English communication

We Offer

  • Flexible working hours and modern digital equipment to support your daily work

  • Central, modern office space in Guadalajara

  • Comprehensive onboarding program with insights into all departments, including a 2-week stay in the USA with all travel and accommodation costs fully covered

  • High-performing work environment with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes

  • Transparent communication through regular all-hands meetings, 1on1s, and annual feedback sessions

  • Individual growth opportunities and training programs through our Appsfactory Academy

We are pleased to meet you!

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity.

To apply for this position, please provide us with the following documents (as PDF) and information:

  • Current CV

  • Certificates/Diploma

  • Possible start date

  • Salary expectation (gross, monthly MXN)

Wibke Wachsmann

title: Staff Engineer - Mexico
description:
Staff Engineer - Mexico

We are searching for a Staff Engineer that can play a critical role in designing, developing and delivering scalable and efficient software solutions. Serving as a technical leader you’ll help mentor your team members, collaborate with cross-functional teams to guide architectural decisions, setting technical standards and ensuring high code quality across projects.

Your depth of experience will enable you to lead on complex projects, drive innovation, champion best practices to enhance product development and deliver real value for the business and our growing customer base internationally. For this role we will need someone that has a strong mix of hands-on technical work and strategic thinking.

About Us
Sokin is a next-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency.
Our mission is simple: we’re simplifying global business - so businesses thrive wherever they choose to grow. We deliver services across:

• Global payments and receivables

• Foreign Exchange (FX)

• Treasury management

• Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America, backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide.

Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we’re building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Design, build, and maintain highly scalable and reliable systems, ensuring they align with company goals and technical standards.

  • Define, communicate, and enforce coding standards, design principles, and development methodologies across teams.

  • Drive architectural decisions and work closely with stakeholders to align on technical strategies and roadmaps.

Project Ownership

  • Lead complex projects from conception through delivery, coordinating with engineering, product, and design teams.

  • Identify technical challenges, propose solutions, and proactively mitigate risks to ensure timely delivery.

  • Own end-to-end performance, security, and reliability of systems and applications.

Mentorship and Collaboration

  • Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional growth.

  • Provide constructive feedback during code reviews, helping to improve the overall quality of the codebase.

  • Collaborate with other engineers and departments to ensure seamless integration of new features and technologies.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and implement best practices, tools, and processes to increase team efficiency, code quality, and system performance.

  • Conduct root cause analysis of issues and drive long-term improvements.

  • Stay updated on emerging technologies, bringing innovative solutions and ideas to the team.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as a bridge between engineering teams and other departments, communicating complex technical concepts in an accessible manner.

  • Participate in technical discussions with senior leadership and contribute to strategic decision-making.

  • Gather and address feedback from stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business goals.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of software development experience, with a strong background in large-scale systems and application architecture.

  • Proven experience in one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript - our stack is based on Python, Go, Flask, Fast API, AWS, Angular, Typescript etc.

  • Deep understanding of software design patterns, architecture, and best practices (e.g. DDD).

  • Experience with cloud technologies, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.

  • Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD, and automation.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to a non-technical audience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a Tech Lead or Staff Engineer role.

  • Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks and data engineering best practices.

Please note, candidates will need to have the right to work in the jurisdiction that they are looking to work in.

Sokin is an equal opportunities employer and committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. As a growing global startup with bases across multiple countries, we were established on and continue to promote an agile, flexible working culture. Please reach out to discuss any accommodations you may require during the recruitment process.

title: Senior Java & Spark Data Engineer for Regulatory Reporting
description:
Project description

You will join a Regulatory Reporting Platform within a large US investment bank. The platform is responsible for collecting, processing, and transforming large volumes of data from multiple internal systems to produce regulatory reports for 240 jurisdictions worldwide. In total, the platform supports around 10,000 reports across a wide range of regulatory, compliance, financial, and risk reporting areas.This is a large-scale, business-critical data platform operating in a highly regulated environment, where data accuracy, quality, traceability, and timely delivery are essential. The team works on building and enhancing data pipelines, implementing reporting logic, ensuring data validation and reconciliation, and supporting the generation of complex regulatory outputs.The project is delivered by a global distributed team with colleagues located in Ukraine, Poland, and the US, offering close collaboration with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders across multiple regions.

Responsibilities

  • - Design, develop, and maintain solutions for a large-scale Regulatory Reporting Platform- Build and enhance data processing pipelines using Java and Apache Spark- Implement scalable logic for data ingestion, transformation, aggregation, and enrichment from multiple internal data sources- Develop and optimize batch processing jobs to support the generation of regulatory reports across multiple jurisdictions- Ensure high standards of data quality, validation, reconciliation, and consistency throughout the reporting lifecycle- Translate business and regulatory requirements into robust technical solutions- Collaborate with business analysts, QA engineers, and cross-functional teams to deliver reporting functionality- Investigate and resolve data and application issues in development, test, and production environments- Improve application performance, scalability, and reliability for high-volume data processing workloads- Contribute to the design and implementation of reusable components and engineering best practices- Participate in code reviews, testing, and release activities to ensure high-quality deliverables- Work closely with distributed teams across Ukraine, Poland, and the US in an agile delivery model- Support continuous improvement of the platform, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational stability

SKILLS

Must have

  • - 6+ years of commercial experience with Java+ 2+ years of experience with Spark- Experience in designing and developing scalable, high-performance backend applications- Good knowledge of SQL and working with large datasets from multiple data sources- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a global distributed team

Nice to have

- Experience in financial services, investment banking, or regulatory reporting projects- Familiarity with data quality, reconciliation, and control frameworks- Experience working with large-scale enterprise data platforms- Knowledge of cloud environments and modern data platform architectures- Understanding of CI/CD practices and automated deployment pipelines- Experience working in Agile / Scrum teams within a distributed global setup
