title: Senior Delivery Lead - Singapore
description:
Senior Delivery Lead - Singapore

We are looking for an ambitious, experienced Senior Delivery Lead to join our team. At Sokin, we are building a world-class delivery enablement team that can help our teams remove the borders, barriers and burdens from global business.

Delivery Enablement at Sokin is all about striving for best-in-class performance of our teams, providing the right people, tools and processes that allow them to deliver products that drive real value for our customers and the business.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to be part of something challenging and transformative and who will play a critical role in coaching and supporting our incredible teams into the next phase of their journey and beyond.

About us:

Sokin is a next-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency.

Our mission is simple: we’re simplifying global business - so businesses thrive wherever they choose to grow. We deliver services across:

• Global payments and receivables

• Foreign Exchange (FX)

• Treasury management

• Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America, backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide.

Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we’re building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

The Role

In this role, you will work closely with Product Managers and delivery teams to understand their individual ways of working, including Agile maturity, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

Partnering with the Head of Delivery, you will help shape and advocate for the Delivery Framework, define and track north star metrics, and provide coaching, mentoring, and guidance to support teams in achieving their goals.

You will proactively identify and remove impediments to fast, high-quality, high-value delivery, collaborating both within Product Engineering and across wider stakeholder groups such as Operations. Where required, you will also take direct ownership and leadership of business‑critical delivery initiatives.

Requirements

· Experience in payments or fintech, particularly at a company that has run multi-market licensing

· You have a deep understanding of Agile methodologies, frameworks and principles, but most importantly, are able to flexibly adapt these to individual teams and real-world challenges

· You are an excellent communicator with the ability to engage and inspire from individuals with varied roles, backgrounds and seniority levels

· You will have, and promote, a mindset for continuous learning and experimentation to effectively influence change across the business

· You are organised and methodical, able to confidently prioritise your workload and understand where to add value

title: IT Infrastructure Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Infrastructure Manager is responsible for the leadership, governance, design, operational management, performance and continual improvement of the organisation’s IT infrastructure services. The role owns the end-to-end design, delivery and operational integrity of network, server, storage, virtualisation, workplace, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, ensuring services are secure, resilient, supportable, cost-effective and aligned with business priorities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Own the infrastructure strategy, roadmap, standards and operating model across networks, servers, storage, virtualisation, end-user platforms, data centres, cloud services and hybrid environments.

· Lead the design, delivery and controlled operation of LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, firewalls, internet connectivity and associated network services, ensuring resilient architectures, approved configurations and appropriate technical documentation.

· Accountable for infrastructure availability, capacity, performance, security, supportability and lifecycle health, using measurable service levels, operational KPIs and regular management reporting.

· Own centralised infrastructure monitoring and alerting to proactively identify risks to health, availability, performance and capacity, ensuring alerts are actionable and team accountability for timely response is clearly defined.

· Maintain a complete and current suite of architecture diagrams, site records, configurations, procedures, support models, asset data and knowledge articles, with clear ownership and review cycles.

· Provide clear leadership, direction and line management for the infrastructure function, setting objectives, allocating work, developing capability and holding team members and suppliers accountable for agreed outcomes.

· Own the governance and optimisation of cloud and hybrid infrastructure, including connectivity, compute, storage, backup, monitoring, cost control, security configuration and alignment architecture principles.

· Drive the adoption of cloud infrastructure and migration from on-premises environments where appropriate, assessing business needs, technical suitability, security, resilience and total cost of ownership, and remaining accountable for migration planning, delivery and transition into operational support.

· Maintain ownership of infrastructure risks, technical debt and vulnerabilities, with documented remediation plans, ensuring clear visibility of risks and associated governance.

· Direct infrastructure projects and technical change from requirements and design through implementation, testing, acceptance and transition to support, with clear accountability for scope, quality, cost, risk and benefits.

· Ensure incidents, service requests, problems and changes are managed in line with agreed priorities, service levels and ITIL-aligned controls, taking command of major infrastructure incidents and ensuring effective communication, recovery and post-incident action.

· Ensure patching, configuration hardening, privileged access, endpoint protection, vulnerability remediation and audit evidence are completed to policy and within agreed timescales.

· Own backup, restore and disaster recovery capability across on-premises and cloud services, ensuring recovery objectives are defined, tests are completed, failures are remediated and recovery readiness is evidenced.

· Approve infrastructure designs, bills of materials, implementation plans, method statements, risk assessments, migration plans, acceptance criteria and operational handover documentation.

· Manage infrastructure budgets, forecasts, licensing, assets, contracts and supplier performance, ensuring value for money, accurate records, commercial control and timely renewal or replacement decisions.

· Build effective relationships with security teams, service management, project teams and third parties, translating business needs into prioritised and supportable infrastructure outcomes.

· Champion continual service improvement, automation, standardisation and simplification, ensuring improvement actions have measurable benefits and accountable delivery owners.

· Ensure the function has appropriate resource, skills, succession and operational coverage to meet current and future business requirements.

SKILLS & CAPABILITIES

Experience & Knowledge

· Substantial experience leading infrastructure operations and engineering teams in complex, multi-site or business-critical environments.

· Demonstrable management accountability for infrastructure operational performance, people, budgets, suppliers, risks, controls and delivery commitments.

· Broad technical knowledge across enterprise networking, Wi-Fi, firewalls, SD-WAN, servers, storage, virtualisation, endpoints, identity, backup and disaster recovery.

· Technology experience across Cisco routing and switching, Fortinet firewalls, HP servers and storage, Veeam Backup, infrastructure monitoring technologies, VMware, Microsoft Hyper-V and Microsoft Azure.

· Practical experience managing public cloud and hybrid infrastructure, including cloud governance, security, connectivity, monitoring, resilience, cost optimisation and operational support.

· Experience owning major incidents, infrastructure change, problem resolution, lifecycle planning, technical debt and continual service improvement in an ITIL-aligned environment.

· Experience directing infrastructure projects, reviewing technical designs and ensuring effective testing, acceptance and transition into operational support.

· Strong commercial and supplier management experience, including budgeting, forecasting, procurement, licensing, contract performance and value-for-money decisions.

· Sound knowledge of information security, vulnerability management, access control, audit evidence and relevant ISO and Cyber Essentials requirements.

· Ability to establish clear ownership, define expected outcomes and intervene decisively when performance, risk or delivery falls below standard.

· Ability to translate strategic and business requirements into prioritised infrastructure roadmaps, investment cases and deliverable plans.

· Strong analytical, governance and reporting capability, with confidence presenting service performance, risks, decisions and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

· Visible, accountable leader who takes ownership of outcomes and creates the same expectation across the team and supplier community.

title: Mechatronics Development Engineer
description:
Alva is hiring multiple engineers to strengthen our FiberPrinting™ team - the people behind designing, building, and testing our line of FiberPrinters: advanced, custom-built machines that produce the stators used in Alva motors. FiberPrinting™ is what allows Alva to make some of the thinnest motors in the world.

You’ll be working with the core technology Alva is built on. This is a highly interdisciplinary role blending different fields of engineering. You’ll join a hands-on team that thrives on rapid prototyping, open collaboration, and continuous learning. We emphasize early prototyping and practical testing to validate ideas and guide development. This allows us to identify challenges early and refine solutions before committing to detailed designs. Learn more about FiberPrinting™ here:

Working in our small team means:

  1. You take ideas from concept to reality

  2. You’ll split your time between desk work and workshop time - doing experiments, building machines, assisting production, and more

  3. You won’t hand a design over to another department and never see it again - you get to follow it all the way into operation

  4. Minimal admin and meetings → more time spent building

If this way of working resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

Strengths we're looking for

We're hiring multiple engineers with different backgrounds and strengths. Experience in any of the areas below could make you a good fit.

  • Proven ability to develop, build, and test technical solutions

  • Strong experience in one of the following: mechanical design, mechatronics, automation, software development

  • Hands-on experience with machinery, whether it's production equipment, cars, motorcycles, 3D-printers, CNC machines, etc.

  • Experience in one or more of these areas: 3D-CAD, software development, machine vision, automated manufacturing, or industrialization

  • Comfortable working with complex technical problems

This is an on-site position in Trondheim as you need daily access to our workshop and production facilities.

Team responsibilities

The areas below describe what we cover as a team, not what we expect every individual to cover. Your position will be tailored to your strengths.

Software development, machine vision and machine learning

  • Design, build, and test custom machine vision applications.

  • Create custom datasets to train and validate machine learning models using available tools.

  • Develop and iterate the physical systems alongside the software to optimize the solutions.

  • Communicate and demonstrate the possibilities and limitations of different methods.

  • Apply these solutions to the production floor, enabling inline measurements, process monitoring, and defect detection during stator production.

Designing, building and testing machines

  • Design mechanical systems and components - from minor upgrades to entirely new production machines.

  • Take ideas from whiteboard sketches to working prototypes, building and testing them in our workshop.

  • Develop prototypes into reliable production machines as Alva scales manufacturing.

  • Develop and improve automation, motion control, and machine integration.

  • Investigate and improve machine stability, performance, and reliability.

  • Troubleshoot and improve existing machines and production processes.

What we offer

  • A rare opportunity to grow fast as an engineer across multiple disciplines - working closely with experts at the forefront of motor design and manufacturing

  • A key role in a small, fast-paced engineering team, contributing to the machines and the technology behind our products

  • A collaborative culture that values initiative, transparency, and continuous learning

  • A truly international work environment with colleagues from around the world

About Alva

Alva Industries develops and manufactures some of the world’s thinnest electric motors. Our frameless design lets customers integrate stators and rotors directly into their systems - reducing mechanical complexity and saving space.

Our portfolio of frameless electric motors is expanding rapidly across multiple industries. All engineering, manufacturing, and assembly happen under one roof, right here in Trondheim - keeping our engineering team close to the production line.

How to apply

Submit a short application explaining why you’re a good match for the role, and what you would like to gain from this position. If you have a portfolio, project, or anything else that shows how you work - please include that too. We review applications continuously and will contact candidates we believe are a good fit.

title: Senior Carer
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the Home Manager or Deputy Manager, the Senior Carer is responsible for ensuring a high level of care is provided to residents and follows company policies and procedures.

The Senior Carer will provide and ensure the highest standards of care are achieved in all areas of the home including relationship centered care, clinical care and dementia care.

The Senior Carer will lead and manage their care team ensuring high quality of care and service is always provided to all residents.

JOB SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership and Management

§ To take a lead role and assist with all aspects of care within the home.

§ Assist with the recruitment and training of the care team; ensuring training targets are met and the teams are competent in their roles.

§ Assist and inspire the care team to deliver exceptional outcomes of care.

  • Ensure that all supervision, appraisal, and performance management of the care team are carried out, supporting them to achieve their potential.
  • Act always in a professional manner to visitors, staff and clients within the home.
  • To attend any training sessions to further knowledge skills deemed necessary.
  • To ensure all care team members attend required training and support them to apply the learning in the workplace.

Care

§ Assist with care delivery in the home, to ensure continuous assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of resident’s care.

§ Assist with ensuring care plans are regularly reviewed and that they are appropriate to the residents needs and reflect the care being delivered.

§ Ensure that each resident receives the meal or diet that he/she has requested and is suitable for his/her needs.

§ Assist with all activities provided within the home to promote relationship centered care.

§ Ensure that all regulatory and statutory requirements are met and company policies and procedures are adhered to.

§ Ensure that the Home Manager/ Deputy Manager is made aware of any clinical issues within the home.

§ Assist any duties requested by the Home Manager or Deputy Manager

§ To help with the admission and discharge of residents, including listing of resident’s property/clothing.

  • Always maintain confidentiality regarding resident’s particulars.
  • Assist and participate in activities within the Home as required.
  • To actively engage with residents in conversation and meaningful occupation related to their lifestyle choices at a level and pace that values the individual and respects their dignity and communication differences.
  • To respond in a timely way to residents who are distressed (calling out, calling for help, knocking or making noises that suggest the need for support) or seek assistance if you feel unable to respond appropriately.

Health and Safety

§ Ensure Home Manager or Deputy Manager is informed of any incidents in the home.

§ Ensure storage of medications are in line with company policies and procedures.

§ Ensure risk assessments are completed within the home and safe working practices are being followed.

§ You will be required for this role to potentially liftheavy objects.

§ All staff are responsible for protecting themselves and others against infection risks. All staff regardless of whether clinical or not are expected to comply with current infection control policies and procedures and to report any problems regarding this to the manager. All staff undertaking patient care activities must attend infection control training and updates as required by this organisation.

JOB DESCRIPTION RECORD

This job description reflects the current main organisational priorities for the position. These priorities may develop and change in consultation with the post holder in line with needs and priorities of the business.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Experience

· Proven track record leading, empowering, supporting and motivating a clinical/care team

· Excellent written, non-verbal and verbal communication skills

· Able to adapt to change

· Willing to learn

· Approachable

· Confident

· Diplomatic

· Enthusiastic

· Flexible

· Influencing skills

· Listening skills

· Negotiating skills

· Patient

· Positive attitude

· Self-motivator

· Flexible approach to working hours - able to work occasional outside of normal hours.

· Ability to promote a professional image for the company at all times

· Ability to travel to other homes where needed for training / support

· Able to adapt to the Strong Life Care culture

title: Demand Planner
description:
*No Recruiters, please!*


The Demand Planner is responsible for forecasting and demand planning for assigned US product lines. The role supports inventory management, supply planning, and ERP data accuracy to maintain appropriate inventory levels and meet customer demand. The Demand Planner works closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, and Supply Chain Operations to maintain accurate forecasts, identify demand trends and risks, and support effective purchasing, inventory, and logistics decisions. The individual contributes to continuous improvement initiatives and the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process to support overall business objectives.


WHO WE ARE:


At Rollease Acmeda, we are innovators of precision window covering hardware systems, specialized fabrics, and automated shade solutions. Since 1980, we have been on the cutting edge of design, development and distribution within the window furnishing industry. The years of knowledge and experience have enabled us to deliver broader product choices, enhanced technologies, and an exceptional level of service to our trade customer base.

We are proudly owned by JM Family Enterprises, one of the largest privately owned companies in the US.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

  • Maintain demand forecasts for assigned US product lines based on historical demand, trends, seasonality, and inputs from Sales, customers, and Product Management. Identify forecast variances and recommend adjustments as needed
  • Apply system overrides in the demand planning software as needed
  • Maintain accurate demand planning and ERP master data, including safety stocks, reorder points, lead times, and other inventory parameters, to support effective inventory management and replenishment
  • Collaborate with the other Demand Planner to share knowledge, cross-train on key responsibilities, and ensure continuity of critical demand planning activities.
  • Establish schedules and execution plans for daily, weekly, and monthly demand planning activities
  • Follow established planning processes and contribute to the development and documentation of procedures, tools, and process improvements that reduce stockouts and optimize inventory management
  • Conduct regular demand reviews with Product Management to review forecasts, discuss demand changes, and identify risks and opportunities
  • Hold quarterly sales focused demand reviews with sales team to track future risks and opportunities
  • Support key customers’ forecasting needs by meeting regularly, providing reports, and gathering input
  • Develop actionable insights, datasets, and reports based on analysis to address key supply chain needs
  • Identify and communicate forecast risks and opportunities to management, recommend corrective actions, and follow through on agreed-upon activities
  • Monitor and report on significant changes in sales forecasts, budgets, and business strategies
  • Address demand-related changes and issues in a timely and effective manner
  • Monitor product lifecycles and new product development activities, and perform related planning tasks
  • Develop forecasts for new products in collaboration with Product Management and Sales, tracking actual performance and adjusting forecasts as needed
  • Build strong relationships with customers and suppliers to develop forecasts, material plans, and actions that optimize supply chain decisions across the business
  • Assist Buying team with purchasing activity and perform analysis of supplier capacity, air freight or other impacts to output when needed
  • Support the S&OP process by maintaining accurate forecasts, providing demand analysis, and identifying gaps between forecasted demand, sales budgets, and business objectives
  • Assist with preparing executive S&OP presentations, scorecards, and reports
  • Collaborate with IT to ensure planning tools meet allocation, demand planning, and forecasting needs
  • Implement and maintain inventory and material management strategies for raw materials and finished goods through regular review and optimization of inventory parameters and levels, including reorder points, safety stocks, lead times, and ABC categorization
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement agreed-upon actions to improve forecast performance
  • Monitor inventory performance, including stockout risks, excess inventory, and changing demand patterns, and recommend appropriate planning adjustments.
  • Review supply issues with Operations leadership to assess their impact on production and distribution output


WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or related field, preferred
  • 2 years of forecasting or demand planning experience working with Demand Planning and DRP tools
  • Excel skills must be advanced – experience with PowerBI preferred
  • Experience gathering, analyzing & presenting data
  • Experience utilizing Demand Planning software
  • Experience working with MRP/ERP systems, Microsoft D365 experience, preferred
  • Experience supporting S&OP processes preferred
  • Prior exposure to analyzing supply chain KPI’s (Forecast Accuracy, Bias, Fill Rate)
  • Professional certifications in IBF, APICS or similar, preferred
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint
  • Exhibit Company Core Values of being Consideration, Cooperation, Communication, Accountability, Innovation
  • Proven knowledge of inventory management and examples of forecasting skills
  • Strong attention to detail with proven examples of follow through and effective communication
  • Ability to work across the entire supply chain enterprise – suppliers, customers, and internal sales, marketing, and operations
  • Self-management skills and the ability to work in office, warehouse, and on-line environments
  • Must have critical thinking skills and a technical aptitude
  • Ability and desire to learn new skills and apply them quickly
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills, including an excellent telephone and video conference manner
  • Well organized with the ability to handle multiple and competing priorities to meet deadlines
  • Motivated self-starter with a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and professional demeanor
  • Team oriented individual, able to build and maintain rapport and work effectively cross-functionally
  • Experience collaborating with and influencing others
  • Consistently exhibit company core values of Consideration, Cooperation, Communication, Accountability, and Innovation

  • Ability to work in a growing company where your talents and skills can have a positive impact

title: Senior EA to the CEO
description:
🌱 Who we are

Mother Root is the fiery ginger non-alcoholic aperitif. We harness the power of apple cider vinegar to serve up a dose of good feelings. Our mission is to redefine the evening ritual of drinking well and feeling good, with drinks that are complex, delicious and rooted in nature.

We're the UK's fastest-growing drinks brand and the number one non-alcoholic spirit. We were a £7m business last year and we're on track for more than £20m this year. Next we're accelerating that growth, and becoming one of the leading non-alcoholic brands in the US as well as the UK. Small but mighty team, big category, plenty still to build.

We're building a team where ambitious people do the best work of their careers, supporting each other and making something they truly believe in. We believe work should be joyful, purposeful and full of flavour.

🚀 The Role

Mother Root is growing fast, and our founder and CEO, Bethan, is pulled in more directions than one calendar can hold. You're here to change that. The job isn't managing an inbox - it's building a system around her so the right things reach her at the right time and everything else gets decided without her.

You'll set up and run the tools that now do most traditional EA work (we use AI, Notion and Slack every day), then lead from above them: filtering, tweaking, spotting what matters and getting Bethan's attention when something genuinely needs it. Over time you'll know her and the business well enough to predict her answer and act on it.

You'll work side by side with Bethan, our senior leadership team and our Heads Of. You'll be across the meetings she's in and the documents that come her way, so you can keep her briefed and step in for her when she's not in the room.

This role isn't for someone who wants a clear task list each morning. You'll tell the CEO when she's spending time on the wrong things, hold her to the boundaries she sets and be ahead of the week without anyone asking you to be. If you'd rather be told what to do, this won't be the job for you.

📋 What You’ll Do

  • Build the system

    • Set up and run AI and automation so most of the inbox, calendar, meeting notes and follow-ups happen without anyone touching them.

    • Create one view of Bethan's world: what's waiting on her, what's coming up and what needs thinking time.

    • Turn repeat ad hoc requests into simple processes and clear decision rights, so the team can make good calls without escalating.

    Run the week, ahead of time

    • Plan Bethan's calendar weeks out in clear blocks, with prep and pre-read time before key meetings and reflection time before big decisions.

    • Look ahead each quarter so key dates, travel and commitments are in the diary well before they land.

    • Protect the non-negotiables (family, research, exercise, free time) as firmly as a board meeting.

    • Own Bethan's travel end to end, from booking and itineraries to visas and logistics, planning ahead as much as possible.

    • Keep Bethan accountable. Spot patterns that keep recurring or building up and bring them with a fix.

    Be a second pair of eyes and ears

    • Attend or catch up on Bethan's meetings and read what lands on her desk. Brief her in a way that leads with what needs a decision.

    • Be the first point of contact for external requests, from intros and investor meetings to podcast, press and speaking invites.

    • Step in when she can't: represent her in meetings, chase actions and make calls within agreed limits.

    • Challenge up. When something shouldn't be on Bethan's plate, say so and recommend who should own it.

    • Help Bethan remember what matters to the people she works with, so she can show up for them. You'll handle this with care and discretion.

🧭 Your first year

  • First month: shadow everything. Learn how Bethan works, who's who and where her time actually goes, then come back with an honest audit.

  • By month three: the system is live. One view, a calendar planned weeks ahead and most admin automated. Bethan has noticeably more thinking time.

  • By month six: you're running the week with light-touch input and deputising in meetings. The team gets decisions from agreed processes rather than from Bethan's inbox.

  • By month twelve: you can predict Bethan's call on most things, and the business runs smoothly whether she's in the room or not.

🎓 What You’ll Bring

  • You've been the right hand to a senior leader in a fast-moving business, and you made their job smaller.

Useful, not essential

Experience in a startup or consumer brand background.

💫 How we work

Four values, and we use them to make actual calls.

  • Be human. Warmth first, with each other, customers and suppliers. The person stays at the heart of every decision. We're straight when it's hard, and we lean on each other.

  • Bring the heat. Energy, hunger, momentum. We're ambitious and we don't settle. We back ourselves and we test and learn rather than get stuck in debate.

title: Optometry Technician

Job Summary:

The optometric technician supports the delivery of comprehensive eye care services by performing clinical testing, assisting providers, and ensuring efficient clinic operations, resulting in timely, accurate, and culturally competent care.

Essential Functions:

  • Obtain and document Relative medical and ocular history, chief complaint, and medications in the electronic health record to ensure complete and compliant clinical records.
  • Perform preliminary and advanced optometric testing (visual acuity, autorefraction, tonometry, imaging) to provide accurate baseline data for diagnosis and treatment planning.
  • Prepare Relative and exam rooms prior to provider evaluation to support efficient clinic flow and reduce Relative wait times.
  • Administer eye drops as directed to support diagnostic accuracy and treatment effectiveness.
  • Perform specialty testing (OCT, visual field, pachymetry) to aid in early detection and monitoring of ocular disease.
  • Assist the provider during examinations and treatments to enhance care quality and provider efficiency.
  • Educate Relatives on diagnosis, treatment plans, and medications to improve understanding, compliance, and health outcomes.
  • Train Relatives on contact lens insertion, removal, and care to ensure safe and effective lens use and compliance.
  • Communicate clearly and respectfully with Relatives to promote a positive, culturally competent Relative experience.
  • Enter and track contact lens orders to maintain order accuracy and timely delivery.
  • Coordinate with the vendor regarding orders to resolve issues and prevent delays in care.
  • Document all Relative interactions and clinical data in the electronic health record to maintain compliance with legal, regulatory, and billing requirements.
  • Manage Relative flow and room turnover to maximize provider productivity and minimize delays.
  • Clean and disinfect equipment and exam rooms to maintain infection control and Relative safety standards.
  • Monitor and restock supplies to ensure uninterrupted clinical operations.
  • Support Relative education initiatives to reduce preventable vision issues within the Relative population.
  • Participate in outreach events and vision screenings to improve access to care and community health outcomes.
  • Engage in cross-training opportunities to support clinic flexibility and career growth.
  • Adhere to HIPAA and confidentiality standards to protect Relative information and maintain trust.
  • Follow all policies and procedures to ensure regulatory compliance and operational consistency.
  • Maintain professional communication with Relatives, coworkers, and external stakeholders to support a respectful and productive work environment.
  • Participate in required trainings to maintain competency and improve job performance.
  • Maintain consistent and reliable attendance, including arriving on time and adhering to scheduled work hours to ensure continuity of Relative care, adequate staffing coverage, and efficient clinical operations

Physical Requirments

• Participates in Core Connections training and applies GPTLHB Core Connections concepts and practices in their work to support a positive, culturally competent work environment.

•Perform duties that require prolonged standing, walking, and/or sitting throughout the workday to ensure continuous Relative care and support efficient clinic operations.

• Use manual dexterity to operate clinic equipment, computers, and small instruments to accurately perform testing, documentation, and Relative care tasks.

•Lift, carry, and move equipment and supplies (up to designated weight limits) to maintain stocked, functional, and organized clinical and work areas.

• Maintain visual acuity and attention to detail when performing clinical or administrative tasks to ensure accuracy in measurements and documentation.

• Communicate effectively with Relatives and team members in person and via phone or electronic systems to ensure clear, accurate, and timely exchange of information.

•Perform repetitive tasks such as typing, data entry, and equipment use to support timely documentation and workflow.

• Adapt to a fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions and task-switching to maintain productivity and meet Relative care demands.

• Follow all infection control, safety, and PPE protocols to minimize risk to Relatives, staff, and self.

• Interact with diverse Relative populations including those with medical, emotional, or communication challenges to provide respectful, culturally competent, and Relative-centered care.

• Utilize multiple systems in a technology-driven setting to ensure accurate documentation and operational efficiency.

• Maintain professionalism in a team-based high-interaction environment to support positive team dynamics and effective collaboration.

• Maintain consistent attendance and the ability to perform assigned duties within the physical and environmental conditions of the role of ensuring dependable operations and uninterrupted Relative care.

Education/Experience/Certificates/Credentials

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • At least one year of experience as an optometry or ophthalmology technician
  • Paraoptometric or Ophthalmic Assistant certification preferred, but not required
  • Must successfully pass a criminal and background check, and a pre-employment drug screen.

The GPTLHB is a tribal organization which follows tribal preference laws. It is our policy to give preference to qualified Indian/Tribal candidates over qualified non-native candidates in hiring decisions, if all other qualifications are equal.

Employment is contingent upon the outcome of all required criminal background checks.

Compliance with our Employee Health Procedure is a condition of employment. You are required to agree that you will comply with all job-related employee health screening and immunizations prior to your first day of employment. Jobs require that you have documentation that you have completed the following immunizations prior to your first day of employment: MMR (Measles, Mumps and Rubella, Varicella (Chicken Pox), Hepatitis B, Influenza, T-dap (Tetanus - Diphtheria - Pertussis), and COVID-19 vaccination is required.

title: Master (MSc) Thesis ''Development and Validation of Daughter Boards''
description:
Are you interested in contributing to the development of hardware for future space missions? OHB Sweden is looking for a Master's student to support the development and validation of unit daughter boards.

During the thesis, you will work with the complete early-stage development process, from defining the concepts to preliminary sizing, modelling, and electronics design. The work will involve balancing key considerations such as performance, reliability, costs, and manufacturability. You will have the possibility to design, set up, and test a proof-of-concept prototype.

You will carry out the thesis as part of OHB Sweden's Avionics and Electrical department, working closely with experienced engineers and contributing to the development of technology intended for future space applications.

The tasks of the master's thesis topic are as follows:

The student will contribute to the development of the electronic boards through activities such as:

  • Analysis of requirements and their design consequences,

  • Review and consolidation of the component selection,

  • Design, Schematics and analysis of electronics (FMEA, reliability, WCA),

  • PCB routing and procurement of assembled PCB from local suppliers,

  • Prototype integration together with existing development boards,

  • Support to driver coding,

  • Assessment of performance through measurements and tests

The required candidate’s skills are:

The position is suitable for Master's students in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Preliminary experience (through university courses, extra curriculum activities or autodidact) in the following domains is expected / required:

  • Electronics schematics and PCB routing (i.e KiCAD)

  • General knowledge of electronic circuits (memories, ADCs, power converters, etc.)

  • Spice Simulations (i.e circuits op amps, filtering, etc.)

  • Testing (i.e power supplies, oscilloscopes, multimeter)

  • Scripting (i.e Python)

What can we offer the student for them to succeed in their master's thesis?

The student will become part of OHB Sweden's Avionics and electrical team and contribute to the development of a Innosat avionics architecture. The work offers hands-on experience with real hardware development and close collaboration with engineers working on current and future space missions.

Successful thesis work may also open a path towards future employment within the Avionics & Electrical team at OHB Sweden.

title: Field Maintenance PM Tech
company: JC Davis Ventures LLC dba JC Davis Power
description:
At JC Davis Ventures, LLC dba JC Davis Power, we keep work moving with smart, reliable solutions that allow our people and our partners to stay safe, focused, and ahead. Powering a jobsite shouldn't be a hassle. But too often, crews are left waiting, equipment breaks down, vendors go dark, and deadlines slip.

We started JC Davis Power to fix all of that. We're a full-service jobsite operations partner, delivering and maintaining temporary power, climate control, and tower lighting. All with one reliable crew. No handoffs. No confusion.

We show up, solve problems, and do the work the right way. Whether you're supporting customers in the field, building systems behind the scenes, or helping drive the business forward, you'll be part of a team that values reliability, accountability, and getting the job done.

Simple - Reliable - Done Right!

The Role

JC Davis Power is hiring Preventive Maintenance Technicians to support our growing Field Maintenance operations. Our fleet is the product, and this role keeps it running. You'll travel to customer jobsites and company locations to perform scheduled preventive maintenance on diesel generators, light towers, and temporary climate control units, catch problems before they become failures, and keep accurate service records.

This is a full-time, hands-on field position with frequent travel between operating regions, including overnight stays when needed. You'll be supported by experienced leadership, a dedicated Field Maintenance Coordinator, established maintenance procedures, and a safety-focused team.

What You'll Do

  • Preventive Maintenance: Perform scheduled PM on diesel generators from 14kW to 2MW, as well as light towers and temporary AC units.

  • Inspections: Inspect engines, belts, coolant systems, batteries, fuel lines, trailers, and related components. On light towers, check lamps, masts, and mast-raising systems. On AC units, check filters, coils, fans, and condensate drainage. Identify and report leaks, mechanical defects, abnormal operating conditions, and potential failures.

  • Procedures and Checks: Follow established shutdown, maintenance, startup, and return-to-service procedures, and run post-maintenance operational checks to confirm each unit is working properly.

  • Documentation: Check and record battery voltage, charging voltage, generator hours, and fuel levels. Complete all maintenance forms, service documentation, and equipment photos.

  • Communication and Scheduling: Coordinate daily assignments with the Maintenance Coordinator and report findings, deficiencies, and completed service to Field Maintenance leadership.

  • Equipment Care: Maintain company-provided tools, service vehicles, lube skids, and maintenance equipment.

  • Safety and Environmental: Handle and dispose of used oil, filters, and maintenance waste properly. Keep service locations clean, organized, and safe, and follow company safety policies, environmental requirements, and maintenance SOPs.

  • Customer Presence: Represent JC Davis Power professionally at customer locations.

What We're Looking For

  • Valid driver's license that is not suspended, revoked, or restricted, and an acceptable motor vehicle record

  • Working knowledge of diesel engines, lubrication systems, filters, batteries, and basic mechanical and electrical components

  • Ability to perform routine mechanical maintenance, identify equipment deficiencies, and troubleshoot basic mechanical problems

  • Ability to follow written procedures, complete digital service forms, and keep accurate documentation

  • Strong attention to detail, safety awareness, and personal accountability

  • Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with the maintenance team

  • Full-time availability (minimum 40 hours per week), with overtime and occasional weekend work as needed

  • Willingness to travel frequently to jobsites and between operating regions, including overnight stays

  • Ability to work outdoors in changing weather and active industrial environments

  • Physical ability to stand, bend, kneel, climb, and safely lift and move tools, equipment, and materials within company limits

What Success Looks Like

  • Scheduled PMs on generators, light towers, and AC units completed on time and to procedure

  • Problems caught and reported before they turn into equipment failures in the field

  • Complete, accurate service records and photos for every unit serviced

  • Safe work, clean service locations, and proper handling of oil and waste

  • Customers see a professional, reliable JC Davis team

What We Offer

We take care of our team so you can take care of the work. Our benefits are designed to keep you safe, supported, and set up for success.

  • Health & Wellness – 100% company-paid medical coverage premiums for you and your family, including spouse or domestic partner and children

  • Life Insurance – Company-paid group life insurance for every employee

  • Additional Coverage – Employee-paid dental, vision, short and long term disability, additional life, accident, illness, and hospital indemnity options available

  • 401k – plus 4% matching

  • Time Off – PTO, paid holidays, plus your birthday off

  • Overtime – Steady work with overtime opportunities

  • Tools & Equipment – Company-provided tools, equipment, and technology

  • Transportation – Company vehicle, stipend, or mileage reimbursement depending on role

  • Supportive Culture – Safety-first mindset, people-first values, and a team that looks out for one another

title: Technician Training and Development Manager
description:
Working Hours/Days

This is a full-time, exempt position. The employee will be expected to work the hours necessary to fulfill the position's duties. Typical work schedule is Mon-Fri, 7am-3pm, weekend work as needed.

Overview

The Technician Training and Development Manager develops and coordinates programs that prepare Altorfer Power Systems technicians for safe, productive careers, with a primary focus on electric power generation (EPG). The role supports rapid service growth through structured onboarding, mentoring, and career development for both the broader EPG workforce and technicians dedicated to large data center generator sets. Training also addresses industrial engine-driven products and marine engines based on business needs.

Reporting to the Director of Product Support, this position leads through collaboration and influence across service locations. Primary responsibilities include curriculum development, training coordination, individual development tracking, and recruiting support, with approximately 10–20% of time devoted to selected instruction and practical learning. Technicians continue to report through their department supervisors and service managers.

Basic Duties

  • Within the first 6–12 months, develop and launch an accelerated onboarding program with structured mentoring, supervised field experience, and progress reviews to prepare less-experienced technicians to contribute safely and productively alongside experienced team members.
  • Develop an EPG-centered curriculum combining classroom, online, and practical learning. Establish shared engine, electrical, controls, diagnostics, and safety foundations, with broader EPG service training and supplemental industrial engine and marine instruction based on assignments.
  • Partner with the Data Center Product Support Manager, project managers, service leaders, and Technical Services to develop a specialized pathway for commissioning, testing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing approximately 3 MW generator sets and associated power and ancillary equipment.
  • Assess current and future training needs with service leaders, Technical Services, and Sales, using skills assessments, service performance, customer requirements, and anticipated products and technologies to set priorities.
  • Work with service leadership and Human Resources to harmonize classification and advancement requirements across locations, using existing apprentice, Levels 1–4/Journeyman, and Master Technician definitions as a starting point while recognizing specialized career paths.
  • Maintain individual technician development plans and records covering training, demonstrated competencies, qualifications, renewals, and next-level requirements. title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst
description:
📊 Do you enjoy turning complex financial data into sound credit decisions and want your judgement to shape how a business grows?

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst at Ecommpay, you'll take ownership of how we assess, measure and price merchant and counterparty risk across our global portfolio. You'll cover merchant credit risk across all industry types, each with its own risk profile, including Deferred Delivery Merchants, where we settle funds before the service is delivered, and make sure every exposure is understood, provisioned, mitigated and priced correctly.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll calculate IFRS 9 expected credit losses, build risk-based pricing, write credit memos for the Credit Committee and develop the existing credit framework so it supports our growth. Sitting within Finance, you'll work closely with Risk, Pricing, Sales and senior management, with your analysis directly informing board reporting and annual planning.

What you will do:

Portfolio and exposure analysis

  • Assess and monitor credit risk across the merchant portfolio, including Deferred Delivery Merchants (DDM) and other higher-risk industry types, quantify merchant exposure and define appropriate reserves, security deposits and settlement terms

  • Conduct merchant credit assessments covering financial statements, cash flow, liquidity, ownership structures, trading history, chargebacks and refunds

  • Monitor concentration and counterparty risks across merchants, sectors, jurisdictions and settlement banks, escalating breaches of agreed limits

IFRS 9 and provisioning

  • Calculate IFRS 9 expected credit losses for merchant receivables, settlement advances and other in-scope financial assets

  • Build and maintain PD, LGD and EAD inputs, apply staging and significant-increase-in-credit-risk criteria, and document forward-looking macroeconomic scenarios and weightings

  • Maintain the provision matrix and prepare individual assessments for material or impaired counterparties

  • Provide ECL disclosure inputs and model documentation for Finance and external audit, and defend the methodology during audit reviews

Risk-based pricing

  • Develop and apply risk-based pricing: translate merchant risk grades into pricing, reserve levels, settlement terms and collateral requirements, so that risk is priced in and not absorbed

  • Partner with Pricing, Sales and Account Management to reprice existing merchants whose risk profile no longer matches their commercial terms

  • Analyse portfolio profitability on a risk-adjusted basis and identify merchants and segments where margin doesn't cover the exposure, recommending pricing and mitigation outcomes

Framework, policy and governance

  • Enhance and maintain the credit risk policy, scoring model, approval matrix and delegated authority levels

  • Prepare credit memos and limit recommendations, present them to the Credit Committee and document the rationale for every decision

  • Design a tiered assessment workflow for standard cases, enhanced reviews and high-risk exceptions

  • Deliver monthly portfolio and exposure reporting to management and the board risk committee

Planning cycle

  • Own the risk assumptions in the annual revenue baseline, using probability-weighted expected losses from client attrition and traffic loss that are built on historical data, not guesswork

  • Provide well-supported assumptions to Finance, with clear commentary on what is changing, why, on what data, and which risks are already reflected

  • Provide regular reviews of exposure and loss experience

What we are looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience in credit risk, counterparty risk or credit analysis, ideally in banking or merchant acquiring (payments, fintech, trade finance or credit insurance also considered)

  • Hands-on IFRS 9 ECL experience, meaning you've done the calculations, staging and PD/LGD/EAD inputs and defended the methodology to auditors

  • Strong financial statement analysis skills: you can read a set of accounts, build a cash flow view and form your own view on a counterparty's solvency

  • Experience with risk-based pricing, or a proven ability to link risk grading to commercial terms, reserves and collateral

  • Advanced Excel skills for portfolio analysis and comfort working with incomplete or inconsistently classified transaction data

  • Excellent knowledge of English

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Deferred delivery, pre-paid or future-service merchants exposure, such as travel, airlines, ticketing, events or subscriptions

  • Understanding of card scheme rules on chargebacks, reserves and merchant underwriting

  • Developing and scaling a credit function or framework

  • Familiarity with bank counterparty and jurisdiction risk assessment

What we offer:

🚀 Make your mark on a fast-growing fintech industry becoming part of 500+ team with 4 offices worldwide

🎓 Enhance your skills with our own Academy and receive compensation for additional trainings and courses to foster your growth

💰 Earn performance-based bonuses tied to achieved KPIs

🏆 Accumulate your Loyalty Days as a reward for your years of commitment

🎂 Get an extra paid day off to celebrate your birthday

🏠 Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work model

🏥 Receive generous health insurance including dental, 5 Health Leave days per year and access to a private gym in the office

Salary Range: 3000-4500 EUR Gross/month

Ready to turn complex financial data into clear insights and make a visible impact on business performance? Join Ecommpay as our Senior Credit Risk Analyst and help shape budgeting, planning and reporting, improve how we work through automation and uncover opportunities that support sustainable growth. Our team will get back to you and guide you through the next steps.

Let's grow!

  • Attends and completes mandatory education including infection prevention and control, safety, CPR, equipment usage and procedures according to hospital and department policies.

  • May assist inpatient and family education by providing educational material and general health information to patients and family members.
  • May assist with transportation of patients to ancillary departments or inpatient units as directed by licensed staff.
  • May instruct in Basic Life Support (BLS) requirements.
  • May perform IV access.
  • May perform other duties based on department assigned.
  • At the discretion of department operational and patient care needs, this position is required to work rotating schedules, which may include variable hours, weekends, nights, and holidays to meet the staffing and patient care demands of a 24/7 complex health system. Regular, reliable, and punctual attendance during assigned shifts is considered an essential function of the role.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Ability to withstand the physical demand of being on your feet for long periods of time, of moving and lifting patients and of reaching for and handling equipment.

Qualifications

Licenses Required

  • Current RQI Healthcare Provider eCredential through the University of Utah Health RQI system. The eCredential is to be obtained within 30 days of hire.
  • One of the following
    • Current Advanced EMT certification with the State of Utah.
    • Current certification as a Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through AAMA
    • Current certification to practice as a Paramedic in the State of Utah.
    • Currently credentialed in ABR-OE (Assessment-Based Recognition in Order Entry) through AAMA.
    • Current certification as a Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through AMT
    • Current certification as a National Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through NCCT.
    • Current Clinical Medical Assistant Certification through NHA.
    • Current certification as a NRCMA - Medical Assistant through the National Association for Health Professionals.
* Additional license requirements as determined by the hiring department.

Qualifications (Preferred)

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

Employee must be able to meet the following requirements with or without an accommodation.

  • This position involves intermediate working conditions in a healthcare setting that may exert up to 50 pounds and may consistently require lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, or otherwise moving patients or objects, such as medical equipment, while providing patient care. Workers in this position may be exposed to infectious diseases and may be required to function around prisoners or behavioral health patients. Incumbents face exposure to potentially dangerous contaminated bodily fluids, blood, used needles and other contaminants as part of the daily hazards of the job.

Physical Requirements

Carrying, Climbing, Color Determination, Crawling, Lifting, Listening, Manual Dexterity, Near Vision, Pulling and/or Pushing, Reaching, Sitting, Speaking, Standing, Stooping and Crouching, Walking

title: Activities Co-ordinator
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the Home Manager, the Activities Coordinator is responsible for ensuring that meaningful, enjoyable, engaging and stimulating activities are planned, organised, promoted and implemented in the Home for all residents in line with the principles, policies, procedures and best practice guidelines for relationship centred care, clinical care and dementia care.

The Activities Coordinator will motivate, inspire, and mobilise team members in the Home to be involved and engaged in the provision of stimulating activities within the residents’ environment. They will provide information to report on the effectiveness of activities and regularly review, revise, and refresh the activities programmes for all residents accordingly.

JOB SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

Activities Coordination

§ Plan, organise, promote, and implement a meaningful, enjoyable, engaging and stimulating activities programme, based on relationship-centred care principles, throughout the home that involves and includes all residents relative to them as individuals.

§ Motivate, inspire, and mobilise other activities and care team members in the provision of meaningful, enjoyable, engaging and stimulating activities within the home to support relationship-centered care for residents.

§ Champion relationship-centered care with all team members in the home to ensure residents are empowered to make, or continue to make, lifestyle choices relevant and appropriate to them.

§ Lead on the design, development and implementation of the home’s newsletter that reports on the Home’s events and activities of interest (with photography where appropriate)

§ Ensure records relating to activities are accurate and up to date.

§ Plan regular reviews with each resident, in partnership with the care team members, where appropriate, to further enhance the lived experience of each resident in the home.

§ Conduct regular reviews of all activities programmes to measure and assess effectiveness, revising and refreshing activities for all residents as a result

§ Ensure events, activities and achievements are communicated to the Manager and, where possible, local media with the Managers support.

§ Build strong and positive external links within the local community for the Home

§ Support the home, in building volunteering opportunities within the homes.

§ Support the Home to ensure charity events organised by or within the Home are successful

§ Ensure all regulatory and statutory requirements are met and company policies and procedures are adhered to

§ Role model relationship centred care with all team members to empower residents with their choices.

§ Responsible for ensuring there is always sufficient equipment and resources available for the team to meaningfully engage and occupy residents.

§ To actively engage with residents in conversation and meaningful occupation related to their choices at a level and pace that values the individual and respects their dignity and communication differences.

§ To respond in a timely way to residents who are distressed (calling out, calling for help, knocking or making noises that suggest the need for support) or seek assistance if you feel unable to respond appropriately.

§ Document all activities that residents take part in or that are held within the home.

Health and Safety

§ Ensure the Home Manager / Team Leader is informed of any incidents, issues or concerns.

§ Work with Home’s team members to ensure risk assessments have been carried out on all outings and all documentation is complete and recorded.

§ Ensure risk assessments related to activities and volunteering are completed within the home and safe working practices are being always followed.

§ Ensure all H&S requirements are met and company policies and procedures relating to H&S are adhered to.

§ All staff are responsible for protecting themselves and others against infection risks. All staff regardless of whether clinical or not are expected to comply with current infection control policies and procedures and to report any problems regarding this to the manager. All staff undertaking patient care activities must attend infection control training and updates as required by this organisation.

Leadership

§ Be a role model to the whole team in relation to engagement of residents in all areas of care and support the team to provide the right level of occupation and activities to the residents.

§ Lead, support, empower and inspire direct reports to deliver outcomes for the home

§ Lead the team to ensure they are all aligned with the Strong Life Care vision and are operating from the Mission Statement.

§ Lead regular communication with residents and relatives.

§ Ensure all reporting is completed accurately and on time.

§ Ensure that all regulatory and statutory requirements are met and company policies and procedures are adhered to

§ Ensure any requirements from internal and external audits are actioned within the timescales required

§ Ensure there is effective communication and preparation of the activity program to all interested parties

§ Ensure that future activities are planned.

JOB DESCRIPTION RECORD

This job description reflects the current main organisational priorities for the position. These priorities may develop and change in consultation with the post holder in line with needs and priorities of the business.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Essential Criteria

Qualifications/Education

· A minimum of two GCSE’s, one of which must be English Language, at Grade C or above (or equivalent)

· NVQ HSC Level 3 or QCF HSC Award 3 (or higher) in Health and Social Care (or equivalent) (desirable)

· Having achieved or expected to complete the Level 2 award in supporting activities provisions (Desirable)

· Psychology or Creative Studies qualification (desirable)

Experience

· Proven track record organising, coordinating, supporting and motivating others.

· Experience of organising and scheduling programmes of events or activities

· Experience of working and/or engaging with older people (both living with and without dementia)

· Experience delivering high quality relationship centered care (desirable)

Skills/

Knowledge

· Strong management and organisation skills

· Influencing, negotiating, and persuading skills

· Listening skills

· Excellent written, non-verbal, and verbal communication skills

· Dementia knowledge - desirable

· Data management (for record keeping and review)

Personal Qualities

· Reliable and punctual

· Flexible and adaptable

· Will and able to work, from time to time, outside standard work hours (e.g. at weekends, evenings)

· Approachable and friendly

· Confident and assertive

· Diplomatic and tactful

· Enthusiastic and keen to learn / develop.

· Patient and understanding

· Positive in outlook and manner

· Self-motivated

· Able to always promote a professional image for the company.

· Able to travel to other homes where needed for training / support.

· Believe in and work within the Strong Life Care Mission and values.

title: IAM Success Manager
description:
About the role

Identity & Access Management (IAM) is becoming increasingly important as organizations evolve, digitalize, and strengthen their security posture. At If, we are developing modern IAM capabilities that support our employees, partners, and customers while enabling secure and efficient business operations.

As an IAM Success Manager, you will help drive adoption, engagement, and continuous improvement across our IAM services and products. You will work closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, product managers, architects, and end users across the organization.

The role combines elements of product management, service management, stakeholder engagement, communication, and change enablement. You will help connect business and technology perspectives, understand user needs, support the adoption of IAM capabilities, and contribute to communication and awareness activities. You will also participate in shaping the future direction of identity-related services for both human and non-human identities.

You do not need to be a deep IAM expert from day one. More important is your ability to collaborate with different stakeholders, understand their needs, drive improvements, and help others succeed.

You’ll join Digital Sales and Customer Experience, within Business Area Private, focusing on digital enablers for transformation. The team works across business and IT to deliver the IAM services our business needs.

What are you going to do?

  • Drive adoption, engagement, and continuous improvement of IAM services and products

  • Work closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, product managers, architects, and end users

  • Understand user and business needs and help translate them into improvements to IAM services

  • Connect business and technology perspectives and support collaboration across different teams

  • Support communication, awareness, and change activities related to IAM capabilities

  • Contribute to ensuring that IAM services deliver value and are understood by their users

  • Gather feedback and help improve how IAM services are delivered and experienced

  • Contribute to shaping the future direction of identity-related services for human and non-human identities

What do we expect from you?

Must have

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • A customer- and user-oriented mindset

  • Ability to coordinate activities across multiple teams

  • Experience in security, digital identity, and modern technology

  • Experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), including an understanding of non-human identities such as service accounts, applications, and AI agents and their access management needs

  • A structured and proactive way of working

  • Ability to navigate both business and technology discussions

  • Excellent English language skills are required for effective day-to-day communication with colleagues both locally and internationally

Nice to have

  • Experience with Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)

  • Product management experience

  • Business analysis experience

  • Experience with HR or workforce-related processes

  • Experience working in agile ways of working

Most importantly, you enjoy building relationships, solving problems, and continuously improving how services are delivered and experienced.

Our promise to you

  • Monthly salary: €3800 – 4500 gross depending on your qualifications

  • Strong company culture: knowledge sharing, company events, interesting speakers, and other inspiring initiatives

  • Career and development opportunities (e.g. 3 dedicated up-skilling days) in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics

  • Challenging and exciting projects with autonomy to plan own tasks

  • Extra vacation days, annual bonus, great insurance benefits, discounts on our products for you and your family, gifts, etc.

  • Possibility of hybrid work, where office is our primary workplace

  • A recently renovated office in Riga centre with a 24/7 gym on the premises

  • Business trips to Baltic and Nordic countries


Read more about benefits for our employees.

Application deadline: November 11, 2026


Your application will be processed according to our privacy notice.

title: Business Develop,
description:
Guidant Measurement delivers high-accuracy measurement solutions for the global energy industry. Built on the legacy of trusted brands Smith Meter®, INVALCO®, and Sening®, our technologies support custody transfer, terminal automation, and fluid measurement across production, transportation, and storage operations.

From flow meters and electronic measurement platforms to integrated terminal systems, Guidant solutions help customers operate safely, efficiently, and with confidence in the accuracy of every transaction.

With a global network of engineering, manufacturing, and service expertise, Guidant partners with operators around the world to solve complex measurement challenges and support the evolving energy landscape.

The Business Development role is responsible for identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities and accelerating order growth through proactive prospecting and deal creation within an assigned territory to increase market share for both new product sales and service of installed equipment.

This role builds and nurtures strong customer relationships, executes targeted sales strategies, and represents Guidant Measurement’s solutions through effective presentations, demonstrations, reporting, and post-sale support. Success requires a proactive, strategic, and technically knowledgeable approach to territory development, customer engagement, and negotiations.

What You Will Be Doing:


Prospecting & Relationship Management

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through cold calling, networking, referrals, and other pipeline building activities.
  • Build, develop, and maintain long-term customer relationships across the territory.
  • Drive sales growth and expand market share for new products and service offerings.
  • Maintain consistent communication with customers to support repeat business and loyalty.

Sales Strategy & Territory Planning

  • Develop and execute short-term and long-range territory plans to meet or exceed assigned sales quotas.
  • Identify, prioritize, and manage key target accounts to expand market presence.
  • Recommend specific sales initiatives that strengthen Guidant Measurement’s direct sales and service operations in the territory.
  • Monitor customer needs, market trends, and competitive activity to optimize strategy.

Sales Presentations & Customer Engagement

  • Conduct effective product demonstrations and value-focused sales presentations.
  • Arrange, lead, and participate in customer training sessions, seminars, and industry events.
  • Partner with internal technical and operations teams to ensure accurate and timely customer support.

Negotiation & Commercial Execution

  • Lead contract and pricing negotiations in alignment with established policies and procedures.
  • Prepare and deliver customer proposals that meet business and commercial requirements.
  • Ensure all closed business complies with internal governance, legal, and pricing frameworks

Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and timely records of sales activities, customer interactions, pipeline status, and forecasts in the CRM system.
  • Prepare reporting requested by management, including opportunity updates, project tracking, and account specific insights.

Other / Post Sale Support

  • Provide post sale follow-up to ensure customer satisfaction and encourage repeat business.
  • Coordinate appropriate technical interfaces between customers and all relevant internal departments.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives through feedback, documentation, and cross functional collaboration.

Your Areas of Knowledge and Expertise that matter most for this role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of sales experience OR 5 or more years in Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Field Service, or Engineering.
  • Experience in Custody Transfer or Process Measurement.
  • Experience with Metering Instrumentation, Automation Solutions, and applications in the Midstream and Downstream Petroleum markets.
  • Knowledge of Measurement Solutions products and services.
  • Excellent communication skills including written, verbal and presentation; strong understanding of the sales process within the Measurement Solutions or oil and gas industry
  • Self-Motivated: Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Other: Must have a valid driver’s license and capable of extensive travel to meet customers and attend events and/or trainings.

Key Interactions

Internally: Work cooperatively with product management, engineering, field service, manufacturing, and other departments to communicate and enhance business intelligence regarding product enhancements, pricing strategies, promotional plans, etc.

Externally: Capable of calling on all levels of decision makers within customer organizations including engineering, operations, procurement and field technicians

Work Environment:

Fast-paced, performance-driven environment with a focus on responsiveness, accuracy, and customer satisfaction. This role operates in a hybrid office environment requiring frequent interaction with regional teams, customers, and cross-functional partners. Regular use of standard office equipment and digital collaboration tools (video conferencing, CRM, ERP systems). Periodic domestic and international travel to customer sites, regional offices, and manufacturing facilities.

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. Guidant Measurements promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

Physical Demands:

This role will involve periods of sitting, working on a computer, and participating in virtual meetings. Frequent verbal and written communication required to interact with regional and global teams and customers. Ability to travel, including long-duration flights and time spent walking through customer sites, offices, and manufacturing facilities. May require standing, walking, or light physical activity during site visits. Ability to occasionally lift or carry light materials (e.g., laptop, documents, small equipment up to ~15 lbs.). Must be able to comply with safety requirements when visiting industrial sites, including wearing personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, steel-toe shoes, and hearing protection.

title: Sr. Wastewater Technician - 1st Shift
description:
Garelick Farms, Dairy Farmers of America, is excited to announce an opening for a 1st shift Sr. Wastewater Technician.

We offer excellent benefits and competitive pay with great growth opportunities!

1st Shift - Schedule - Tuesday - Saturday - 6:00AM - 2:30PM

External Candidate ~$1,500.00 sign-on bonus

GENERAL PURPOSE

Provide operation and maintenance support for the wastewater treatment plant, performing tasks in a safe manner and following safety and environmental regulations. Demonstrate full proficiency of wastewater treatment processes and activities. Work within defined processes or methodologies and help determine the appropriate approach for new assignments. Proactively or quickly recognize issues and provide solutions to problems in situations that are atypical or occur infrequently based on existing precedents. Work with a limited degree of supervision, with oversight focused only on new assignments. Be a resource and provide training for colleagues with less experience.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Inspect equipment and monitor operating conditions, meters, and gauges to determine load requirements and detect malfunctions

· Maintain chemicals levels, adjustment, and disinfection of water and other liquids

· Record operational data, meter, and gauge readings on specified forms at specified frequencies

· Perform COD, TSS, total solids and other analysis testing on daily samples; interpret daily results for operational trends and make informed adjustments based on daily data collection

· Solve common problems; analyze possible solutions using technical experience, judgment and precedents to solve more complex situations/issues

· Advise supervisor regarding potential areas of concern and then implement appropriate changes

· Assist with maintenance, repair, and lubrication of wastewater equipment using hand tools and power tools; record all parts used during preventive maintenance or repair

· Work with vendors to align with best practices. Ensure equipment is stored in ready state to allow placement directly from inventory to functioning in the plant

· Request maintenance repair work through appropriate system/process

· Monitor sludge dumpster levels (if appropriate) and call appropriate personal when an exchange is needed

· Accompany supervisor and regulatory inspectors on facility inspections, as requested, and implement corrective action accordingly

· Assist the supervisor with the purchasing of parts, materials, and chemicals

· Write, review, and/or update processes and documentation, such as standard operating procedures, job hazard analysis, lockout/tagout (LOTO) and confined space procedures

· Function as the primary resource with management on issues when supervisor is not available

· Communicate pertinent information at shift end to a shift supervisor

· Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, communicate to supervisor, and implement appropriate changes (Lean, Kaizen, 5S and Leader Standard Work)

· Attend required training, including but not limited to, GMP’s, HAACP, SQF, Safety, etc.

· Follow all DFA GMP’s and work in a manner consistent with all corporate and regulatory, food safety, quality, and sanitation requirements

· The requirements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employee, but is not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as required
