title: Electrical Technician
description:
Phillips 66 & YOU - Together we can fuel the future

Phillips 66 has been operating in the UK for over 65 years and we are as excited about our future as we are proud of our past. We are committed to improving lives, and that is our promise to our employees and communities. We are sustained by the backgrounds and experiences of our diverse teams, which reflect who we are, the environment we create and how we work together.


Our company is built on values of safety, honour and commitment. We call our cultural mindset Our Energy in Action, which we define through four simple, intuitive behaviors: We work for the greater good, cultivate an environment of trust, seek different perspectives and pursue excellence.


Our employees are the heart of our success, and there is a reason why we continue to attract great talent and it’s not just the excellent benefits package, or the opportunities for personal growth, it’s also the caring and committed culture of the organisation that makes everyone feel like they can bring their authentic self to work and be truly part of our team.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Electrical Technician is responsible for the safe, reliable and efficient execution of all maintenance activities on assigned process equipment, area or project. Responsible for adherence to maintenance and reliability work processes in alignment with asset integrity and reliability strategies. Ensures own work and that of other Phillips 66 employees and contractors is carried out efficiently and to a high quality.

Responsibilities May Include:

  • Role Model for company values
  • Resource for support to the Refinery
  • Successfully diagnosing physical cause of failure in conjunction with Reliability Group
  • Feeds forward continuous improvement ideas/reliability improvements to Discipline Supervisor for consideration
  • Ensuring quality repairs & understanding cause, with Zero re-work
  • Ensuring the most efficient and effective approach to work execution is taken
  • Ensuring Operational Reliability reports are correctly and timely completed with quality information
  • Ensuring that safety is paramount in all aspects of the work execution, including permit compliance, risk assessments, Material Safety Data Sheet, take time, method statements (as applicable)
  • Mentoring Peers and Operators in maintenance work practices and processes
  • Working with Discipline Supervisor / Area Planner to ensure correct updates to Bills of Materials
  • Driving changes to Planned Preventative Maintenance through Supervision
  • Executing Minor Maintenance jobs and supports Operations Minor Maintenance jobs

Qualifications

Basic/Required:

  • Legal right to work in the UK.
  • Discipline qualification (City & Guilds S/NVQ Level 3 or equivalent)
  • Full, valid UK driving licence
  • Demonstrated plant maintenance experience
  • Proven level of competence
  • Good written and oral communication skills
  • Effective time manager
  • Team player

Preferred:

  • Previous experience working with electrical equipment in refining or similar process industry
  • Working knowledge of refinery topography


Providing Energy. Improving Lives.

The Humber Refinery is playing its part of the UK’s decarbonisation efforts. As a part of the UK Government’s net zero ambition, the Humber Refinery is on a journey to become the Refinery of the Future. With proposed plans for a number of projects including to implement a first-of-a-kind FCC carbon capture project, the Humber Refinery is part of Humber Zero, a world-scale concept to reduce UK industry carbon emissions, saving up to 8 million tonnes of CO2 by 2030 from the Immingham industrial area. On top of this, the Humber Refinery is the UK’s only refiner producing Sustainable Aviation Fuel at scale. It is also the only European facility producing battery anode coke, which forms a critical component for lithium-ion batteries used in electrical vehicles and in consumer electronics. Our current production of battery anode coke is equivalent to placing 1.3 million EVs on the road every year, and we are developing multiple projects to expand this capability.

Phillips 66 has more than 140 years of experience in providing the energy that enables people to dream bigger and go farther, faster. Our company is built on values of safety, honor and commitment. We call our cultural mindset Our Energy in Action, which we define through four simple, intuitive behaviors: We work for the greater good, cultivate an environment of trust, seek different perspectives and pursue excellence.

title: Night carers
description:
Night Carers – Nursing Care Home, Castleford

Job Summary

We are looking for caring and compassionate Night Carers to join our nursing care home team in Castleford. As a Night Carer, you will provide safe, dignified and person-centred support to residents through the night, helping them feel settled, secure and well looked after. This role suits someone who values kindness, patience and respect, and who wants to make a real difference to people's lives. No previous experience is required.

About the Role

Our Night Carers play an essential part in the nursing care home team, ensuring residents receive attentive, high-quality care around the clock. Working closely with nursing colleagues, you will provide reassurance and personal support, respond to residents' needs and help maintain a calm, comfortable environment overnight. Salary is competitive, and the Night Carer position is based on site in Castleford. Remote work is not available.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide compassionate personal care to residents during the night, including support with washing, dressing, toileting, continence care and repositioning, while promoting dignity and independence.
  • Monitor residents' wellbeing through regular night checks, and report any changes in health, behaviour or mood to the nurse in charge promptly.
  • Collaborate with nursing staff and the wider care team to deliver care plans and support residents' individual needs and preferences.
  • Respond calmly and quickly to call bells, emergencies and incidents, following established procedures.
  • Support residents who are anxious, unsettled or awake during the night with patience, reassurance and good listening.
  • Maintain accurate, timely records of care delivered, observations and handover information in line with company policy.
  • Assist with early-morning routines, including supporting residents with hydration and preparing them for the day shift handover.
  • Uphold safeguarding, infection prevention, health and safety, and confidentiality standards at all times.
  • Contribute to a clean, safe, comfortable and homely environment for residents and their visitors.

Required Qualifications

  • A caring, compassionate and respectful approach to supporting vulnerable adults.
  • Willingness to work night shifts, including waking nights, and to stay alert and attentive throughout.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to build warm, trusting relationships with residents, families and colleagues.
  • Reliability, a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Willingness to undergo relevant pre-employment checks, including an enhanced DBS check and right-to-work verification.
  • Commitment to treating every resident with dignity, equality and respect.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a care home, nursing home, hospital or other care setting (helpful but not essential).
  • A Care Certificate or a Level 2 or 3 qualification in Health and Social Care, or willingness to work towards one.
  • Experience supporting people living with dementia, reduced mobility or complex health needs.
  • Training in moving and handling, first aid, safeguarding or infection control.

Skills

Core Skills

  • Empathy, patience and emotional resilience
  • Clear verbal communication and active listening
  • Attention to detail and accurate record keeping
  • Observation skills and the ability to recognise changes in a resident's condition
  • Calm, sound decision-making under pressure
  • Teamwork and effective shift handover

Practical Skills

  • Knowledge of personal care and safe moving and handling techniques
  • Awareness of infection prevention and hygiene practices
  • Understanding of safeguarding principles and the importance of confidentiality
  • Basic digital skills for completing care records, where applicable

Application Information

If you are caring and compassionate and would like to join our team as a Night Carer, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application through the usual channels, including a brief summary of your background and why you would like to work in a nursing care home setting. Experience in care is welcome but not required, as we value the right attitude and values.

title: Butiksmedarbetare Stockholm
description:
Butikssäljare till MM Sports – Stockholm

MM Sports är ett av Nordens största företag inom kosttillskott, träningskläder, träningsredskap och tillbehör. Med ett komplett sortiment erbjuder vi marknadens mest kvalitativa och genomtänkta produkter för att hjälpa våra kunder att ta sin träning till nästa nivå. Vi brinner för träning och vill inspirera andra att bli starkare – vill du vara med på vår resa?

Om tjänsten

Vi söker dig som brinner för träning, service och försäljning. Du gillar mötet med människor och drivs av att ge varje kund en riktigt bra upplevelse – oavsett om det handlar om att hitta rätt kosttillskott, välja träningskläder eller bara ge extra energi i vardagen.

Hos oss är butiken mer än en butik. Det är en mötesplats för människor med träningsintresse och höga ambitioner.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som butikssäljare hos MM Sports är din främsta uppgift att ge professionell rådgivning kring våra produkter. Kunden är alltid i fokus – före, under och efter köpet. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

  • Försäljning, rådgivning och kundservice

  • Påfyllning av varor och butiksplock

  • Orderläggning och inventering

Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av butiksförsäljning och trivs i en roll där service, ansvar och resultat går hand i hand. Du är självgående, lösningsorienterad och gillar att arbeta i ett högt tempo.

Du har ett genuint intresse för träning och hälsa och tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap till kunder och kollegor. Eftersom tjänsten ibland innebär ensamarbete behöver du känna dig trygg i att ta ansvar och fatta egna beslut i det dagliga arbetet.

Vi söker också dig som är flexibel och trivs i en vardag där scheman och arbetstider ibland kan anpassas utifrån verksamhetens behov. Under perioder kan extra ansvar och fler timmar förekomma.

Arbetet är fysiskt och innefattar regelbundet tunga lyft i samband med leveranser och varuhantering. Det är därför viktigt att du är bekväm med ett praktiskt och fysiskt arbete där bland annat lådor och varor behöver hanteras och bäras mellan butik och lager.

✔ Erfarenhet av butiksförsäljning
✔ Intresse och kunskap inom träning och kosttillskott
✔ Motiveras av att arbeta mot mål och skapa kundupplevelser

Commit to Quality

På MM Sports är det nära till beslut och nästa nivå. Vi präglas av gemenskap, ansvar och glädje och har en tydlig tillväxtresa framför oss. Vi strävar efter att arbeta enkelt, effektivt och med snabba beslutsvägar för att driva utvecklingen framåt.

Hos oss får du ett varierande arbete och ett starkt ägandeskap i en verksamhet som växer. Vi står för Kvalitet, Kunskap och Passion – We commit to quality!

Placering & arbetstid

📍 Placering: I våra 4 butiker i region Stockholm.
⏳ Omfattning: 13% schemalagd tid med möjlighet till extra timmar.
🎯 Start: Så snart som möjligt, enligt överenskommelse.

Det här erbjuder vi:

✔ Ett passionerat, drivet och engagerat team
✔ Självklart avtalsenliga arbetsvillkor

Vi genomför intervjuer löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan ansökningstiden löpt ut. Inledande intervjuer sker via Teams, medan slutskedet innefattar fysiska intervjuer i butiken.

title: Master (MSc) Thesis ''Study of an Advanced Power Supply for Spacecraft''
description:
Are you interested in contributing to the development of hardware for future space missions? OHB Sweden is looking for a Master's student to support their development of an advanced power supply for Spacecraft.

During the thesis, you will work with the complete early-stage development process, from defining the concepts to preliminary sizing, modelling, and if time allows, electronics design. The work will involve balancing key considerations such as performance, reliability, costs, and manufacturability. You will have the possibility to design and simulate a proof of concept if time allows.

You will carry out the thesis as part of OHB Sweden's Avionics and Electrical department, working closely with experienced engineers and contributing to the development of technology intended for future space applications.

The tasks of the master's thesis topic are as follows:

The student will contribute to the development of the power supply through activities such as:

  • Requirements Specification definition and its design consequences,

  • Trade off and selection of key DC-DC converter topologies

  • Simulations of the concept (transients, efficiency, start-up, EMI, etc.)

  • Review and consolidation of the required component technologies,

  • Design, Schematics and analysis of electronics (FMEA, reliability, WCA),

  • Report

The required candidate’s skills are:

The position is suitable for Master's students in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Preliminary experience (through university courses, extra curriculum activities or autodidact) in the following domains is expected / required:

  • Good knowledge of Power Electronics (topologies, stability, components)

  • Matlab / Simulink or equivalent piecewise linear model simulation (i.e PLECS)

  • Spice Simulations

  • Testing (i.e power supplies, oscilloscopes, multimeter)

  • Scripting (i.e Python)

What can we offer the student to succeed in his/her master's thesis?

The student will become part of OHB Sweden's Avionics and Electrical team and contribute to the development of an Innosat avionics architecture. The work offers hands-on experience with real hardware development and close collaboration with engineers working on current and future space missions.

Successful thesis work may also open a path towards future employment within the Avionics & Electrical team at OHB Sweden.

title: OT specialist
description:
Are you experienced in OT cybersecurity and industrial network architecture? Do you enjoy designing secure networks, solving complex technical challenges, and turning cybersecurity best practices into practical solutions?

At Alight, you’ll help protect the infrastructure behind some of the Nordics’ most ambitious solar and battery storage projects.

Join us as an OT Specialist and take an active role in shaping how we secure, standardize, and manage our growing portfolio of renewable energy assets across Europe.

About Alight

Alight is an entrepreneurial renewable energy company on a mission to decarbonize the grid by helping energy-intensive businesses transition to solar power.

Founded in 2013, we have helped shape the Nordic solar industry through some of the region’s largest solar installations, innovative financing solutions, and pioneering hybrid solar and battery energy storage (BESS) projects.

As a leading independent power producer (IPP) in the Nordics, we own and operate the assets that generate renewable energy. This means our operational technology (OT) systems are a critical part of the energy infrastructure we manage—and protecting them is essential to keeping our solar parks secure, reliable, and operational.

Your impact

As our OT Specialist, you’ll help build and strengthen the cybersecurity foundations of our solar parks. Working closely with our existing OT Specialist, you’ll take shared ownership of OT security across our portfolio, from improving the architecture of existing installations to designing secure networks for new projects.

This is a technically focused role with a strong emphasis on network architecture and security. You’ll work with industrial networks, firewalls, network segmentation, secure remote access, SCADA systems, and the wider OT environment, ensuring that security is built into our assets from the outset and continuously improved throughout their lifecycle.

You’ll divide your time between strategic improvements, project work, and operational support. This means collaborating with engineering and project teams on new installations while working with Asset Management to strengthen the security and resilience of existing sites.

The role is open to candidates based in Sweden, Finland, Norway, or Denmark, with flexible remote and hybrid working options. Our headquarters are in Stockholm, with a smaller office in Helsinki. The role also involves occasional travel to our project sites and solar parks across the Nordics.

You’ll help shape the next generation of OT security at Alight, with responsibilities including:


Industrial network architecture and security

  • Design, review, and improve network architectures for existing and new solar parks, including SCADA systems, dataloggers, and other OT components.

  • Implement and improve network security measures, including firewalls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

  • Establish consistent security standards and network configurations across our growing portfolio of assets.

  • Work with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) teams to ensure security is integrated into new projects from the design stage.

OT cybersecurity and risk management

  • Identify, assess, and prioritize vulnerabilities across OT devices, software, and networks, coordinating remediation and patching activities.

  • Conduct OT security risk assessments and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

  • Strengthen access management by supporting centralized management of privileged access and OT credentials.

  • Contribute to security monitoring, incident response, and the development of practical recovery procedures for scenarios affecting site operations.

Asset management and continuous improvement

  • Develop and maintain an accurate inventory of OT assets, networks, software, and configurations.

  • Ensure OT documentation, including network diagrams, firewall rules, and security policies, is accurate and accessible.

  • Improve standardization across sites by developing repeatable processes, technical guidelines, and security best practices.

  • Collaborate with Asset Management, IT, Engineering, and external partners to balance security improvements with operational reliability.

We’re looking for you

We’re looking for someone who understands how industrial networks are built and secured, and who can translate that knowledge into robust, scalable solutions.

You may currently work in OT cybersecurity, industrial networking, SCADA infrastructure, automation, or network engineering within the energy, utilities, or industrial sectors. Whatever your background, you’re comfortable looking at an industrial network architecture, understanding how its components communicate, identifying weaknesses, and determining how to improve its security.

We believe you’ll bring:

  • A degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in OT cybersecurity, industrial networking, or securing technical infrastructure within the energy, utilities, or industrial sectors.

  • Strong knowledge of network architecture, including the ability to interpret network diagrams and understand how firewalls, switches, and connected devices interact.

  • A solid understanding of network security principles, including firewalls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

  • Experience designing, implementing, or securing industrial networks, ideally involving SCADA systems, dataloggers, or other OT infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, OT security tools, and vulnerability management.

  • An analytical and structured approach to identifying risks, solving technical problems, and prioritizing security improvements.

  • The ability to communicate technical concepts and security risks clearly to colleagues and stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work across projects, operations, and multiple technical teams.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Extra points if you also have

  • Experience with renewable energy systems, such as solar PV, battery energy storage, or wind power.

  • Knowledge of the IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards.

  • An understanding of electrical systems and industrial control environments.

  • Experience with centralized privileged access management (PAM), OT asset inventories, or configuration management databases (CMDBs).

  • Familiarity with command-line tools and industrial network troubleshooting.


Sounds like a fit? Apply today!

title: Quality Supervisor
description:
About Kitron

Kitron is a leading Scandinavian Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) company, delivering improved flexibility, cost efficiency, and innovation power through the value chain. The company has operations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Lithuania, Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, India, China, Malaysia and the United States. With 2500 highly skilled employees, Kitron manufactures and delivers anything from fully assembled electronic circuit boards to complete end - products for customers globally. Related technical services like prototyping, industrialisation, material analysing and test development are also key competencies offered by Kitron.

Our values

Location: Senai

1. QA Team Management

  • Manage and oversee IQA, IPQA, OBA inspection activities and non-conformance handling processes.

  • Plan and allocate QA/IQA manpower based on incoming material status and production output requirements.

  • Guide and coach QA personnel on inspection methods and quality standards.

  • Ensure all inspections are performed in accordance with established procedures and work instructions, with accurate completion of inspection records.

  • Conduct monthly and annual performance evaluations for QA/IQA personnel.

  • Supervise workplace discipline and ensure compliance with company policies.

  • Monitor employees' working hours, breaks, and maintain 5S standards within the QA area.

  • Report shift handover issues and quality abnormalities to the responsible engineers, follow up on corrective actions, and communicate updates to all QA personnel, including the night shift leader.

  • Conduct daily shift briefing meetings for QA teams at the beginning of each shift.

2. Process Audit

  • Perform regular production process audits covering Man, Machine, Material, Method, Environment, and Product characteristics.

  • Identify non-conformities, document audit findings, and coordinate with responsible departments to implement corrective actions.

3. New Employee Training

  • Organize practical training and competency assessments for new QA employees according to the approved Job Description.

  • Conduct practical training and competency evaluations for employees promoted to higher-level QA positions.

  • Maintain and update all training records and documentation.

4. Report Review & Documentation

  • Review QA reports daily before the end of each shift and investigate any abnormalities.

  • Review SFC system reports every morning to ensure data accuracy.

  • Collect, organize, scan, and archive all First Article Inspection (FAI) records on a weekly basis.

5. Production Area Lighting Measurement

  • Measure and record illumination levels at inspection workstations according to the lighting inspection procedure.

  • Ensure inspection areas meet the required lighting standards.

6. Soldering Iron Verification

  • Perform periodic soldering iron inspections and measurements in accordance with established procedures.

  • Follow up promptly on corrective actions for any soldering irons that do not meet specifications.

7. Microscope & Magnifier Maintenance

  • Perform routine maintenance and calibration checks for QA microscopes and magnifiers in accordance with maintenance procedures.

  • Ensure all inspection equipment remains in good working condition.

8. AOI Program Arrangement

  • Coordinate QA personnel to support HMD AOI program creation during the assigned shift.

  • Prioritize AOI programming activities based on engineering requirements and production priorities.

9. Other Duties

  • Perform any other duties assigned by the immediate superior.

Requirements

  • High School Certificate, Diploma, or equivalent qualification.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Quality Assurance within the electronics manufacturing industry.

  • Good understanding of IQA, IPQA, OBA inspection processes and non-conformance control.

  • Experienced in using inspection and measurement equipment such as microscopes, magnifiers, vernier calipers, and 2.5D measuring instruments.

  • Good knowledge of IPC standards and ability to apply them in practical inspection activities.

  • Familiar with AOI program creation and modification.

  • Strong observation and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Good coaching and mentoring skills to develop QA team members.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and coordination abilities.

  • Detail-oriented, proactive, responsible, and able to work effectively under pressure.

title: Senior Product Manager - Financial Services Ops
description:
Your role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead Financial Services Ops, the squad that turns compliance, risk, and operational needs into product. Your internal customers are the Compliance, Operations, Risk, and Fraud teams that keep Spendesk’s payment licence running, together with the four Financial Services squads building cards, wallets, and transfers for end customers.

Today, those teams pull product and engineering time from across Financial Services. A regulatory change, a manual operational workload, or a risk alert can become a new P0 on another squad’s roadmap. Your role is to absorb that demand, turn it into one prioritised backlog, and build the tools and workflows that help compliance and operations scale without slowing the rest of Financial Services down.

The squad already owns KYC and AML, including company onboarding, representative verification, ongoing transaction monitoring, and the migration of our transaction monitoring system. The scope is broader than KYC and AML: you will own the internal platform between Spendesk’s regulated entity and the products built on top of it.

What you’ll own

  • Onboarding and KYC: company and representative verification, document collection, and time-to-activation.

  • AML and monitoring: transaction monitoring, alert handling, and the transaction monitoring system migration.

  • Operations tooling: back-office tools, case management, and dashboards that replace manual work.

  • Risk and fraud controls: controls, limits, and the signals Risk and Fraud teams need to act.

  • Regulatory intake: one entry point and one priority order for regulatory and operational requests across Compliance, Legal, and the Financial Services squads.

  • Infrastructure vendors: identity verification, monitoring, and BaaS partners across the EU, UK, and US.

What you’ll do

  • Define the platform strategy and roadmap so it serves Financial Services business goals and regulatory obligations.

  • Replace the current competing-P0 model with a single intake and prioritised backlog agreed by Compliance, Operations, and the Financial Services squads.

  • Rebuild company onboarding to reduce time-to-activation, improve document completion, and remove manual rework.

  • Lead the transaction monitoring system migration with Engineering and Compliance.

  • Build internal tools and dashboards that help Operations scale without adding headcount at the same pace.

  • Define and instrument metrics that do not exist yet, including time-to-activation, file completeness at KYC entry, cost per manual case, straight-through processing rate, and engineering time spent on internal requests outside your squad.

  • Act as the bridge between Product and Compliance, so regulation is designed in rather than patched later.

  • Evaluate and manage identity, monitoring, and infrastructure vendors.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated environment.

  • Experience building products for internal users, such as back-office, operations tooling, platform, or infrastructure products.

  • Comfort working with regulation. You do not need to be a lawyer, but PSD2, AML directives, compliance policies, and conversations with an MLRO should be familiar territory.

  • Analytical rigour: you define success metrics, instrument what is not measured yet, and use evidence to prioritise.

  • Clear, natural communication. You can explain a regulation in plain language, build trust with Compliance, Operations, and Engineering, and negotiate scope without losing substance.

  • The resilience to work effectively in a changing environment with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with KYC, KYB, AML, or transaction monitoring.

  • Experience owning onboarding or identity verification flows with measurable outcomes.

  • Experience leading a vendor migration or infrastructure integration, such as a BaaS, card processor, or monitoring provider integration.

  • Experience working across EU, UK, and US regulatory contexts.

  • Fluency in French or Spanish.

About Spendesk

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk gives employees a simpler way to spend and finance leaders the visibility and control they need across company spend, including multi-entity structures.

Spendesk supports more than 200,000 users across companies including PayFit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt, and Yousign. The company has offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain, and Germany, and puts community at the heart of its mission.

For more information:

About our people and culture

We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to thrive and grow. Liberation is at the core of how we work: we empower Spendeskers to take ownership, navigate ambiguity, and seize opportunities. Our international team spans more than 35 countries, with a shared commitment to curiosity, kindness, and tackling challenges with a positive mindset.

About our benefits

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth, with benefits to match:

  • Flexible on-site and remote policy.

  • Latest Apple equipment.

  • Access to for emotional and mental health wellbeing.

  • Great office snacks.

  • A positive team to work with every day.

We also offer location-specific benefits, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships.

Diversity and inclusion

At Spendesk, we are committed to fostering an environment where differences are encouraged, supported, and celebrated. We are building our culture for everyone, with everyone, and welcome people from all backgrounds.

As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.
